### 8. `demo/captures/render_v5_cards.py`

**Purpose.** Renders three HTML title/end cards to 1920×1080 PNG files using headless Playwright. These static PNGs are used as freeze-frame segments in the ffmpeg mix scripts. Version 5 cards: `audit_trail_card.html`, `end_card_v5.html`, `title_beat3.html`.

---

**Lines 1–27 — complete file.** The entire script is a single `main()` coroutine. No CLI arguments. Creates `raw-v5/` output directory. Launches headless Chromium with 1920×1080 viewport. For each of the three card names, navigates to the local HTML file via `as_uri()`, waits 0.8 s for fonts and CSS animations to settle, and takes a viewport (non-full-page) screenshot with background included.

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render v5.1 cards to 1920x1080 PNGs."""
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright

DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
OUT = DIR / "raw-v5"
OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
CARDS = DIR / "cards"

async def main():
    async with async_playwright() as pw:
        browser = await pw.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        ctx = await browser.new_context(viewport={"width": 1920, "height": 1080})
        page = await ctx.new_page()
        for name in ["audit_trail_card", "end_card_v5", "title_beat3"]:
            await page.goto((CARDS / f"{name}.html").as_uri(), wait_until="networkidle")
            await asyncio.sleep(0.8)
            out = OUT / f"{name}.png"
            await page.screenshot(path=str(out), full_page=False, omit_background=False)
            print(f"[ok] {out}")
        await ctx.close()
        await browser.close()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())
```

**Produces:** `raw-v5/audit_trail_card.png`, `raw-v5/end_card_v5.png`, `raw-v5/title_beat3.png` — via Playwright headless Chromium screenshotting local HTML files.

### 9. `demo/captures/mix_video_v6_1.sh`

**Purpose.** Master ffmpeg assembly script for the v6.1 submission video (`pawconscious-demo-v6.1-soul-corcho.mp4`). Assembles 11 visual segments (Veo opening, screen captures, title card, Veo closing, end card), chains 8 VO MP3 beats with millisecond-precise offsets, applies a 10-stage emotional volume arc to the Lyria music bed, sidechains the music under VO, and muxes everything into a 2-minute final output. All intermediate files land in `_work_v6_1/`.

---

**Lines 1–11 — script header and change log.** Documents v6.1 changes from v6 (Corcho/chews/no-Mesh/pricing/beat-7-length), the output filename, and `set -euo pipefail` for strict error handling.

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# v6.1 mix — soul + Corcho + chews + no overlap + product on phone.
#
# Changes from v6:
# - VO regenerated with Corcho/10yo/no Mesh/improved pricing/tightened beat 7
# - Veo opening regen with chews jar (not liquid tincture)
# - Veo closing regen with phone product card visible
# - Beat 7 VO now 12s instead of 17s — fixes the 1:46 overlap
#
# Output: pawconscious-demo-v6.1-soul-corcho.mp4

set -euo pipefail
```

---

**Lines 13–22 — path setup.** Sets `DIR` to the script's own directory. Defines source directories for raw captures (v4 and v5), Veo clips, VO MP3s, and music. Sets the output path and working directory.

```bash
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
RAW_V4="$DIR/raw-v4"
RAW_V5="$DIR/raw-v5"
VEO="$DIR/veo-v6"
VO="$DIR/vo-v6_1"
MUSIC="$DIR/music-v3"
OUT="$DIR/pawconscious-demo-v6.1-soul-corcho.mp4"
WORK="$DIR/_work_v6_1"

mkdir -p "$WORK"
```

---

**Lines 24–33 — input validation.** Checks existence of all required source files before doing any work: four webm passes (A–D from raw-v4), two PNGs (title_beat3, end_card_v5 from raw-v5), two Veo MP4s (opening and closing from veo-v6), the music bed WAV, and all 8 VO beat MP3s. Exits with error on any missing file.

```bash
for f in "$RAW_V4/passA.webm" "$RAW_V4/passB.webm" "$RAW_V4/passC.webm" "$RAW_V4/passD.webm" \
         "$RAW_V5/title_beat3.png" "$RAW_V5/end_card_v5.png" \
         "$VEO/opening_corcho_chews.mp4" "$VEO/closing_corcho_product.mp4" \
         "$MUSIC/bed.wav"; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "missing $f" >&2; exit 1; }
done
for n in 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08; do
  [ -f "$VO/beat-$n.mp3" ] || { echo "missing beat-$n.mp3" >&2; exit 1; }
done
```

---

**Lines 35–37 — video constants.**

```bash
W=1920; H=1080; FPS=30; BG="#0E1218"
```

---

**Lines 39–101 — visual segment encoding (b1a through b8b).** Eleven ffmpeg invocations, each producing one H.264 segment in `_work_v6_1/`. All use `-preset slow -crf 18` for high quality, `-r 30` for consistent frame rate, `-an` to strip audio, and `format=yuv420p` for compatibility. Details per segment:

- `b1a_veo.mp4` — Veo opening, 8 s, letterboxed to 1920×1080 with `#0E1218` background padding.
- `b1b_demo.mp4` — First 2 s of passA (scene-0 start).
- `b2.mp4` — passA seconds 2–12 (10 s, Gemini recommendation cold open).
- `b3a_title.mp4` — `title_beat3.png` frozen for 6 s (still image → video via `-loop 1`).
- `b3b_block_start.mp4` — passA seconds 14–23 (9 s, scene-2b beginning).
- `b4.mp4` — passA seconds 23–48 (25 s, BLOCK verdict bento fills + replacement copy).
- `b5.mp4` — passB seconds 0–15 (15 s, PASS + chain anchor).
- `b6.mp4` — passD seconds 0–15 (15 s, `/agents` page scroll).
- `b7.mp4` — passC seconds 0–15 (15 s, `/architecture` SVG pan).
- `b8a_closing.mp4` — Veo closing, 8 s, letterboxed + 1-second black fade-out starting at t=7.
- `b8b_end.mp4` — `end_card_v5.png` frozen 7 s with 1-second fade-in and 2-second fade-out.

```bash
echo "[v6.1 mix] building visuals..."

# b1a — Veo opening Corcho with chews (8s)
ffmpeg -y -i "$VEO/opening_corcho_chews.mp4" -t 8 -an \
  -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -r $FPS \
  -vf "scale=$W:$H:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=$W:$H:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:color=$BG,format=yuv420p" \
  "$WORK/b1a_veo.mp4" 2>&1 | tail -1
# b1b — 2s scene-0 start
ffmpeg -y -i "$RAW_V4/passA.webm" -t 2 -an \
  -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -r $FPS \
  -vf "scale=$W:$H,format=yuv420p" \
  "$WORK/b1b_demo.mp4" 2>&1 | tail -1
# b2 — passA[2-12]
ffmpeg -y -ss 2 -i "$RAW_V4/passA.webm" -t 10 -an \
  -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -r $FPS -vf "scale=$W:$H,format=yuv420p" \
  "$WORK/b2.mp4" 2>&1 | tail -1
# b3a — title card (6s)
```

**Lines 88–104 — concat list and visual assembly.** Writes a `concat.txt` file with all 11 segment paths (using `file '...'` absolute path syntax). Runs ffmpeg concat demuxer with `-c copy` (stream copy, no re-encode). Reports visual track duration via `ffprobe`.

```bash
# Concat
cat > "$WORK/concat.txt" <<EOF
file '$WORK/b1a_veo.mp4'
file '$WORK/b1b_demo.mp4'
file '$WORK/b2.mp4'
file '$WORK/b3a_title.mp4'

file '$WORK/b7.mp4'
file '$WORK/b8a_closing.mp4'
file '$WORK/b8b_end.mp4'
EOF
ffmpeg -y -f concat -safe 0 -i "$WORK/concat.txt" -c copy "$WORK/visual.mp4" 2>&1 | tail -1
VISUAL_DUR=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$WORK/visual.mp4")
echo "[v6.1 mix] visual: ${VISUAL_DUR}s"
```

---

**Lines 106–122 — VO chain assembly.** Constructs an ffmpeg `adelay` + `amix` filter graph dynamically via bash loop. Beat start times in milliseconds: 0, 10000, 20000, 35000, 60000, 75000, 90000, 105000. For each of the 8 beats, the loop emits `[$i:a]adelay=${ms}|${ms}[a$i];` into `FILTER` and `-i $VO/beat-$b.mp3` into `INPUTS`. After the loop, the 8 delayed streams are mixed with `amix=inputs=8:duration=longest:normalize=0`, padded to 120 s, trimmed to exactly 120 s, and encoded as AAC 192 kbps stereo to `vo.m4a`.

```bash
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# VO chain (unchanged beat starts; beat 7 VO is just shorter now so no overlap)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
declare -a STARTS=(0 10000 20000 35000 60000 75000 90000 105000)
declare -a BEATS=(01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08)
INPUTS=""
FILTER=""
for i in "${!BEATS[@]}"; do
  b=${BEATS[$i]}
  ms=${STARTS[$i]}
  INPUTS="$INPUTS -i $VO/beat-$b.mp3"
  FILTER="$FILTER[$i:a]adelay=${ms}|${ms}[a$i];"
done
MIXES=""
for i in "${!BEATS[@]}"; do MIXES="$MIXES[a$i]"; done
FILTER="${FILTER}${MIXES}amix=inputs=${#BEATS[@]}:duration=longest:normalize=0,apad=whole_dur=120,atrim=0:120,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS"
ffmpeg -y $INPUTS -filter_complex "$FILTER" -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 44100 -ac 2 "$WORK/vo.m4a" 2>&1 | tail -1
```

---

**Lines 124–142 — Lyria music arc.** Applies a 10-segment piecewise volume envelope to `bed.wav` via ffmpeg's `volume` filter in `eval=frame` mode (evaluated per-frame using `if(lt(t,...))` nesting). The emotional arc:

| Time window | Volume | Narrative moment |
|---|---|---|
| 0–10 s | 0.60 | Veo Corcho opening — warm intro |
| 10–20 s | 0.55 | Gemini recommendation cold open |
| 20–35 s | 0.55 → 0.45 (ramp) | Title card + BLOCK beginning |
| 35–58 s | 0.45 → 0.30 (ramp) | BLOCK bento fills + verdict |
| 58–60 s | 0.10 | Near-silence: the protected moment |
| 60–75 s | 0.50 | PASS + chain anchor — relief |
| 75–90 s | 0.55 | Developer surface — steady |
| 90–105 s | 0.55 → 0.65 (ramp) | Architecture — building swell |
| 105–117 s | 0.65 | Veo closing — warm resolution |
| 117–120 s | 0.65 → 0 (fade) | Silence |

Output: `music_arc.m4a` at AAC 160 kbps.

```bash
# Music arc (unchanged from v6)
ffmpeg -y -i "$MUSIC/bed.wav" -filter_complex "
  [0:a]
  atrim=0:120,
  asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,
  volume='
    if(lt(t,10), 0.60,
    if(lt(t,20), 0.55,
    if(lt(t,35), 0.55 - (t-20)/15 * 0.10,
    if(lt(t,58), 0.45 - (t-35)/23 * 0.15,
    if(lt(t,60), 0.10,
    if(lt(t,75), 0.50,
    if(lt(t,90), 0.55,
    if(lt(t,105), 0.55 + (t-90)/15 * 0.10,
    if(lt(t,117), 0.65,
    if(lt(t,120), 0.65 * (1 - (t-117)/3),
    0))))))))))':eval=frame
  [out]
" -map "[out]" -c:a aac -b:a 160k -ar 44100 -ac 2 "$WORK/music_arc.m4a" 2>&1 | tail -1
```

---

**Lines 144–159 — sidechain compression, final mux, and probe.** Mixes VO (`vo.m4a`) and music arc (`music_arc.m4a`) using `sidechaincompress` (threshold 0.05, ratio 4:1, attack 20 ms, release 400 ms, makeup gain 1) so music ducks under speech. Then adds the unprocessed VO back on top of the ducked music via `amix`, applies `alimiter=limit=0.95` to prevent clipping. Output: `audio.m4a` at AAC 192 kbps.

Final mux: stream-copies `visual.mp4` video and `audio.m4a` audio into the output MP4 with `-movflags +faststart` (moves moov atom to front for streaming) and `-t 120` (hard 2-minute cap). Runs `ffprobe` on the output to report format duration, bit rate, codec names, and resolution.

```bash
# Mix VO + music
ffmpeg -y -i "$WORK/vo.m4a" -i "$WORK/music_arc.m4a" -filter_complex "
  [1:a][0:a]sidechaincompress=threshold=0.05:ratio=4:attack=20:release=400:makeup=1[ducked];
  [0:a][ducked]amix=inputs=2:duration=longest:normalize=0,
  alimiter=limit=0.95
" -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 44100 -ac 2 "$WORK/audio.m4a" 2>&1 | tail -1

# Final
ffmpeg -y -i "$WORK/visual.mp4" -i "$WORK/audio.m4a" \
  -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a copy -movflags +faststart \
  -t 120 "$OUT" 2>&1 | tail -1

echo
echo "FINAL: $OUT"
ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration,bit_rate -show_entries stream=codec_name,width,height -of default=noprint_wrappers=1 "$OUT"
echo "Size: $(du -h "$OUT" | cut -f1)"
```

**Produces:** `pawconscious-demo-v6.1-soul-corcho.mp4` (1920×1080, 30fps, 2:00, H.264 + AAC, faststart) — via ffmpeg using Playwright screen captures + Veo 3.1 clips + ElevenLabs VO + Lyria music bed as inputs.

**Lines 148–178 — Lyria music arc with inline documentation.** Same piecewise volume envelope as v6.1. v6 includes the full documentary comment block (extracted during the v6 → v6.1 refactor). The comment block maps each time window to its volume and narrative moment, making v6.sh the canonical reference for the arc design rationale.

```bash
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Music bed with EMOTIONAL ARC. Volume envelope:
#   0-10s   warm intro (0.60) - Trufa opening
#   10-20s  steady (0.55)     - Gemini ships
#   20-35s  tension build (0.55→0.45) - title + block start
#   35-58s  block tension (0.45→0.30) - bento fills + verdict
#   58-60s  near-silent (0.10) - the protected frame moment
#   60-75s  relief warmth (0.50) - PASS + chain anchor
#   75-90s  steady (0.55)     - developer surface
#   90-105s building swell (0.60) - architecture
#   105-117s peak warm resolution (0.65) - closing Veo
#   117-120s fade to silence (0.65→0)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
ffmpeg -y -i "$MUSIC/bed.wav" -filter_complex "
  [0:a]
  atrim=0:120,
  asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,
  volume='
    if(lt(t,10), 0.60,
    if(lt(t,20), 0.55,
    if(lt(t,35), 0.55 - (t-20)/15 * 0.10,
    if(lt(t,58), 0.45 - (t-35)/23 * 0.15,
    if(lt(t,60), 0.10,
    if(lt(t,75), 0.50,
    if(lt(t,90), 0.55,
    if(lt(t,105), 0.55 + (t-90)/15 * 0.10,
    if(lt(t,117), 0.65,
    if(lt(t,120), 0.65 * (1 - (t-117)/3),
    0))))))))))':eval=frame
  [out]
" -map "[out]" -c:a aac -b:a 160k -ar 44100 -ac 2 "$WORK/music_arc.m4a" 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "[v6 mix] music arc built"
```

```bash
  [0:a][ducked]amix=inputs=2:duration=longest:normalize=0,
  alimiter=limit=0.95
" -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 44100 -ac 2 "$WORK/audio.m4a" 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "[v6 mix] audio built (arc + sidechain)"

# Final mux

  -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a copy -movflags +faststart \
```

```html
    --border-strong:rgba(255,255,255,0.16);
    --ink:          #EDEEF1;
    --muted:        rgba(237,238,241,0.62);
    --dim:          rgba(237,238,241,0.42);
    --electric:     #00D4FF;          /* cyan agentic accent */
    --electric-dim: rgba(0,212,255,0.18);
    --moss-glow:    #00D49B;          /* PASS/verified green */
    --warning:      #FF5C35;          /* fail/alert */
    --signal:       #FFB446;          /* compliance flag amber */
    --grad-1:       #00D4FF;
    --grad-2:       #7B6CFF;
    --grad-3:       #FF5C9F;
    --sans:  'Geist', 'Inter', 'Söhne', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif;
    --mono:  'JetBrains Mono', 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace;
  }
  *,*:before,*:after { box-sizing: border-box; }
  html,body { margin:0; padding:0; background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); }
  body { font: 400 15px/1.55 var(--sans); -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale; }
  a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; }
  a:hover { color: var(--electric); }
  ::selection { background: var(--electric); color: var(--bg); }

  .container { max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 32px; }
  .eyebrow { font: 600 11px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--electric); }
  .display { font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.04; }
  .num { font: 500 32px/1 var(--mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink); }

  /* ===================== masthead ===================== */
  .masthead {
    position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50;
    background: rgba(10,11,13,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(140%);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .masthead-inner {
    max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px 32px;
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  }
  .wordmark { font: 600 18px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: none; }
  .wordmark .dot { color: var(--electric); }
  /* v0.10.0b: real nav links (replaces status pills). 5 sticky section anchors. */
  .masthead-nav { display: flex; gap: 18px; align-items: center; font: 500 11.5px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
  .masthead-nav a { color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.15s ease; }
  .masthead-nav a:hover { color: var(--electric); }
  .masthead-nav .sep { color: var(--dim); }
  @keyframes livePulse { 0%,100% { opacity:1 } 50% { opacity:0.4 } }

  /* ===================== HERO ===================== */
  .hero {
    position: relative; padding: 80px 0 96px; overflow: hidden;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .hero::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
    background:
      radial-gradient(60% 50% at 80% 20%, rgba(0,212,255,0.08), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(50% 40% at 10% 80%, rgba(123,108,255,0.07), transparent 60%);
  }
  .hero-grid { position: relative; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.2fr; gap: 56px; align-items: start; }
  .hero h1 {
    font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 56px; line-height: 1.02;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: var(--ink); margin: 18px 0 22px; max-width: 540px;
  }
  .hero h1 .grad {
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--grad-1), var(--grad-2) 50%, var(--grad-3));
    -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent;
  }
  .hero-sub { font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted); max-width: 480px; margin: 0 0 30px; }
  .hero-cta { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: stretch; max-width: 540px; }
  .hero-cta input[type="text"] {
    flex: 1; padding: 14px 16px;
    background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    border-radius: 6px;
    font: 400 13px/1.2 var(--mono); color: var(--ink);
    transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease;
  }
  .hero-cta input[type="text"]:focus {
    outline: none; border-color: var(--electric);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--electric-dim);
  }
  .hero-cta button {
    padding: 14px 24px; background: var(--electric); color: var(--bg);
    border: 0; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer;
    font: 600 12px/1 var(--mono); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    transition: filter 0.15s ease, transform 0.06s ease, box-shadow 0.4s ease;
    position: relative;
  }
  .hero-cta button:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.1); }
  .hero-cta button:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); }
  .hero-cta button:disabled { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--dim); cursor: not-allowed; }
  /* v0.10.0b / codex A6: soft pulse on the Verify button — telegraphs "click me"
     without the autoplay distraction. Animation halts after first click. */
  .hero-cta button.pulse:not(:disabled) {
    animation: ctaPulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .hero-cta button.pulse-stop, .hero-cta button:disabled { animation: none; }
  @keyframes ctaPulse {
    0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,212,255,0.55); }
    50%      { box-shadow: 0 0 0 8px rgba(0,212,255,0); }
  }

  /* v0.10.0b / codex A8: inline three-tier error element under URL input. */
  .hero-error {
    margin-top: 12px; padding: 12px 14px;
    background: rgba(255,92,53,0.08); border: 1px solid var(--warning);
    border-radius: 6px; max-width: 540px;
    font: 500 12px/1.55 var(--mono);
  }
  .hero-error[hidden] { display: none; }
  .hero-error .err-problem { color: var(--warning); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .hero-error .err-cause   { color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .hero-error .err-fix     { color: var(--ink); }
  .hero-error .err-fix::before { content: "→ "; color: var(--electric); font-weight: 700; }

  /* v0.10.0b / codex A7: honest footnote below CTA. "Top-risk" copy scrubbed. */
  .hero-footnote {
    margin-top: 14px; max-width: 540px;
    font: 500 11px/1.55 var(--mono); color: var(--dim);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .hero-footnote .ft-key { color: var(--electric); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.08em; }
  .hero-footnote a { color: var(--electric); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }

  .hero-pills {
    margin-top: 18px; display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap;
    font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .hero-pills .pill {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    color: var(--muted); padding: 5px 9px;
    background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px;
  }
  .hero-pills .pill::before { content: "✓"; color: var(--moss-glow); font-weight: 700; }

  /* 2026-05-25 (Omar Proposal 1, Stripe pattern) hero action row + brand drawer.
     Replaces the URL-input-as-primary pattern. The new primary is "Watch the demo"
     (gradient pill), the secondary is "Test your brand" which discloses the input. */
  .hero-actions {
    margin: 6px 0 0;
    display: flex; gap: 14px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center;
  }
  .hero-primary {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    padding: 14px 22px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--grad-1) 0%, var(--grad-2) 50%, var(--grad-3) 100%);
    color: #FFF;
    font: 600 14px/1 var(--sans);
    text-decoration: none;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(155,114,203,0.32);
    transition: transform 200ms cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), box-shadow 200ms, filter 200ms;
  }
  .hero-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: brightness(1.05); box-shadow: 0 16px 36px rgba(155,114,203,0.42); }
  .hero-primary .play {
    width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.20);
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 9.5px;
  }
  .hero-primary .arrow { transition: transform 200ms; font-weight: 700; }
  .hero-primary:hover .arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

  .hero-secondary {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
    padding: 13px 20px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    background: transparent;
    color: var(--ink);
    font: 500 13.5px/1 var(--sans);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: border-color 200ms, color 200ms, background 200ms;
  }
  .hero-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--electric); color: var(--electric); background: rgba(0,212,255,0.06); }
  .hero-secondary .arrow {
    font: 500 11px var(--mono);
    color: var(--muted);
    transition: transform 200ms, color 200ms;
  }
  .hero-secondary:hover .arrow { color: var(--electric); }
  .hero-secondary[aria-expanded="true"] .arrow { transform: rotate(180deg); color: var(--electric); }

  .brand-drawer {
    margin-top: 18px;
    max-width: 580px;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    border-radius: 10px;
    animation: brand-drawer-open 220ms cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1) both;
  }
  .brand-drawer[hidden] { display: none; }
  @keyframes brand-drawer-open {
    from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-6px); }
    to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  }
  .brand-drawer-label {
    margin: 0 0 10px;
    font: 500 12px/1.45 var(--mono);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    color: var(--muted);
  }

  /* Hero stack strip (2026-05-25). Sits below the hero grid, full-width,
     thin mono row of tech names. Carries the tech-judge legibility that the
     in-hero trust paragraph + pills used to (but now reads as proof, not
     noise). */
  .hero-stack {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;   /* span the full hero grid, not just the 1fr left column */
    margin-top: 56px;
    padding-top: 22px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .hero-stack .container {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; align-items: center; column-gap: 18px; row-gap: 12px;
  }
  .hero-stack .hs-label.hs-gcp { color: var(--electric); }
  @media (max-width: 760px) { .hero-stack .container { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .hero-stack .hs-label {
    font: 600 10px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--dim);
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .hero-stack .hs-chips {
    display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; width: 100%;
    justify-content: flex-start;
    font: 500 11.5px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    color: var(--muted);
  }
  .hero-stack .hs-chips span {
    padding: 5px 9px;
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px;
    transition: border-color 180ms, color 180ms;
  }
  .hero-stack .hs-chips span:hover { border-color: var(--electric); color: var(--electric); }

  /* v0.10.1c / codex A-codex-8: first-10s trust anchor above the URL input.
     Buyers (compliance / GC / CMO) need a "why should I trust this" cue
     before they commit to pasting a URL. Single line, mono, electric accent. */
  .hero-trust {
    margin: 18px 0 14px; max-width: 540px;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    background: rgba(0,212,255,0.05); border-left: 3px solid var(--electric);
    border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
    font: 500 12.5px/1.55 var(--sans); color: var(--muted);
  }
  .hero-trust strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }
  .hero-trust .icon { color: var(--electric); margin-right: 6px; font-weight: 700; }

  /* v0.10.1c / codex A-codex-7: mobile breakpoints moved to the
     RESPONSIVE section near end of file (was here, but cascaded before
     base .demo definitions and got overridden — codex C.combined P2 fix). */

  /* ===================== HERO SIGNED-BUNDLE SCHEMATIC (2026-05-25 Omar A-v2) =====
     Dark-theme stylized output card. Mirrors Stripe Connect's pattern of
     showing the product's OUTPUT (a signed credential), not a screenshot
     of its UI. The cinematic stays at /demo. Pure CSS/HTML — no images.
     The whole card is clickable and links to /demo. */
  .bundle-card {
    position: relative;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    background:
      radial-gradient(120% 80% at 0% 0%, rgba(99,108,255,0.10), transparent 50%),
      radial-gradient(120% 80% at 100% 100%, rgba(0,212,255,0.10), transparent 60%),
      var(--bg-elevated);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong);
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: inherit;
    padding: 22px 24px 18px;
    box-shadow: 0 32px 80px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),
                0 0 0 1px var(--border) inset;
    transition: transform 240ms cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1),
                box-shadow 240ms,
                border-color 240ms;
  }
  .bundle-card::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: 3px;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, #00D4FF 0%, #6c80ff 50%, #00D49B 100%);
    opacity: 0.85;
  }
  /* A-v3 (2026-05-25): bundle card is passive illustration, not a button.
     No hover lift — that signal would suggest it's clickable. */
  .bundle-card:hover {
    border-color: var(--border-strong);
  }

  /* ASK GEMINI · Path 2 · public Gemini-grounded chat widget (2026-05-25 night).
     Real Gemini 2.5 Flash call via /api/ask-gemini · grounded on PawConscious
     verified bundles. First public Google AI surface on the landing. */
  .askgem {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px;
  }
  .askgem-eyebrow {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    font: 700 11px/1 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--electric);
  }
  .askgem-icon {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    width: 18px; height: 18px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4285F4, #9B72CB, #E56C83);
    color: #FFF;
    border-radius: 4px;
    font: 700 10px/1 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
  }
  .askgem-subline {
    font: 500 12.5px/1.5 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
    color: var(--muted);
  }
  .askgem-chip-row {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px;
  }
  .askgem-chip {
    text-align: left;
    padding: 8px 12px;
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: var(--ink);
    font: 500 12.5px/1.35 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: border-color 180ms, background 180ms, transform 180ms;
  }
  .askgem-chip::before {
    content: "›  ";
    color: var(--electric);
    font: 700 12px var(--mono);
  }
  .askgem-chip:hover {
    border-color: var(--electric);
    background: rgba(0,212,255,0.04);
    transform: translateX(2px);
  }
  .askgem-input-row {
    display: flex; gap: 8px;
  }
  .askgem-input {
    flex: 1; min-width: 0;
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    border-radius: 8px;
    color: var(--ink);
    padding: 11px 13px;
    font: 500 13px 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
    transition: border-color 180ms, box-shadow 180ms;
  }
  .askgem-input:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: var(--electric);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,212,255,0.15);
  }
  .askgem-go {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
    padding: 11px 18px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4285F4, #9B72CB, #E56C83);
    color: #FFF;
    border: 0; border-radius: 8px;
    font: 600 13px 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
    cursor: pointer;
    box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(155,114,203,0.30);
    transition: transform 180ms, filter 180ms;
  }
  .askgem-go:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); transform: translateY(-1px); }
  .askgem-go:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: wait; transform: none; }

  .askgem-status[hidden] { display: none !important; }
  .askgem-status {
    padding: 9px 12px;
    background: rgba(0,212,255,0.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.30);
    border-radius: 6px;
    font: 500 11.5px/1.35 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    color: var(--electric);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .askgem-status[data-mode="error"] {
    background: rgba(255,138,77,0.06);
    border-color: #FF8A4D;
    color: #FF8A4D;
  }

  .askgem-answer[hidden] { display: none !important; }
  .askgem-answer {
    padding: 14px 16px;
    background: var(--bg-elevated);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    font: 400 13.5px/1.6 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
    color: var(--ink);
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    word-wrap: break-word;
  }
  .askgem-answer strong { font-weight: 700; color: var(--electric); }
  .askgem-answer p { margin: 0 0 10px; }
  .askgem-answer p:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }

  .askgem-meta[hidden] { display: none !important; }
  .askgem-meta {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    padding-top: 10px;
    border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
    font: 500 10.5px/1 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    color: var(--dim);
  }
  .askgem-meta .ag-meta-spacer { flex: 1; }
  .askgem-meta .ag-meta-link { color: var(--electric); text-decoration: none; }
  .askgem-meta .ag-meta-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

  .askgem-empty {
    padding: 22px 16px;
    background: var(--bg-elevated);
    border: 1px dashed var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .askgem-empty[hidden] { display: none !important; }
  .askgem-empty-icon {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    width: 28px; height: 28px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4285F4, #9B72CB, #E56C83);
    color: #FFF;
    border-radius: 6px;
    font: 700 14px/1 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }
  .askgem-empty-line {
    font: 500 13px/1.4 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
    color: var(--ink);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .askgem-empty-meta {
    font: 500 11px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    color: var(--muted);
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }

  /* PROOF section eyebrow · signals to brand-owners that what's below is
     the cryptographic trail (legal / AI-agent / transparency log facing). */
  .proof-eyebrow {
    font: 600 9.5px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    letter-spacing: 0.20em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--dim);
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .bundle-header {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  /* A-v4 (2026-05-25): plain-English subtitle so non-technical brand owners
     can parse the card without losing the PCEC v0.1 technical eyebrow that
     judges look for. Subtle moss accent on the front half. */
  .bundle-subtitle {
    font: 500 13px/1.45 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
    color: var(--ink);
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  .bundle-subtitle::before {
    content: "";
  }
  .bundle-mark {
    font: 700 11px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--electric);
  }
  .bundle-status {
    font: 700 10.5px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    letter-spacing: 0.18em;
    color: #00D49B;
    background: rgba(0,212,155,0.10);
    border: 1px solid rgba(0,212,155,0.30);
    padding: 4px 9px; border-radius: 4px;
  }

  .bundle-body[hidden] { display: none !important; }
  .bundle-body {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;
  }
  .bundle-row {
    display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 14px;
    font: 500 13px 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
  }
  .bundle-row .bk {
    flex-shrink: 0;
    width: 92px;
    font: 600 10px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--dim);
  }
  .bundle-row .bv {
    flex: 1;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .bundle-row .bv-strong { color: #00D49B; font-weight: 700; }
  .bundle-row .bv-hash {
    font: 500 11.5px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    color: var(--electric);
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    word-break: break-all;
  }
  .bundle-body--mono .bundle-row { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; }

  .bundle-divider {
    margin: 18px 0;
    border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
  }

  .bundle-foot {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
    margin-top: 20px;
    padding-top: 16px;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .bundle-foot .bf-stack {
    font: 500 11px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    color: var(--muted);
  }
  .bundle-foot .bf-spacer { flex: 1; }
  /* A-v3 (2026-05-25): bundle card became pure illustration. Footer carries
     a small "EXAMPLE · from a real verified brand" tag instead of a CTA. */
  .bundle-foot .bf-example {
    font: 500 10.5px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--dim);
  }
  .bundle-foot .bf-cta {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px;
    font: 600 13.5px 'Geist', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif;
    color: var(--ink);
    padding: 9px 14px;
    border-radius: 100px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(99,108,255,0.18) 0%, rgba(155,114,203,0.18) 50%, rgba(229,108,131,0.18) 100%);
    border: 1px solid rgba(155,114,203,0.32);
    transition: background 220ms, border-color 220ms, transform 220ms;
  }
  .bundle-card:hover .bf-cta {
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(99,108,255,0.32) 0%, rgba(155,114,203,0.32) 50%, rgba(229,108,131,0.32) 100%);
    border-color: rgba(155,114,203,0.55);
  }
  .bf-cta .play {
    width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #6c80ff 0%, #9b72cb 60%, #e56c83 100%);
    color: #FFF;
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 9.5px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .bf-cta .meta {
    font: 500 10.5px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    color: var(--muted);
    letter-spacing: 0.06em;
    padding-left: 8px;
    margin-left: 4px;
    border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
  }
  .bf-cta .arrow { transition: transform 220ms; color: var(--electric); font-weight: 700; }
  .bundle-card:hover .bf-cta .arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

  /* A (2026-05-25): live chain-head readout inside the bundle card. JS
     fetches /pcec/v0/chain/head on load and writes the real hash here. */
  .bundle-live {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap;
    margin-top: 14px;
    padding-top: 12px;
    border-top: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.08);
    font: 500 11px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .bundle-live .bl-dot {
    width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.20);
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: background 200ms, box-shadow 200ms;
  }
  .bundle-live .bl-label {
    color: var(--dim);
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    font-size: 9.5px;
  }
  .bundle-live .bl-hash {
    color: var(--muted);
    text-decoration: none;
    border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
    word-break: break-all;
    transition: color 200ms, border-color 200ms;
  }
  .bundle-live .bl-hash:hover { color: var(--electric); border-color: var(--electric); }
  .bundle-live .bl-age {
    margin-left: auto;
    color: var(--dim);
    font-size: 10px;
  }
  .bundle-live[data-status="ok"] .bl-dot {
    background: #00D49B;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,212,155,0.55);
    animation: bl-pulse 2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .bundle-live[data-status="ok"] .bl-hash { color: var(--electric); }
  .bundle-live[data-status="err"] .bl-dot { background: #FF8A4D; }
  .bundle-live[data-status="err"] .bl-hash { color: var(--dim); }
  @keyframes bl-pulse {
    0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,212,155,0.55); }
    50%      { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px rgba(0,212,155,0); }
  }

  /* B (2026-05-25): "Inspect the pipes" panel. Three one-click proofs
     beneath the bundle card. Two are open-in-new-tab links to real
     Google-stack endpoints; the third POSTs to the live A2A endpoint
     and displays the real task_id response inline. */
  .pipes-panel {
    margin-top: 18px;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    background: var(--bg-elevated);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
  }
  .pipes-panel .pp-eyebrow {
    font: 700 10px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    letter-spacing: 0.22em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--electric);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  .pipes-panel .pp-row {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px;
  }
  .pipes-panel .pp-btn {
    display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 5px;
    padding: 11px 13px;
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    border-radius: 8px;
    text-decoration: none; color: inherit;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-align: left;
    transition: border-color 180ms, background 180ms, transform 180ms;
    position: relative;
  }
  .pipes-panel .pp-btn:hover {
    border-color: var(--electric);
    background: rgba(0,212,255,0.04);
    transform: translateY(-1px);
  }
  .pipes-panel .pp-mono {
    font: 600 10.5px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    color: var(--electric);
    word-break: break-all;
  }
  .pipes-panel .pp-label {
    font: 500 11px var(--sans);
    color: var(--muted);
  }
  .pipes-panel .pp-arrow {
    position: absolute; top: 11px; right: 13px;
    font: 700 12px 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    color: var(--dim);
    transition: transform 180ms, color 180ms;
  }
  .pipes-panel .pp-btn:hover .pp-arrow { color: var(--electric); transform: translate(2px, -2px); }
  .pipes-panel .pp-btn-run { font-family: inherit; }
  .pipes-panel .pp-btn-run.running { border-color: var(--electric); background: rgba(0,212,255,0.06); cursor: wait; }
  .pipes-panel .pp-btn-run.running .pp-arrow { animation: bl-pulse 1s ease-in-out infinite; }
  .pipes-panel .pp-output {
    margin-top: 12px; padding: 12px 14px;
    background: #07080B;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    font: 500 11px/1.55 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
    color: #C8D4E0;
    overflow-x: auto;
    white-space: pre-wrap; word-break: break-all;
  }
  .pipes-panel .pp-output .out-key { color: var(--electric); }
  .pipes-panel .pp-output .out-str { color: #6FAE7A; }
  .pipes-panel .pp-output a { color: var(--electric); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px dashed currentColor; }
  @media (max-width: 800px) {
    .pipes-panel .pp-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }

  /* ===================== DEMO CONTAINER (unified — cached/live/replay) =====================
     v0.10.0a (commit 1 of hero rebuild) — FIXED-HEIGHT 520px container.
     Codex amendment A4: mode distinction = badge color + ●/▶ icon + outer border color.
     Codex amendment A5: SVG geometry locked here BEFORE rewiring JS in v0.10.0b.
     ============================================================================ */
  .demo {
    position: relative; background: var(--bg-elevated);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 8px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 32px 80px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 1px var(--border) inset;
    /* v0.10.3 ISSUE 2 (Omar feedback): no state-machine resize. Container is
       fixed 600px ALWAYS. Stream is fixed 180px ALWAYS. The cert is no
       longer inside the container at all — it renders into the separate
       full-width <section class="result-report"> below the hero (ISSUE 1). */
    height: 600px; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    transition: border-color 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
  }
  /* A4: outer border colour swaps with mode — peripherally visible even if badge below fold */
  .demo[data-mode="ready"]   { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
  .demo[data-mode="auto"]    { border-color: rgba(0,212,255,0.35); }
  .demo[data-mode="live"]    { border-color: var(--warning); }
  .demo[data-mode="replay"]  { border-color: #B9AEFF; }
  .demo[data-mode="done"]    { border-color: var(--moss-glow); }

  /* v0.10.1c — Phase C perimeter glow narrative per active stage.
     data-stage overrides border-color during stage transitions; the
     pulse animation runs continuously while a stage is "active". */
  .demo[data-stage="stage1"] {
    border-color: var(--electric);
    animation: stage1Pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .demo[data-stage="stage2"] {
    border-color: var(--moss-glow);
    animation: stage2Flash 3s ease-in-out 1;
  }
  .demo[data-stage="stage3"] {
    border-color: #B9AEFF;
    animation: stage3Pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .demo[data-stage="done-pass"] {
    border-color: var(--moss-glow);
    animation: none;
    box-shadow: 0 0 24px -4px rgba(0,212,155,0.35),
                0 32px 80px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),
                0 0 0 1px var(--border) inset;
  }
  .demo[data-stage="done-fail"] {
    border-color: var(--warning);
    animation: none;
    box-shadow: 0 0 24px -4px rgba(255,92,53,0.35),
                0 32px 80px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5),
                0 0 0 1px var(--border) inset;
  }
  @keyframes stage1Pulse {
    0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,212,255,0), 0 32px 80px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 1px var(--border) inset; }
    50%      { box-shadow: 0 0 24px 0 rgba(0,212,255,0.55), 0 32px 80px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 1px var(--border) inset; }
  }
  @keyframes stage2Flash {
    0%       { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,212,155,0); border-color: var(--border-strong); }
    20%      { box-shadow: 0 0 36px 4px rgba(0,212,155,0.85); border-color: var(--moss-glow); }
    50%      { box-shadow: 0 0 24px 2px rgba(0,212,155,0.55); border-color: var(--moss-glow); }
    100%     { box-shadow: 0 0 12px 0 rgba(0,212,155,0.3); border-color: var(--moss-glow); }
  }
  @keyframes stage3Pulse {
    0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(123,108,255,0), 0 32px 80px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 1px var(--border) inset; }
    50%      { box-shadow: 0 0 24px 0 rgba(123,108,255,0.55), 0 32px 80px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5), 0 0 0 1px var(--border) inset; }
  }

  .demo-chrome {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center;
    padding: 9px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--surface);
    font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .demo-chrome .dots { display: inline-flex; gap: 6px; }
  .demo-chrome .dot { width: 9px; height: 9px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--surface-2); }
  .demo-chrome .dot.r { background: #FF5C5C; }
  .demo-chrome .dot.y { background: #FFBD2E; }
  .demo-chrome .dot.g { background: #27C93F; }
  .demo-chrome .mode {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
    color: var(--muted); min-width: 0;
  }
  .demo-chrome .mode .badge {
    padding: 3px 9px; background: var(--electric-dim); color: var(--electric);
    border-radius: 3px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  /* A4: shape signal in addition to color — ● for live, ▶ for cached, ◌ for auto */
  .demo-chrome .mode .badge::before { content: "◌"; font-size: 11px; }
  .demo-chrome .mode .badge.live { background: rgba(255,92,53,0.18); color: var(--warning); }
  .demo-chrome .mode .badge.live::before { content: "●"; }
  .demo-chrome .mode .badge.replay { background: rgba(123,108,255,0.22); color: #B9AEFF; }
  .demo-chrome .mode .badge.replay::before { content: "▶"; }
  .demo-chrome .mode-text { color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .demo-chrome .right { color: var(--dim); white-space: nowrap; }

  /* A3: coverage line — second row inside chrome. Two columns:
       left = state (dot + text), right = "Replay cached demo" button.
       Pre-run shows readiness; live mode swaps to poll status;
       post-run shows claim coverage. Wired by setCoverage() in JS. */
  .demo-coverage {
    padding: 7px 12px 7px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: var(--bg);
    font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--muted); flex-shrink: 0;
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; gap: 12px; align-items: center;
  }
  /* v0.10.0b codex review fix: ellipsis must live on the inline span, not
     the flex container — flex children render text-overflow correctly only
     when the SPAN itself sets white-space/overflow/text-overflow AND has a
     bounded width (parent min-width:0 enables shrinking below content size). */
  .demo-coverage .cov-left { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
  .demo-coverage .cov-left #demoCoverageText {
    min-width: 0; flex: 1;
    overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .demo-coverage .dot-marker {
    display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0;
    background: var(--electric); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--electric);
    animation: livePulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .demo-coverage.live .dot-marker { background: var(--warning); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--warning); }
  .demo-coverage.completed .dot-marker { background: var(--moss-glow); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--moss-glow); animation: none; }
  .demo-coverage.error .dot-marker { background: var(--warning); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--warning); animation: none; }
  /* Replay button — secondary CTA visually scoped to the cached cycle. */
  .demo-coverage .cov-replay {
    padding: 6px 12px; background: transparent; color: #B9AEFF;
    border: 1px solid rgba(123,108,255,0.4); border-radius: 4px;
    font: 600 9.5px/1 var(--mono); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em;
    cursor: pointer; flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease;
  }
  .demo-coverage .cov-replay:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(123,108,255,0.12); border-color: #B9AEFF; }
  .demo-coverage .cov-replay:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

  .demo-body { padding: 16px 22px 20px; flex: 1; min-height: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; overflow: hidden; }
  /* v0.10.1c: diagram grows 220 → 260 inside the taller container, more readable.
     Stage cinema cards float over the SVG via absolute positioning. */
  .demo-stage { flex-shrink: 0; height: 260px; position: relative; }
  .demo-svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }

  /* Stage cinema cards — codex A-codex-3 trimmed: ≤3 lines each, sequential
     show/hide (never two visible at once), positioned in diagram corners. */
  .stage-card {
    position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px;
    min-width: 220px; max-width: 280px;
    padding: 10px 12px;
    background: rgba(22,24,29,0.92);
    border: 1px solid var(--electric); border-radius: 6px;
    font: 500 11px/1.45 var(--mono);
    color: var(--ink); letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    opacity: 0; pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.35s ease, transform 0.35s ease;
    transform: translateX(8px);
    z-index: 4;
    backdrop-filter: blur(4px);
  }
  .stage-card[data-card="stage2"] {
    top: 50%; left: 50%; right: auto;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(0.95);
    border-color: var(--moss-glow);
    min-width: 280px;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .stage-card[data-card="stage3"] {
    top: 8px; left: 8px; right: auto;
    border-color: #B9AEFF;
    transform: translateX(-8px);
  }
  .stage-card.show { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; transform: translateX(0); }
  .stage-card[data-card="stage2"].show { transform: translate(-50%, -50%) scale(1); }
  .stage-card .sc-header {
    font-size: 9.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.22em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--electric);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .stage-card[data-card="stage2"] .sc-header { color: var(--moss-glow); }
  .stage-card[data-card="stage3"] .sc-header { color: #B9AEFF; }
  .stage-card .sc-body { color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .stage-card .sc-tail { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; font-size: 10.5px; }

  /* Stage groups (subtle dashed cyan bounds — mirror /architecture canonical) */
  .demo-svg .stage-bg {
    fill: rgba(0,212,255,0.018);
    stroke: rgba(0,212,255,0.22);
    stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 4 4;
    rx: 8;
  }
  .demo-svg .stage-label {
    font: 700 8.5px/1 var(--mono); fill: var(--electric);
    text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  }
  .demo-svg .stage-sub {
    font: 500 8px/1 var(--mono); fill: var(--dim);
    text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  }

  /* Edges + animation classes preserved from the radial version so existing JS still drives them */
  .demo-svg .edge { stroke: var(--border-strong); stroke-width: 1.4; fill: none; transition: stroke 0.4s ease, stroke-width 0.4s ease; }
  /* v0.10.2 Phase G: marching-ants flow on active edges — data flowing visualization */
  .demo-svg .edge.active {
    stroke: var(--electric); stroke-width: 1.8;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px var(--electric));
    stroke-dasharray: 4 6;
    animation: edgeFlow 1.2s linear infinite;
  }
  .demo-svg .edge.done { stroke: var(--moss-glow); stroke-width: 1.6; }
  @keyframes edgeFlow { to { stroke-dashoffset: -20; } }

  /* Agent chips — numbered circles (codex A1 decision). Labels below, truncate if needed. */
  .demo-svg .node circle.body {
    fill: var(--surface); stroke: var(--border-strong); stroke-width: 1.5;
    transition: fill 0.4s ease, stroke 0.4s ease;
  }
  .demo-svg .node.active circle.body { fill: var(--electric); stroke: var(--electric); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px var(--electric)); }
  .demo-svg .node.done circle.body { fill: var(--moss-glow); stroke: var(--moss-glow); }
  /* v0.10.0b / codex A6: hover-preview — Verify button hover flashes chips in sequence
     as a 0.8s "this is what's about to happen" cue, without committing to autoplay. */
  .demo-svg .node.preview-on circle.body { fill: var(--electric-dim); stroke: var(--electric); }
  .demo-svg .node.preview-on circle.halo { stroke-width: 1.5; opacity: 0.5; }
  .demo-svg .node circle.halo {
    fill: none; stroke: var(--electric); stroke-width: 0; opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
  }
  .demo-svg .node.active circle.halo {
    stroke-width: 2; opacity: 0.8;
    animation: haloPulse 1.2s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  /* v0.10.3 ISSUE 3: work-pulse — a dashed ring overlaid on the active chip
     with the dashes "marching" around the circumference via stroke-dashoffset.
     No transform (avoids SVG transform-origin viewBox bugs). Says "this agent
     is THINKING NOW", distinct from the ambient halo. */
  .demo-svg .node circle.work-pulse {
    fill: none; stroke: var(--electric);
    stroke-width: 1.6;
    stroke-dasharray: 5 6;
    stroke-dashoffset: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
  }
  .demo-svg .node.active circle.work-pulse {
    opacity: 0.85;
    animation: workMarch 1.4s linear infinite;
  }
  .demo-svg .node.done circle.work-pulse { opacity: 0; }
  @keyframes workMarch {
    to { stroke-dashoffset: -22; }
  }
  @keyframes haloPulse {
    0%,100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 0.8; }
    50% { transform: scale(1.35); opacity: 0.1; }
  }
  .demo-svg .node text.num {
    font: 700 9px/1 var(--mono); fill: var(--ink);
    text-anchor: middle; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .demo-svg .node.active text.num { fill: var(--bg); }
  .demo-svg .node.done text.num { fill: var(--bg); }
  .demo-svg .node text.label {
    font: 600 7.5px/1 var(--mono); fill: var(--muted);
    text-anchor: middle; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  }
  .demo-svg .node.active text.label { fill: var(--electric); }
  /* v0.10.2 Phase G: pulse-link — when a stream row is hovered, the matching
     chip briefly flashes electric to confirm "this log came from THAT agent". */
  .demo-svg .node.pulse-link circle.body {
    fill: var(--electric); stroke: var(--electric);
    filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px var(--electric));
    animation: chipPulseLink 0.18s ease-out;
  }
  @keyframes chipPulseLink {
    0% { transform: scale(1); }
    50% { transform: scale(1.18); }
    100% { transform: scale(1); }
  }
  /* v0.10.3 ISSUE 3: SONAR RING expansion from SIGN anchor at the moment of
     signature. Replaces the v0.10.2 particle burst. Two concentric rings
     expand outward over 1.6s — single coherent visual event, reads at any
     viewport size, no overflow leak. Triggered via JS adding .fire class. */
  .demo-svg .sonar-ring {
    fill: none;
    stroke: var(--moss-glow);
    stroke-width: 2;
    transform-origin: center;
    transform-box: fill-box;
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .demo-svg .sonar-ring.fire {
    animation: sonarExpand 1.6s cubic-bezier(.22,.7,.34,1) forwards;
  }
  /* v0.10.3 codex-1: use transform: scale() instead of animating the `r`
     attribute via CSS — Safari support for CSS-animated SVG `r` shipped
     in 16+ but is still inconsistent. Scale is universally supported. */
  @keyframes sonarExpand {
    0%   { transform: scale(1);   opacity: 0.95; stroke-width: 2.4; }
    100% { transform: scale(6.1); opacity: 0;    stroke-width: 0.4; }
  }
  /* v0.10.3 ISSUE 3: stage radial-glow backgrounds that fade in during the
     active stage. Reinforces the perimeter pulse + cinema card without competing. */
  .demo-svg .stage-glow {
    pointer-events: none;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.5s ease;
  }
  .demo[data-stage="stage1"] .demo-svg .stage-glow.s1,
  .demo[data-stage="stage2"] .demo-svg .stage-glow.s2,
  .demo[data-stage="stage3"] .demo-svg .stage-glow.s3 {
    opacity: 1;
    animation: stageGlowBreathe 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes stageGlowBreathe {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 0.85; }
    50%      { opacity: 0.55; }
  }
  .demo-svg .node.done text.label { fill: var(--moss-glow); }

  /* Sign anchor — special Stage 2 trust event, moss-green when done */
  .demo-svg .anchor-body { fill: var(--surface-2); stroke: var(--border-strong); stroke-width: 1.5; }
  .demo-svg .anchor-body.done { fill: var(--moss-glow); stroke: var(--moss-glow); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(0,212,155,0.4)); }
  .demo-svg .anchor-label { font: 700 9px/1 var(--mono); fill: var(--ink); text-anchor: middle; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; }
  .demo-svg .anchor-body.done + .anchor-label { fill: var(--bg); }
  .demo-svg .anchor-sub { font: 500 7px/1 var(--mono); fill: var(--electric); text-anchor: middle; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.18em; }

  /* v0.10.3 ISSUE 2: stream is fixed at 180px ALWAYS. No state-machine resize.
     Long lines wrap, overflow scrolls internally. Always-prominent surface. */
  .demo-stream {
    background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px 12px;
    font: 500 10.5px/1.55 var(--mono); color: var(--muted);
    height: 180px; overflow-y: auto; flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .demo-stream .row {
    display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline;
    padding: 2px 4px 2px 8px;
    margin: 0 0 1px 0;
    /* v0.10.2 A-codex-3: 4px colored left bar keyed to agent/stage
       instead of per-row chip badge (less visual clutter). Default is
       border-strong; per-agent selectors below override. */
    border-left: 4px solid var(--border-strong);
    cursor: default;
    transition: background 0.15s ease;
  }
  .demo-stream .row[data-agent="extract"],
  .demo-stream .row[data-agent="evidence"],
  .demo-stream .row[data-agent="rubric"],
  .demo-stream .row[data-agent="compliance"],
  .demo-stream .row[data-agent="auditor"] {
    border-left-color: var(--electric);
    background: rgba(0,212,255,0.045);
  }
  .demo-stream .row[data-agent="sign"] {
    border-left-color: var(--moss-glow);
    background: rgba(0,212,155,0.06);
  }
  .demo-stream .row[data-agent="composer"],
  .demo-stream .row[data-agent="opinion"] {
    border-left-color: #B9AEFF;
    background: rgba(123,108,255,0.06);
  }
  .demo-stream .row:hover { background: rgba(0,212,255,0.1); }
  .demo-stream .row .ts { color: var(--dim); flex-shrink: 0; min-width: 56px; }
  .demo-stream .row .msg {
    color: var(--ink);
    word-break: break-word; overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  }
  .demo-stream .row .msg.ok { color: var(--moss-glow); }
  .demo-stream .row .msg.err { color: var(--warning); }
  .demo-stream .row .msg.dim { color: var(--muted); }
  .demo-stream .caret { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 13px; background: var(--electric); animation: blink 1s steps(1) infinite; vertical-align: -2px; margin-left: 2px; }
  @keyframes blink { 50% { opacity: 0; } }

  .demo-cert {
    background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--electric); border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 0 14px;
    font: 500 11px/1.7 var(--mono); color: var(--ink);
    opacity: 0; max-height: 0; overflow: hidden; flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: opacity 0.35s ease, max-height 0.35s ease, padding 0.35s ease;
  }
  /* v0.10.3 ISSUE 1: demoCert inside the container is now ALWAYS hidden.
     Cert renders into the separate full-width <section class="result-report">
     below the hero. We keep the in-container element + .visible class as a
     no-op fallback so existing JS doesn't break, but display: none guarantees
     it never shows. */
  .demo-cert { display: none !important; }
  .demo-cert.visible { display: none !important; }
  /* v0.10.1c: verdict + per-claim block get visual prominence inside the cert pane */
  .demo-cert.visible .cert-headline,
  .demo-cert.visible h3 { font-size: 0.95rem !important; line-height: 1.3 !important; margin-bottom: 8px !important; }
  .demo-cert.visible::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; }
  .demo-cert.visible::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg); }
  .demo-cert.visible::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--electric-dim); border-radius: 4px; }
  .demo-cert .line { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; word-break: break-all; }
  .demo-cert .line .k { color: var(--electric); }
  .demo-cert .line .v.pass { color: var(--moss-glow); font-weight: 700; }
  /* v0.10.2 H.toggle: forward-compatible bundle link, routed today to the
     existing /pcec/v0/claim/{urn} JSON endpoint. v0.11.0 swaps target to
     /cert/{urn} HTML PDF page (codex A-codex-6 stable URL scheme). */
  .demo-cert .cert-bundle-link {
    margin-top: 10px; padding-top: 10px;
    border-top: 1px dashed var(--border-strong);
    font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--mono);
    letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase;
  }
  .demo-cert .cert-bundle-link a {
    color: var(--electric); text-decoration: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
  }
  .demo-cert .cert-bundle-link a:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--electric); }

  /* ===================== RESULT REPORT (v0.10.3 ISSUE 1) =====================
     The cert / signed-report section lives BELOW the hero as an independent
     full-width surface. When a cycle completes, showResultReport() unhides
     this and the user sees the certificate read like a real report. */
  .result-report {
    padding: 80px 0 96px;
    background:
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 0%, rgba(0,212,255,0.05), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 100%, rgba(123,108,255,0.04), transparent 60%),
      var(--bg);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .result-report[hidden] { display: none; }
  .result-report .container { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 32px; }
  .result-report .eyebrow {
    color: var(--electric); font: 600 11px/1 var(--mono);
    letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }
  .result-report .result-title {
    font: 600 28px/1.2 var(--sans); color: var(--ink);
    margin: 0 0 18px 0; letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  }
  .result-report .result-meta {
    display: flex; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center; margin-bottom: 36px;
    font: 500 11.5px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .result-report .meta-pill {
    padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    border-radius: 4px; color: var(--muted);
    word-break: break-all;
  }
  .result-report .meta-link {
    color: var(--electric); text-decoration: none;
    border-bottom: 1px solid transparent;
    padding-bottom: 2px;
    text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
  }
  .result-report .meta-link:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--electric); }
  .result-report .result-body {
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 36px 44px;
    color: var(--ink);
    font: 500 14.5px/1.65 var(--sans);
    box-shadow: 0 16px 48px -16px rgba(0,0,0,0.4),
                0 0 0 1px var(--border) inset;
  }
  /* The Agent 6 cert is full HTML with its own inline styles and class hooks.
     We override font-sizes inside the result-body for readability at this
     prominence (cert composed for the inline panel was tuned for 11px mono).  */
  .result-report .result-body .cert-headline,
  .result-report .result-body h3 {
    font: 700 22px/1.3 var(--sans) !important;
    color: var(--ink) !important;
    margin: 0 0 18px 0 !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.005em !important;
  }
  .result-report .result-body p { font-size: 15px !important; line-height: 1.65 !important; }
  .result-report .result-body ol,
  .result-report .result-body ul { font-size: 14.5px !important; line-height: 1.7 !important; }
  .result-report .result-body details { font-size: 13px; }
  .result-report .result-body summary { cursor: pointer; color: var(--electric); }
  .result-report .result-second-opinion {
    margin-top: 32px;
    background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid #B9AEFF;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 28px 36px;
    color: var(--ink);
  }
  .result-report .result-second-opinion[hidden] { display: none; }

  /* ===================== ARCHITECTURE (interactive technical SVG) ===================== */
  .arch { padding: 96px 0; background: var(--bg-elevated); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .arch-head { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 auto 48px; text-align: center; }
  .arch-head h2 { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.1; margin: 12px 0; color: var(--ink); }
  .arch-head p { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--muted); margin: 0; }
  .arch-canvas {
    position: relative; background: var(--bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 32px; overflow: hidden;
  }
  .arch-canvas::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; pointer-events: none;
    background-image: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(255,255,255,0.025) 1px, transparent 1px);
    background-size: 24px 24px;
  }
  .arch-svg { position: relative; width: 100%; height: auto; min-height: 560px; display: block; }
  .arch-svg .edge { stroke: var(--border-strong); stroke-width: 1.2; fill: none; transition: stroke 0.3s ease; }
  .arch-svg .edge.dim { stroke: var(--border); stroke-width: 1; }
  .arch-svg .edge.flow { stroke: var(--electric); stroke-width: 1.4; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(0,212,255,0.4)); }
  .arch-svg .edge.hi { stroke: var(--electric); stroke-width: 2; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 4px var(--electric)); }
  .arch-svg g.box rect { fill: var(--surface); stroke: var(--border-strong); stroke-width: 1.4; transition: stroke 0.2s ease, fill 0.2s ease; rx: 6; }
  .arch-svg g.box.agent rect { stroke: var(--electric-dim); }
  .arch-svg g.box.signing rect { fill: var(--surface-2); stroke: var(--moss-glow); stroke-width: 1.6; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(0,212,155,0.18)); }
  .arch-svg g.box:hover rect { stroke: var(--electric); fill: var(--surface-2); cursor: pointer; }
  .arch-svg g.box.signing:hover rect { stroke: var(--moss-glow); }
  .arch-svg g.box .label { font: 600 10px/1 var(--mono); fill: var(--electric); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.16em; }
  .arch-svg g.box.signing .label { fill: var(--moss-glow); }
  .arch-svg g.box .title { font: 600 13px/1.2 var(--sans); fill: var(--ink); letter-spacing: -0.005em; }
  .arch-svg g.box .meta { font: 500 10px/1.4 var(--mono); fill: var(--muted); }
  .arch-svg g.box .meta.warn { fill: var(--signal); }
  .arch-svg g.stage rect { fill: rgba(0,212,255,0.018); stroke: rgba(0,212,255,0.18); stroke-width: 1; stroke-dasharray: 4 4; rx: 10; }
  .arch-svg .stage-label { font: 700 10px/1 var(--mono); fill: var(--electric); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.22em; }
  .arch-svg .stage-sub { font: 500 10px/1 var(--mono); fill: var(--dim); letter-spacing: 0.06em; }
  .arch-svg .io-label { font: 500 10px/1 var(--mono); fill: var(--muted); letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .arch-svg .io-meta { font: 500 10px/1.4 var(--mono); fill: var(--dim); }
  .arch-svg .a2a-label { font: 700 9.5px/1 var(--mono); fill: var(--electric); letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; }

  .arch-tooltip {
    position: absolute; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0;
    padding: 12px 14px; background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--electric);
    border-radius: 4px; font: 500 11px/1.5 var(--mono); color: var(--ink);
    transition: opacity 0.15s ease; max-width: 280px; z-index: 10;
    box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
  }
  .arch-tooltip.show { opacity: 1; }
  .arch-tooltip .t-name { font: 700 11.5px/1.2 var(--mono); color: var(--electric); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .arch-tooltip .t-meta { color: var(--muted); }
  .arch-tooltip .t-meta b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }

  .arch-legend {
    margin-top: 24px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 18px;
  }
  .arch-legend .item {
    padding: 16px 18px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 4px;
  }
  .arch-legend .item .h { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .arch-legend .item .h .name { font: 600 12px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink); }
  .arch-legend .item .h .badge { font: 500 9px/1 var(--mono); padding: 3px 7px; background: var(--electric-dim); color: var(--electric); border-radius: 3px; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; }
  .arch-legend .item p { margin: 0; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--muted); }

  /* ===================== HOW (3 numbered steps) ===================== */
  .how { padding: 88px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .how-head { max-width: 720px; margin: 0 0 56px; }
  .how-head h2 { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.1; margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--ink); }
  .how-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 36px; }
  .how-step { padding: 24px; background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; }
  .how-step .n { font: 600 11px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--electric); margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .how-step .title { font: 600 18px/1.25 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .how-step .desc { font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--muted); margin: 0; }
  .how-step .code {
    margin-top: 16px; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--bg);
    border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 4px;
    font: 500 11px/1.6 var(--mono); color: var(--electric); white-space: pre-wrap;
  }

  /* ===================== PROOF (signed cert artifact) ===================== */
  .proof { padding: 88px 0; background: var(--bg-elevated); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .proof-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 0.9fr 1.1fr; gap: 56px; align-items: center; }
  .proof-text h2 { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.1; margin: 12px 0 18px; color: var(--ink); }
  .proof-text p { font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 16px; max-width: 440px; }
  .proof-text .chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin-top: 22px; }
  .proof-text .chip {
    font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 7px 10px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); color: var(--muted); border-radius: 4px;
  }
  .proof-cert {
    background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 28px; position: relative;
    font: 500 12px/1.75 var(--mono); color: var(--ink);
  }
  .proof-cert::before {
    content: "PCEC v0.1 · signed bundle"; position: absolute; top: 14px; left: 28px;
    font: 600 10px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--electric);
  }
  .proof-cert .body { margin-top: 28px; }
  .proof-cert .json-k { color: var(--electric); opacity: 0.9; }
  .proof-cert .json-s { color: var(--moss-glow); }
  .proof-cert .json-p { color: var(--moss-glow); font-weight: 700; }

  /* ===================== BUSINESS CASE ===================== */
  .biz { padding: 88px 0 64px; }
  /* 2026-05-24 taste pass: drop biz section border so biz + becomes read as one continuous arc. */
  /* USE CASES beat — three scenarios + proof stats. Replaces the old buyer-card
     matrix that read as deck content rather than product copy. */
  .usecases { margin: 80px 0; padding-top: 16px; }
  .usecases-head { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 0 52px; }
  .usecases-head .eyebrow { color: var(--electric); }
  .usecases-head h2 { font-size: 38px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 1.08; margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--ink); font-family: var(--sans); }
  .usecases-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 36px; margin-bottom: 36px; }
  /* Each cell becomes a stage with an oversized background numeral (Gemini in-brand:
     12rem mono numeral at 0.05 opacity, brightens to 0.10 on hover). Body content
     sits on top — clean editorial hierarchy without breaking the dark slate brand. */
  .usecase { position: relative; padding: 28px 24px 24px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); overflow: hidden; transition: border-color .25s; }
  .usecase:hover { border-top-color: var(--electric); }
  .usecase::before { content: attr(data-num); position: absolute; top: -28px; right: -8px; font: 700 12rem/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: -0.05em; color: var(--electric); opacity: 0.05; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity .35s, transform .35s; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .usecase:hover::before { opacity: 0.12; transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .usecase > * { position: relative; z-index: 1; }
  .usecase-num { font: 700 11px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--electric); margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .usecase-trigger { font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.012em; color: var(--ink); margin: 0 0 14px; }
  /* The trigger keyword gets a 1px cyan underline that thickens on hover —
     subtle editorial accent inside the brand. */
  .usecase-trigger .kw { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--electric); padding-bottom: 1px; transition: border-bottom-width .25s, padding-bottom .25s; }
  .usecase:hover .usecase-trigger .kw { border-bottom-width: 3px; padding-bottom: 0; }
  .usecase-body { font-size: 14.5px; line-height: 1.62; color: var(--muted); margin: 0; }
  /* Centered single-number cost band. No PawConscious pricing here. */
  .usecase-proof {
    padding: 44px 32px;
    background: var(--bg-elevated);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    text-align: center;
    max-width: 760px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }
  .usecase-proof-head { margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .usecase-proof-head .eyebrow { color: var(--electric); }
  .usecase-proof-num {
    font: 600 56px/1 var(--mono);
    color: var(--electric);
    letter-spacing: -0.025em;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    margin: 0 0 18px;
  }
  .usecase-proof-line {
    font: 400 14px/1.55 var(--sans);
    color: var(--muted);
    margin: 0 auto;
    max-width: 560px;
  }
  .usecase-proof-line a { color: var(--electric); }
  @media (max-width: 640px) {
    .usecase-proof-num { font-size: 40px; }
  }
  /* ===================== PRICING (2026-05-24 v3: taste pass · Stripe-grade discipline) =====================
     Cuts from v2: status chips, per-card overage, inline roadmap tags, translateY lift,
     glow shadow, band logos, band h4+p, sub-paragraph under tiers-head. */
  .tiers-head { max-width: 880px; margin: 48px 0 32px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: end; gap: 24px; }
  .tiers-head-text .eyebrow { color: var(--electric); }
  .tiers-head-text h2 { font-family: var(--sans); font-weight: 600; font-size: 36px; line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--ink); margin: 12px 0 0; }

  .billing-toggle {
    display: inline-flex; background: var(--surface);
    border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px;
    font: 500 11.5px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  }
  .billing-toggle button {
    background: transparent; border: 0; cursor: pointer;
    color: var(--muted); padding: 9px 14px; border-radius: 5px;
    font: inherit; letter-spacing: inherit; transition: all 0.18s ease;
  }
  .billing-toggle button.active { background: var(--bg-elevated); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: 0 1px 0 var(--border-strong); }
  .billing-toggle button:hover:not(.active) { color: var(--ink); }
  .billing-toggle .save { font-size: 9.5px; color: var(--moss-glow); margin-left: 5px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; }

  .biz-tiers { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px; margin: 8px auto 0; padding-top: 16px; max-width: 1080px; }
  .biz-tier {
    position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    background: var(--bg-elevated); border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px; padding: 32px 26px 26px;
    transition: border-color 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.18s ease;
  }
  .biz-tier:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
  .biz-tier.featured {
    border-color: rgba(0,212,255,0.55);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,212,255,0.18), 0 24px 60px -20px rgba(0,212,255,0.18);
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,212,255,0.04), transparent 60%), var(--bg-elevated);
  }
  .biz-tier.featured::before {
    content: "Most popular"; position: absolute;
    top: -14px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
    font: 700 11px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--bg); background: var(--electric);
    padding: 7px 14px; border-radius: 5px; white-space: nowrap;
    box-shadow: 0 6px 20px -4px rgba(0,212,255,0.4);
  }
  .biz-tier .tn { font: 600 16px/1.2 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.005em; text-transform: none; color: var(--ink); margin: 0 0 6px; }
  .tier-job { font: 400 13px/1.45 var(--sans); color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 26px; min-height: 38px; }
  .biz-tier .tp {
    font: 600 42px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--ink);
    margin: 0 0 6px; font-feature-settings: "tnum";
    display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 4px;
  }
  .biz-tier .tp .u { font: 500 12px/1 var(--mono); color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: 0.02em; }
  .tier-cta {
    display: block; width: 100%; padding: 12px 14px;
    margin: 20px 0 22px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border-strong);
    background: transparent; color: var(--ink);
    font: 500 12.5px/1 var(--sans);
    text-align: center; text-decoration: none;
    border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s ease;
  }
  .tier-cta:hover { border-color: var(--electric); color: var(--electric); }
  .biz-tier.featured .tier-cta {
    background: var(--electric); color: var(--bg);
    border-color: var(--electric); font-weight: 600;
  }
  .biz-tier.featured .tier-cta:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); color: var(--bg); }
  .tier-features {
    list-style: none; padding: 20px 0 0; margin: 0;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--muted);
  }
  .tier-features li { position: relative; padding-left: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .tier-features li:last-child { margin-bottom: 0; }
  .tier-features li::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 5px;
    width: 13px; height: 13px;
    background-image: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 13 13' fill='none' stroke='%2300D4FF' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M2.5 6.5 L5.5 9.5 L10.5 3.5'/></svg>");
    background-size: contain; background-repeat: no-repeat;
  }

  .tiers-footnote {
    text-align: center;
    font: 500 11.5px/1.4 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    color: var(--dim); margin: 22px 0 0;
  }
  .tiers-footnote b { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 600; }

  /* Two side-by-side pricing alternative cards (enterprise + agents).
     Replaces the previous horizontal one-line bands. */
  .pricing-bands {
    display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px;
    margin-top: 32px;
  }
  .pricing-band {
    position: relative;
    padding: 32px 28px 28px;
    background: var(--bg-elevated);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    overflow: hidden;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
    transition: border-color 0.18s ease;
  }
  .pricing-band:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong); }
  .pricing-band.enterprise {
    background: linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(0,212,255,0.06), transparent 65%), var(--bg-elevated);
    border-color: rgba(0,212,255,0.22);
  }
  .pricing-band.agents {
    background: linear-gradient(155deg, rgba(123,108,255,0.06), transparent 65%), var(--bg-elevated);
    border-color: rgba(123,108,255,0.22);
  }
  .pricing-band-eyebrow { font: 600 11px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 0 0 14px; }
  .pricing-band.enterprise .pricing-band-eyebrow { color: var(--electric); }
  .pricing-band.agents .pricing-band-eyebrow { color: var(--grad-2); }
```
