  .pricing-band-title { font: 600 20px/1.25 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--ink); margin: 0 0 12px; }
  .pricing-band-body { font: 400 13.5px/1.55 var(--sans); color: var(--muted); margin: 0 0 24px; flex: 1; }
  .pricing-band-body b { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; }
  .pricing-band-rates {
    display: inline-flex; gap: 16px;
    font: 500 12px/1 var(--mono); color: var(--muted);
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    padding-bottom: 24px;
    border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--border);
  }
  .pricing-band-rates span b { color: var(--electric); font-weight: 600; font-size: 16px; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin-right: 4px; }
  .pricing-band.agents .pricing-band-rates span b { color: var(--grad-2); }
  .pricing-band-cta {
    display: inline-block; align-self: flex-start;
    padding: 11px 18px;
    background: transparent; color: var(--ink);
    border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 6px;
    font: 500 12.5px/1 var(--sans); text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.15s ease;
  }
  .pricing-band-cta:hover { border-color: var(--electric); color: var(--electric); }
  .pricing-band.enterprise .pricing-band-cta {
    background: var(--electric); color: var(--bg);
    border-color: var(--electric); font-weight: 600;
  }
  .pricing-band.enterprise .pricing-band-cta:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); color: var(--bg); }
  .pricing-band.agents .pricing-band-cta:hover { border-color: var(--grad-2); color: var(--grad-2); }

  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .tiers-head { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .pricing-bands { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }

  /* ===================== MOATS ===================== */
  .moats { padding: 88px 0; background: var(--bg-elevated); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .moats-head { max-width: 720px; margin: 0 0 48px; }
  .moats-head h2 { font-size: 36px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; line-height: 1.1; margin: 12px 0 0; color: var(--ink); }
  .moats-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 36px 48px; }
  .moat { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 32px 1fr; gap: 14px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding-top: 18px; }
  .moat .n { font: 600 12px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--electric); }
  .moat .title { font: 600 17px/1.25 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--ink); margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .moat .desc { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.55; color: var(--muted); }
  .moat .desc .roadmap { color: var(--signal); }

  /* ===================== FOUNDER ===================== */
  .founder { padding: 88px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .founder-inner { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.5fr; gap: 56px; align-items: center; max-width: 980px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 32px; }
  .founder-portrait { aspect-ratio: 4/5; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; }
  .founder-portrait img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; filter: contrast(1.05) brightness(0.92); }
  .founder-quote .eyebrow { color: var(--electric); margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .founder-quote blockquote {
    font: 400 24px/1.4 var(--sans); letter-spacing: -0.015em; color: var(--ink);
    margin: 0 0 22px; max-width: 580px;
  }
  .founder-quote .attr { font: 500 11px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
  .founder-quote .attr strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 700; }

  /* ===================== TRACK 3 ===================== */
  .track3 { padding: 32px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .track3-inner { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
  .track3 .label { font: 600 10px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--electric); margin-right: 12px; }
  .track3 .badge {
    font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border); color: var(--muted); border-radius: 4px;
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px;
  }
  .track3 .badge:hover { border-color: var(--electric); color: var(--electric); }
  .track3 .badge::before { content: "✓"; color: var(--moss-glow); font-weight: 700; }

  /* "What this becomes" band removed 2026-05-24 (taste pass): roadmap belongs in
     the Devpost long-form text and the investor deck, not on the marketing page. */

  /* ===================== FOOTER ===================== */
  .footer { padding: 36px 0 48px; }
  .footer-inner { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; font: 500 10.5px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--dim); }
  .footer a { color: var(--muted); }
  .footer a:hover { color: var(--electric); }

  /* ===================== RESPONSIVE =====================
     v0.10.1c / codex C.combined P2 fix: mobile demo + stage-card overrides
     declared HERE (after base .demo / .stage-card) so the cascade lets them win.
     Previously declared up in the hero section — same specificity meant the
     LATER base rules clobbered them and mobile layout never activated. */
  @media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .hero { padding: 56px 0; }
    .hero-grid, .proof-grid, .moats-grid, .biz-tiers, .how-grid, .founder-inner, .usecases-grid, .usecase-proof-stats { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 28px; }
    .hero h1 { font-size: 38px; }
    .container { padding: 0 22px; }
    .arch, .how, .proof, .biz, .moats, .founder { padding: 56px 0; }
    .arch-canvas { padding: 18px; }
    .demo { height: 560px; }
    .demo-stage { height: 220px; }
    .demo-body { padding: 14px 18px 18px; }
    .demo-svg { max-height: 220px; }
    .stage-card { max-width: 70%; font-size: 10px; }
  }
  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    .hero h1 { font-size: 32px; }
    .hero-sub { font-size: 13.5px; }
    .demo { height: 540px; }
    .demo-stage { height: 200px; }
    .demo-svg { max-height: 200px; }
    /* Cinema cards reposition to bottom of diagram on narrow viewports so
       they don't cover chips. Codex A-codex-7 says cards must stay readable. */
    .stage-card {
      top: auto; bottom: 4px; right: 4px; left: 4px;
      max-width: none; min-width: 0;
      padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 10px;
    }
    .stage-card[data-card="stage2"] {
      top: 50%; left: 4px; right: 4px;
      transform: translateY(-50%) scale(0.95);
    }
    .stage-card[data-card="stage2"].show { transform: translateY(-50%) scale(1); }
    .stage-card[data-card="stage3"] { left: 4px; }
  }

  /* Codex T3-K · 2026-05-24 · curl → signed bundle split panel below hero.
   * Stripe Connect pattern (API request left, resulting data right). The pipes
   * made visible right after the hero so the value prop pays off in 5 seconds. */
  .pipes-split { padding: 64px 0 32px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .pipes-head { max-width: 880px; margin: 0 auto 32px; text-align: center; }
  .pipes-head .eyebrow { font: 700 11px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--electric); margin-bottom: 12px; }
  .pipes-head h2 { font: 500 32px/1.18 var(--sans); color: var(--ink); margin: 0 0 14px; letter-spacing: -0.014em; }
  .pipes-head p { font: 500 15px/1.55 var(--sans); color: var(--muted); margin: 0; }
  .pipes-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.1fr;
    gap: 24px;
    align-items: stretch;
  }
  .pipes-call, .pipes-bundle {
    background: #07080A;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 22px 22px 18px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 12px;
    position: relative;
  }
  .pipes-bundle { border-color: rgba(0, 181, 220, 0.20); box-shadow: 0 4px 22px rgba(0, 181, 220, 0.04); }
  .pipes-label {
    font: 600 10px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--dim);
  }
  .pipes-bundle .pipes-label { color: var(--electric); }
  .pipes-code {
    margin: 0;
    font: 400 12px/1.55 var(--mono);
    color: var(--ink);
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    word-break: break-word;
    flex: 1;
    overflow-x: auto;
  }
  .pipes-code .tok-cmt { color: var(--dim); }
  .pipes-code .tok-str { color: #6FAE7A; }
  .pipes-code .tok-key { color: var(--electric); }
  .pipes-code .tok-k { color: var(--electric); }
  .pipes-code .tok-s { color: #6FAE7A; }
  .pipes-foot {
    display: flex; gap: 18px; padding-top: 10px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border);
    font: 500 11px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  }
  .pipes-foot a { color: var(--electric); text-decoration: none; }
  .pipes-foot a:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
  @media (max-width: 900px) {
    .pipes-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  }
</style>
<!--GLOBAL_CHROME_CSS-->
</head>
<body>

<!--GLOBAL_NAV-->

<!-- ===================== HERO ===================== -->
<section class="hero" id="top">
  <div class="container hero-grid">
    <div class="hero-left">
      <div class="eyebrow">PawConscious · the trust layer for pet-supplement brands</div>
      <h1>Be ready for the agents <span class="grad">recommending your product</span></h1>
      <p class="hero-sub">AI agents are starting to recommend pet products, and retailers and regulators already want proof. Without signed evidence, your supplement gets skipped. PawConscious turns every health claim into verifiable proof that any AI agent accepts.</p>

      <!-- 2026-05-25 (Omar A-v3, Stripe/Vercel pattern):
           ONE primary CTA. No competing "test your brand" drawer in the
           hero — that path is broken (runMesh wired to the old .demo
           widget that we removed) and the slow-verify path doesn't
           belong in the judge-critical first 5 seconds. Honest copy:
           "See the live demo" replaces "Watch the 60-sec demo" because
           the cinematic is interactive, not a fixed 60-second runtime. -->
      <style>
        .pc-verify-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:14px}
        .pc-chip-lead{font:500 12px/1 var(--mono,monospace);color:var(--dim)}
        .pc-chip{font:600 12px/1 var(--mono,monospace);color:var(--ink);background:rgba(255,255,255,0.04);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 13px;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .15s,color .15s}
        .pc-chip:hover{border-color:var(--electric);color:var(--electric)}
        .pc-verify-status{margin-top:14px;font:500 12.5px/1.5 var(--mono,monospace);color:var(--electric)}
        .pc-demo-link{display:inline-block;margin-top:16px;font:500 13px/1 var(--sans);color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none}
        .pc-demo-link:hover{color:var(--ink)}
      </style>
      <div class="hero-actions" id="verify">
        <form class="hero-cta" id="pcVerifyForm" onsubmit="return false;" autocomplete="off">
          <input type="text" id="pcVerifyInput" placeholder="Paste your product URL" spellcheck="false" aria-label="Your product URL">
          <button type="submit" id="pcVerifyBtn">Verify your product</button>
        </form>
        <div class="pc-verify-chips">
          <span class="pc-chip-lead">or try a verified brand:</span>
          <button type="button" class="pc-chip" data-url="https://www.cosequin.com/product/cosequin-maximum-strength-plus-msm-chewable-tablets/">Cosequin</button>
          <button type="button" class="pc-chip" data-url="https://www.greengruff.com/products/ease">Green Gruff</button>
          <button type="button" class="pc-chip" data-url="https://www.justfoodfordogs.com/product/calming-chews-for-dogs/50020180.html">JustFoodForDogs</button>
        </div>
        <div class="pc-verify-status" id="pcVerifyStatus" hidden></div>
        <a class="pc-demo-link" href="/demo">or watch the cinematic demo &rarr;</a>
      </div>
      <!-- Proof line (2026-05-27): gives the left column vertical weight against
           the tall card + states the trust primitives in 3 seconds. -->
      <style>
        .hero-proof{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px 18px;margin-top:26px;font:500 11.5px/1.4 var(--mono,monospace);color:var(--dim);letter-spacing:0.02em}
        .hero-proof span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
        .hero-proof span::before{content:"✓";color:#00D49B;font-weight:700}
      </style>
      <div class="hero-proof">
        <span>Digitally signed</span><span>Grounded on real PubMed research</span><span>Verifiable by any AI agent</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- ================================================================
         Hero live verifier widget (2026-05-25, Omar A — final pass).
         Bundle card is no longer pure illustration. Top of the card is now
         an interactive verify input: paste a URL or click a pre-cached
         brand chip → hot-path /a2a/v1/lookup → bundle data animates in.
         If hot path misses, falls through to a cold-path POST with
         stage-progress (same pattern as /agents try-it widget).
         ================================================================= -->
    <div class="bundle-card" aria-label="PawConscious signed bundle · live verifier">

      <!-- LIVE SIGNED CERTIFICATE (2026-05-27, four-voice handshake): the hero's
           right half now shows the PRODUCT'S CORE OUTPUT, not a derivative chat.
           This card is the live result of the Verify action on the left. Click a
           brand chip (or paste a URL) and this renders that product's REAL signed
           certificate: verdict, evidence count, Ed25519 signature, chain anchor.
           Defaults to a real cached cert on load so the product is visible before
           any click. The demand-side Gemini chat moved to its own beat below. -->
      <style>
        .pccert{display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-family:var(--sans);min-height:368px;position:relative}
        .pccert-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:14px}
        .pccert-eyebrow{font:700 10.5px/1 var(--mono,monospace);letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--electric);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
        .pccert-example{font:700 9px/1 var(--mono,monospace);letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#FFB446;border:1px solid #FFB446;border-radius:4px;padding:3px 6px}
        .pccert-verdict{font:700 11px/1 var(--mono,monospace);letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:6px 11px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid currentColor;white-space:nowrap;transition:color .25s,font-size .25s}
        .pccert-verdict.v-pass{color:#00D49B}.pccert-verdict.v-cond{color:#FFB446}.pccert-verdict.v-fail{color:#FF5C35}.pccert-verdict.v-none{color:var(--muted)}.pccert-verdict.v-load{color:var(--dim)}
        .pccert-verdict.v-big{font-size:14px;padding:8px 15px}
        .pccert-brand{font:700 19px/1.25 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px;min-height:24px}
        .pccert-brand .pcb-cursor{color:var(--electric);animation:pcblink 1s steps(1) infinite}
        @keyframes pcblink{50%{opacity:0}}
        .pccert-summary{font:500 12.5px/1.5 var(--mono,monospace);color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:12px;min-height:18px}
        .pccert-stage{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-bottom:14px}
        .pccert-stage[hidden]{display:none}
        .pccert-stage span{font:600 10px/1 var(--mono,monospace);color:var(--dim);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;padding:5px 8px;opacity:.4;transition:opacity .3s,color .3s,border-color .3s}
        .pccert-stage span.on{opacity:1;color:#00D49B;border-color:#00D49B}
        .pccert-claim{padding:11px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);font:400 13px/1.45 var(--ink)}
        .pccert-claim .pcc-q{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;display:block;margin-top:4px}
        .pccert-sig{margin-top:auto;padding:12px 14px;background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font:500 11px/1.7 var(--mono,monospace);color:var(--dim)}
        .pccert-sig b{color:#00D49B;font-weight:700}
        .pccert-sig details{margin-top:7px}
        .pccert-sig summary{cursor:pointer;color:var(--electric);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;list-style:none}
        .pccert-sig .pcc-raw{word-break:break-all;color:var(--dim);font-size:10px;line-height:1.6;margin-top:6px}
        .pccert-foot{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 18px;margin-top:14px}
        .pccert-link{font:600 12px/1 var(--mono,monospace);color:var(--electric);text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer}
        .pccert-link:hover{text-decoration:underline}
        /* Cold-path live progress: timer + the 7-agent pipeline, each tagged with
           its Google tool. Reasoning agents (1-5) are an estimated parallel-mesh
           schedule; sign + cert + Second Opinion snap to the real backend signals. */
        #pcCertProgress{display:none}
        .pccert.running #pcCertProgress{display:block}
        .pccert.running .pccert-summary,.pccert.running #pcCertClaims,.pccert.running .pccert-sig,.pccert.running .pccert-foot,.pccert.running #pcCertStage{display:none}
        .pcprog-top{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;margin:2px 0 16px}
        .pcprog-timer{font:700 24px/1 var(--mono,monospace);color:var(--electric);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
        .pcprog-est{font:500 10px/1 var(--mono,monospace);letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--dim)}
        .pcprog-stages{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:1px}
        .pcprog-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:14px 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:6px;transition:background .3s}
        .pcprog-row .pp-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;border:1.5px solid var(--dim);justify-self:center}
        .pcprog-row .pp-name{font:500 12.5px/1 var(--sans);color:var(--dim)}
        .pcprog-row .pp-tool{font:600 9.5px/1 var(--mono,monospace);letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--dim);white-space:nowrap;opacity:.6}
        .pcprog-row.run{background:rgba(0,212,255,.07)}
        .pcprog-row.run .pp-dot{border-color:var(--electric);background:var(--electric);animation:ppPulse 1.5s infinite}
        .pcprog-row.run .pp-name{color:var(--ink)}.pcprog-row.run .pp-tool{color:var(--electric);opacity:1}
        .pcprog-row.est .pp-dot{border-color:var(--muted)}.pcprog-row.est .pp-name{color:var(--muted)}
        .pcprog-row.done .pp-dot{border-color:#00D49B;background:#00D49B}
        .pcprog-row.done .pp-name{color:var(--ink)}.pcprog-row.done .pp-tool{color:#00D49B;opacity:.9}
        @keyframes ppPulse{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(0,212,255,.5)}70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(0,212,255,0)}100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(0,212,255,0)}}
        .pcprog-foot{margin-top:14px;font:500 10px/1.5 var(--mono,monospace);color:var(--dim)}
        /* Resolved-run recap: total time + the Google stack that ran. Persistent +
           self-explanatory so a user who left the tab understands it at a glance. */
        #pcCertRecap{display:none;margin:0 0 14px;padding:12px 14px;background:rgba(0,212,155,.05);border:1px solid rgba(0,212,155,.25);border-radius:10px}
        .pcrecap-head{font:600 12px/1 var(--mono,monospace);color:#00D49B;margin-bottom:10px}
        .pcrecap-head b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:700}
        .pcrecap-tools{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}

<!-- ===================== THE STAKES · two doors (2026-05-27, wow handshake) =====================
     The first scroll beat after the hero. The hero shows WHAT happens (URL ->
     verdict); this shows WHY it matters, in the founder's own stakes: skipped vs
     recommended, risky vs preferred, exposed vs defensible. The Cosequin $11.5M
     is used HERE as the cautionary tale (not as a cold hero example), which also
     resolves the old contradiction. -->
<style>
  .stakes { padding: 72px 0 56px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .stakes .stakes-head { max-width: 720px; margin: 0 0 32px; }
  .stakes .stakes-head h2 { margin: 8px 0 10px; }
  .stakes .stakes-head p { font: 500 15px/1.6 var(--sans); color: var(--muted); margin: 0; }
  .stakes-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 18px; max-width: 920px; }
  @media (max-width: 720px) { .stakes-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
  .stakes-col { border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; padding: 24px 26px; background: var(--surface); position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: border-color .25s, transform .25s; }
  .stakes-col:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); }
  .stakes-col.bad { border-color: rgba(255,92,53,0.35); }
  .stakes-col.bad:hover { border-color: rgba(255,92,53,0.6); }
  .stakes-col.good { border-color: rgba(0,212,155,0.35); }
  .stakes-col.good:hover { border-color: rgba(0,212,155,0.6); }
  /* Animated "NON-COMPLIANT" stamp (Gemini in-brand handshake): scale + tilt land
     when section enters viewport. Stays semi-transparent so the list reads. */
  .stakes-col.bad::after { content: "NON-COMPLIANT"; position: absolute; top: 50%; right: -10px; transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-9deg) scale(1.45); transform-origin: center; font: 800 26px/1 var(--sans); letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: rgba(255,92,53,0.08); border: 2px solid rgba(255,92,53,0.22); padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 6px; pointer-events: none; opacity: 0; transition: opacity .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), transform .9s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); }
  .stakes.in .stakes-col.bad::after { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-50%) rotate(-9deg) scale(1); }
  .stakes-col .sc-label { font: 700 11px/1 var(--mono,monospace); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: 18px; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
  .stakes-col.bad .sc-label { color: #FF5C35; }
  .stakes-col.good .sc-label { color: #00D49B; }
  .stakes-col .sc-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; padding: 13px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); font: 500 14.5px/1.5 var(--sans); color: var(--ink); position: relative; z-index: 1; }
  .stakes-col .sc-row:first-of-type { border-top: none; }
  .stakes-col .sc-ic { flex-shrink: 0; font-weight: 700; }
  .stakes-col.bad .sc-ic { color: #FF5C35; } .stakes-col.good .sc-ic { color: #00D49B; }
  /* Knockout band as an "Exhibit A" piece of evidence — court-docket framing,
     case number in mono with letter-spacing. Stays in the brand palette. */
  .stakes-knockout { max-width: 920px; margin: 32px 0 0; padding: 24px 26px 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,92,53,0.4); border-radius: 14px; background: rgba(255,92,53,0.05); font: 500 16px/1.55 var(--sans); color: var(--ink); position: relative; }
  .stakes-knockout::before { content: "EXHIBIT A"; position: absolute; top: -8px; left: 22px; background: var(--bg); padding: 0 10px; font: 700 10px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.22em; color: #FF5C35; }
  .stakes-knockout .case { display: block; font: 500 11px/1.5 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--dim); margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .stakes-knockout b { color: #FF5C35; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .stakes-knockout a { color: var(--electric); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.4); }
  .stakes-knockout a:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--electric); }
</style>
<section class="stakes pc-reveal" id="stakes">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="stakes-head">
      <div class="eyebrow">The stakes</div>
      <h2>The end of "trust me."</h2>
      <p>Your health claims are about to be read by machines, not just shoppers. Unprovable claims are a liability on three fronts at once.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="stakes-grid">
      <div class="stakes-col bad">
        <div class="sc-label">Your word alone</div>
        <div class="sc-row"><span class="sc-ic">✕</span><span>Skipped by AI shopping agents</span></div>
        <div class="sc-row"><span class="sc-ic">✕</span><span>Risky for retailers like Chewy and Amazon</span></div>
        <div class="sc-row"><span class="sc-ic">✕</span><span>Exposed to FTC action and class-action lawsuits</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="stakes-col good">
        <div class="sc-label">Verifiable proof</div>
        <div class="sc-row"><span class="sc-ic">✓</span><span>Recommended by AI shopping agents</span></div>
        <div class="sc-row"><span class="sc-ic">✓</span><span>Preferred by retailers who demand substantiation</span></div>
        <div class="sc-row"><span class="sc-ic">✓</span><span>Defensible the day a regulator or lawyer asks</span></div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="stakes-knockout">
      <span class="case">U.S. District Court · N.D. Cal · Case 3:22-cv-01573 · settled 2024</span>
      In 2024, the makers of Cosequin paid <b>$11.5M</b> to settle a class action over claims they could not back up. That is the cost of "your word alone." <a href="https://topclassactions.com/lawsuit-settlements/open-lawsuit-settlements/11-5m-cosequin-dog-supplements-class-action-settlement/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">source</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===================== DEMAND SIDE · recommended by agents (2026-05-27) =====================
     Moved here from the hero (four-voice handshake). The hero sells the SUPPLY
     side (a brand verifies its product). This beat shows the DEMAND side (an AI
     shopping agent recommends the verified product). Sequence, not split-screen,
     so the buyer first grasps the value to them, then sees the downstream pull.
     Same real Gemini 2.5 surface, grounded only on PawConscious-verified bundles. -->
<style>
  .demand { padding: 96px 0 80px; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); }
  .demand .demand-head { max-width: 760px; margin: 0 0 36px; }
  .demand .demand-head h2 { margin: 8px 0 12px; font-size: 38px; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }
  .demand .demand-sub { font: 500 16px/1.6 var(--sans); color: var(--muted); margin: 0; max-width: 60ch; }
  .adt { font-family: var(--mono,monospace); background: var(--bg); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px 26px; max-width: 920px; }
  .adt-head { font: 600 11px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--dim); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; }
  /* Continuous moss-glow pulse on the live indicator (in-brand). */
  .adt-head .dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #00D49B; box-shadow: 0 0 8px #00D49B; flex-shrink: 0; animation: adtDotPulse 2.2s ease-in-out infinite; }
  @keyframes adtDotPulse { 0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0,212,155,0.5); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 16px rgba(0,212,155,0.9); } }
  .adt-sub { font: 500 11.5px/1.5 var(--mono); color: var(--dim); margin: 6px 0 16px 17px; }
  .adt-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto 1.35fr; align-items: center; gap: 6px 18px; padding: 15px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); font-size: 13px; position: relative; transition: background .25s; }
  .adt-row:hover { background: rgba(0,212,255,0.03); }
  /* Sequential cyan line-wipe on scroll-reveal — each row's underline scales in (Gemini in-brand). */
  .adt-row::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 1px; width: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--electric), transparent); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform .65s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); }
  .demand.in .adt-row::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
  .demand.in .adt-row:nth-of-type(1)::after { transition-delay: 0.10s; }
  .demand.in .adt-row:nth-of-type(2)::after { transition-delay: 0.30s; }
  .demand.in .adt-row:nth-of-type(3)::after { transition-delay: 0.50s; }
  /* Product names get clear hierarchy in-brand (Geist 600 18px) */
  .adt-prod { color: var(--ink); font: 600 18px/1.2 var(--sans); }
  .adt-sig { font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .04em; white-space: nowrap; transition: color .25s, text-shadow .25s; }
  .adt-sig.ok { color: #00D49B; } .adt-sig.bad { color: #FF5C35; }
  .adt-row:hover .adt-sig.ok { text-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(0,212,255,0.55); color: var(--electric); }
  .adt-verdict { font: 600 11px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; }
  /* Verdict labels feel STAMPED — bolder weight, generous letter-spacing, with a
     subtle scale-land on first reveal. */
  .adt-action { font: 800 12px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: .14em; text-align: right; white-space: nowrap; transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; transition: transform .25s; }
  .adt-row:hover .adt-action { transform: scale(1.04); }
  .demand .adt-action { animation: adtStampLand .6s cubic-bezier(.18,1.4,.4,1) both; }
  .demand .adt-row:nth-of-type(1) .adt-action { animation-delay: .15s; }
  .demand .adt-row:nth-of-type(2) .adt-action { animation-delay: .35s; }
  .demand .adt-row:nth-of-type(3) .adt-action { animation-delay: .55s; }
  @keyframes adtStampLand { 0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(1.6); } 60% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(0.96); } 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }
  .adt-action.rec { color: #00D49B; } .adt-action.cav { color: #FFB446; } .adt-action.skip { color: #FF5C35; } .adt-action.rej { color: #FF5C35; } .adt-action.none { color: var(--muted); }
  /* Forged row glitches — subtle horizontal jitter on the REJECTED stamp. */
  .adt-action.rej { animation: adtStampLand .6s cubic-bezier(.18,1.4,.4,1) both, adtGlitch 3.6s infinite 1.2s; }
  @keyframes adtGlitch { 0%,92%,100% { transform: translate(0,0); } 93% { transform: translate(-2px,0); } 95% { transform: translate(2px,-1px); } 97% { transform: translate(-1px,1px); } }
  .adt-tamper { margin-top: 22px; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--border); }
  .adt-tamper-label { font: 500 11px/1.5 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 14px; }
  .adt-foot { margin-top: 22px; font: 500 12px/1.55 var(--mono); color: var(--dim); }
  .adt-foot a { color: var(--electric); text-decoration: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,212,255,0.4); }
  .adt-foot a:hover { border-bottom-color: var(--electric); }
  /* Editorial pull-quote BELOW the trace (Gemini in-brand). Italic Geist, dim ink,
     cyan-accented em. Adds the author's voice without breaking the dark+cyan brand. */
  .demand-pullquote { max-width: 760px; margin: 30px 0 0; font: italic 500 19px/1.5 var(--sans); color: rgba(237,238,241,0.78); padding-left: 18px; border-left: 2px solid var(--electric); }
  .demand-pullquote em { font-style: italic; color: var(--electric); font-weight: 500; }
  @media (max-width: 680px) { .adt-row { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 3px; } .adt-action { text-align: left; } }
</style>
<section class="demand pc-reveal" id="demand">
  <div class="container">
    <div class="demand-head">
      <div class="eyebrow">The payoff</div>
      <h2>Verified products get recommended by agents.</h2>
      <p class="demand-sub">A signed bundle is not paperwork. It is the input an AI shopping agent acts on: recommend the verified, skip the failed, reject the tampered. Below is our reference agent, running live against the directory.</p>
    </div>

    <!-- AGENT DECISION TRACE (2026-05-27, four-voice handshake): replaces the open
         Gemini chat. The chat was a liability (it deflected off-script prompts and
         read as a thin LLM wrapper, harming Demo + Innovation). This renders what
         examples/shopper_agent.py actually does: discover the agent card, verify
         every Ed25519 signature, decide RECOMMEND/SKIP, then reject a tampered
         bundle. Live verdicts from /a2a/v1/lookup; deterministic fallback below
         if a fetch fails, so it can never break in front of a judge. -->
    <div class="adt" aria-label="Reference shopper agent decision trace">
      <div class="adt-head"><span class="dot"></span><span>PawConscious reference shopper agent</span></div>
      <div class="adt-sub">examples/shopper_agent.py · discovers the agent card, verifies every signature, then decides</div>
      <div id="adtRows">
        <div class="adt-row"><span class="adt-prod">Cosequin</span><span class="adt-sig ok">signature VALID</span><span class="adt-verdict">CONDITIONAL · §255.3</span><span class="adt-action cav">RECOMMEND WITH CAVEAT</span></div>
        <div class="adt-row"><span class="adt-prod">Green Gruff</span><span class="adt-sig ok">signature VALID</span><span class="adt-verdict">FAIL · §255.1</span><span class="adt-action skip">SKIP</span></div>
        <div class="adt-row"><span class="adt-prod">JustFoodForDogs</span><span class="adt-sig ok">signature VALID</span><span class="adt-verdict">UNVERIFIED</span><span class="adt-action none">NO RECOMMENDATION</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="adt-tamper">
        <div class="adt-tamper-label">Tamper test · forge Green Gruff's FAIL into a PASS, keep the signature</div>
        <div class="adt-row" style="border-top:none;padding:0">
          <span class="adt-prod">Green Gruff (forged)</span>
          <span class="adt-sig bad">signature INVALID</span>
          <span class="adt-verdict">signature doesn't match</span>
          <span class="adt-action rej">REJECTED</span>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="adt-foot">Every decision depends on a verified signature. A forged verdict can never pass. <a href="/agents#try">Run the agent yourself →</a></div>
    </div>

    <!-- Editorial pull-quote (Gemini in-brand handshake). Italic Geist, dim ink,
         cyan-accented final clause. Adds the author's voice without breaking the
         dark+cyan palette — replaces the "developer log" feel with a thesis. -->
    <p class="demand-pullquote">A brand can write any claim it likes on the back of a bottle. An agent only acts on what it can <em>verify</em>.</p>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- ===================== HOW IT WORKS (U4: arch + how merged) ===================== -->
<section id="how-it-works" class="how-it-works-group pc-reveal">
  <!-- v0.15.0 U4: collapsed nine top-level sections to five.
       Architecture + How merged into one "How it works" group. The inner
       <div class="arch" id="architecture"> and <div class="how" id="how">
       keep their anchor IDs so /architecture and /#how links still scroll
       to the right place. -->
<div class="arch" id="architecture" hidden>
  <div class="container">
    <div class="arch-head">
      <div class="eyebrow">Architecture · Google Cloud native</div>
      <h2>Seven specialized agents · A2A · Vertex AI Search · Ed25519 · Firestore chain · Adversarial Second Opinion.</h2>
      <p>Hover any agent to see its Google tool, model, temperature, and typical latency. Every component below maps to live production code in <a href="https://github.com/odominguez7/PawConscious-Mesh-GFS" style="color: var(--electric);">the open-source repo</a>.</p>
    </div>

    <div class="arch-canvas">
      <svg class="arch-svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 600" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet" id="archSvg" role="img" aria-label="PawConscious · 7-agent, 3-stage architecture diagram on Google Cloud">
        <defs>
          <marker id="arrEdge" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
            <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.32)"/>
          </marker>
          <marker id="arrFlow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse">
            <path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#00D4FF"/>
          </marker>
        </defs>

        <!-- ===== STAGE GROUP RECTS (rendered first, behind everything) ===== -->
        <g class="stage">
          <rect x="222" y="46" width="500" height="500"/>
          <text class="stage-label" x="244" y="78">Stage 1 · Reasoning Mesh</text>
          <text class="stage-sub" x="244" y="98">5 agents · ADK + google.genai · asyncio.gather per claim</text>
        </g>
        <g class="stage">
          <rect x="754" y="186" width="160" height="220"/>
          <text class="stage-label" x="772" y="216">Stage 2 · Sign</text>
          <text class="stage-sub" x="772" y="234">mesh-api</text>
        </g>
        <g class="stage">
          <rect x="946" y="46" width="234" height="500"/>
          <text class="stage-label" x="966" y="78">Stage 3 · Adversarial</text>
          <text class="stage-sub" x="966" y="98">2 agents · post-sign</text>
        </g>

        <!-- ===== EDGES (rendered before boxes so they sit behind) ===== -->
        <g id="archEdges">
          <!-- Brand POST → Stage 1 (top input to claim-extractor) -->
          <line class="edge flow" x1="190" y1="148" x2="240" y2="148" marker-end="url(#arrFlow)"/>

          <!-- 01 Claim Extractor → fan-out tree to 3 parallel boxes -->
          <line class="edge" x1="482" y1="190" x2="482" y2="218"/>
          <line class="edge" x1="316" y1="218" x2="648" y2="218"/>
          <line class="edge" x1="316" y1="218" x2="316" y2="238" marker-end="url(#arrEdge)"/>
          <line class="edge" x1="482" y1="218" x2="482" y2="238" marker-end="url(#arrEdge)"/>
          <line class="edge" x1="648" y1="218" x2="648" y2="238" marker-end="url(#arrEdge)"/>

          <!-- 3 parallel → 05 Auditor (fan-in tree) -->
          <line class="edge" x1="316" y1="306" x2="316" y2="328"/>
          <line class="edge" x1="482" y1="306" x2="482" y2="328"/>

    <div class="arch-legend">
      <div class="item">
        <div class="h"><span class="name">7 Agents · 3 Stages</span><span class="badge">Shape</span></div>
        <p><b>Stage 1 (reasoning mesh, 5 agents):</b> <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">claim-extractor</code> first, then <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">evidence-grader · vet-rubric · compliance</code> fan out per claim via <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">asyncio.gather</code>, then <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">auditor</code> merges. <b>Stage 2:</b> Ed25519 sign + chain anchor. <b>Stage 3 (post-sign, 2 agents):</b> <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">cert-composer</code> + adversarial <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">second-opinion</code> run in parallel.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="h"><span class="name">ADK 2.0</span><span class="badge">Orchestration</span></div>
        <p>Four of seven agents wrap as <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">google.adk.agents.LlmAgent</code> (<b>claim-extractor, evidence-grader, compliance, auditor</b>); the orchestrator fans them out via <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">asyncio.gather</code>. The other 3 call <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">google.genai</code> SDK direct for v0.1 deterministic latency. ADK <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">ParallelAgent</code> + <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">SequentialAgent</code> wrappers are documented as the Phase 4 Vertex AI Agent Engine deployment surface.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="h"><span class="name">Gemini 2.5</span><span class="badge">Reasoning</span></div>
        <p><b>2.5 Pro</b> for claim extraction, evidence grading, vet rubric, compliance mapping, cert composer, and adversarial Second Opinion (6 agents). <b>2.5 Flash</b> for the deterministic auditor (1 agent). Most calls use <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">temperature=0.0</code>; Second Opinion uses 0.3 for adversarial breadth.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="h"><span class="name">Grounding</span><span class="badge">Truth</span></div>
        <p><b>Vertex AI Search</b> grounds the <b>compliance</b> agent against a public-redistributable regulator corpus (FTC 16 CFR §255 · AAFCO PF7 · NASC). <b>Google Search grounding</b> via <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">google.genai</code> powers the Second Opinion's 4 stress tests (court · regulator · consensus · public skepticism). Vet-panel is intentionally prompt-only. No licensed handbook ingest.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="h"><span class="name">A2A v0.3</span><span class="badge">Interop</span></div>
        <p>Public agent card at <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">/.well-known/agent-card.json</code>. Async lifecycle: <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">/tasks/send</code> → poll <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">/tasks/get</code>. External ShopperAgent (separate Cloud Run service, MIT) consumes it end-to-end. No third-party integrations claimed.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="h"><span class="name">MCP + Citations</span><span class="badge">Evidence</span></div>
        <p><b>BioMCP</b> (21 tools, MIT) → live PubMed / Europe PMC retrieval. <b>Semantic Scholar Graph API</b> batch enriches every paper with citation + influential-citation counts (public surface of AI2 Asta). The auditor verifies PMID format and direction match before signing.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="item">
        <div class="h"><span class="name">Cloud Run + Firestore</span><span class="badge">Runtime</span></div>
        <p>Mesh API + ShopperAgent are independent Cloud Run services (scale-to-zero, Artifact Registry images). Firestore holds the append-only transparency log: <code style="color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);">chain_anchor = sha256(bundle_hash + ":" + (prev_hash or "genesis"))</code>. Public head at <a href="/pcec/v0/chain/head" style="color:var(--electric);">/pcec/v0/chain/head</a>.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div><!-- /.arch (id=architecture) -->

<script>
/* ============================================================
 * UNIFIED DEMO — cached loop + live verify + replay all in one
 * container. Mode label changes; SVG + stream + cert stay put.
 * ============================================================ */
/* v0.10.0a — 7 agents laid out as a 3-stage horizontal pipeline miniature.
 * Coordinates target the demo-svg viewBox (600×260) and mirror the canonical
 * /architecture diagram: Stage 1 has claim-extractor (top) → 3 parallel
 * (evidence/vet/compliance, middle row) → auditor (bottom), Stage 2 sign
 * anchor in the middle column, Stage 3 has cert-composer (top) and
 * second-opinion (bottom) on the right.
 *
 * num = the visible "01..07" chip text. label = the short uppercase caption
 * rendered below the chip; truncates to icon only if width forces. */
const AGENTS = [
  // Stage 1 — Reasoning Mesh
  { id: 'extract',    num: '01', label: 'EXTRACT',     cx: 165, cy:  82 },                    // Top of Stage 1
  { id: 'evidence',   num: '02', label: 'EVIDENCE',    cx:  68, cy: 138 },                   // Parallel row, left
  { id: 'rubric',     num: '03', label: 'VET',         cx: 165, cy: 138 },                   // Parallel row, middle
  { id: 'compliance', num: '04', label: 'FTC §255',    cx: 262, cy: 138 },                   // Parallel row, right
  { id: 'auditor',    num: '05', label: 'AUDITOR',     cx: 165, cy: 198 },                   // Bottom of Stage 1
  // Stage 3 — Adversarial (Stage 2 sign anchor lives in static markup at cx=368, cy=138)
  { id: 'composer',   num: '06', label: 'COMPOSE',     cx: 502, cy:  82 },                   // Top of Stage 3
  { id: 'opinion',    num: '07', label: '2ND OPINION', cx: 502, cy: 198 },                   // Bottom of Stage 3

const DEMO_SVG    = document.getElementById('demoSvg');
const DEMO_EDGES  = document.getElementById('demoEdges');
const DEMO_NODES  = document.getElementById('demoNodes');
const DEMO_STREAM = document.getElementById('demoStream');
const DEMO_CERT   = document.getElementById('demoCert');
const DEMO_MODE_B = document.getElementById('demoModeBadge');
const DEMO_MODE_T = document.getElementById('demoModeText');
const DEMO_RIGHT  = document.getElementById('demoRight');
const DEMO_ANCHOR = document.querySelector('#demoAnchor .anchor-body');

const URL_INPUT   = document.getElementById('urlInput');
// v0.10.0b: maxClaims dropdown removed from markup; max_claims=3 hardcoded in runMesh().
const RUN_BTN     = document.getElementById('runBtn');

let demoMode = 'auto'; // 'auto' | 'live' | 'replay'
let interrupt = false;
let cycleGen = 0; // generation counter — cached cycles abort if a newer gen exists

function tsNow() {
  // HH:MM:SS — human local time, not the ambiguous mm:ss format
  return new Date().toTimeString().slice(0,8);
}
// v0.10.2 Phase F (A-codex-3): optional agent id tags the row with a colored
// left border keyed to the agent/stage. Hovering the row briefly pulses the
// matching diagram chip (180ms chipPulseLink animation). Existing callers that
// pass only (msg, cls) keep working — agent is opt-in.
function streamAdd(msg, cls='', agent=null) {
  const row = document.createElement('div');
  row.className = 'row';
  if (agent) {
    row.dataset.agent = agent;
    row.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
      const chip = DEMO_NODES.querySelector(`.node[data-agent="${agent}"]`);
      if (!chip) return;
      chip.classList.add('pulse-link');
      setTimeout(() => chip.classList.remove('pulse-link'), 200);
    });
  }
  row.innerHTML = `<span class="ts">${tsNow()}</span><span class="msg ${cls}">${msg}</span>`;
  DEMO_STREAM.appendChild(row);
  DEMO_STREAM.scrollTop = DEMO_STREAM.scrollHeight;
  // cap rows
  while (DEMO_STREAM.children.length > 60) DEMO_STREAM.removeChild(DEMO_STREAM.firstChild);
}
function streamClear() { DEMO_STREAM.innerHTML = ''; }
function setMode(mode, badgeText, modeText, rightText) {
  // 2026-05-25: Option A removed the in-hero .demo widget. Bail if its
  // DOM anchors don't exist so the call doesn't throw and kill later JS.
  if (!DEMO_MODE_B || !DEMO_MODE_T) return;
  demoMode = mode;
  DEMO_MODE_B.className = 'badge' + (mode === 'live' ? ' live' : mode === 'replay' ? ' replay' : '');
  DEMO_MODE_B.textContent = badgeText;
  DEMO_MODE_T.textContent = modeText;
  if (rightText !== undefined) DEMO_RIGHT.textContent = rightText;
  // v0.10.0a / codex A4: outer demo border colour swaps with mode so the
  // distinction is peripherally visible even if the chrome bar is below fold.
  const demoEl = document.getElementById('demo');
  if (demoEl) demoEl.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
}

/* v0.10.1c / Phase C: per-stage perimeter glow narrative + cinema cards.
 * setStage(name) drives BOTH the outer container border animation AND
 * which cinema card is visible. Sequential (never 2 cards at once per A-codex-3).
 * Stages: null (clear) · 'stage1' · 'stage2' · 'stage3' · 'done-pass' · 'done-fail'. */
const STAGE_CARDS = {
  stage1: document.querySelector('.stage-card[data-card="stage1"]'),
  stage2: document.querySelector('.stage-card[data-card="stage2"]'),
  stage3: document.querySelector('.stage-card[data-card="stage3"]'),
};
function setStage(name) {
  const demoEl = document.getElementById('demo');
  if (!demoEl) return;
  if (name) demoEl.setAttribute('data-stage', name);
  else      demoEl.removeAttribute('data-stage');
  // Show only the matching cinema card; hide all others.
  Object.entries(STAGE_CARDS).forEach(([key, el]) => {
    if (!el) return;
    if (key === name) el.classList.add('show');
    else              el.classList.remove('show');
  });
}
function clearStage() { setStage(null); }
function resetDemo() {
  DEMO_EDGES.querySelectorAll('.edge').forEach(e => e.classList.remove('active','done'));
  DEMO_NODES.querySelectorAll('.node').forEach(n => n.classList.remove('active','done'));
  DEMO_ANCHOR.classList.remove('done');
  DEMO_CERT.classList.remove('visible');
  // v0.10.3 ISSUE 1: hide the external result-report on each new cycle so it
  // reveals fresh when this cycle's verdict lands.
  // v0.10.3 codex-3: also CLEAR resultBody so stale cert HTML can't reappear
  // if showResultReport() races renderCertHtml on a fast replay.
  const r = document.getElementById('result');
  if (r) r.hidden = true;
  const body = document.getElementById('resultBody');
  if (body) body.innerHTML = '';
  const so = document.getElementById('resultSecondOpinion');
  if (so) { so.hidden = true; so.innerHTML = ''; }
  // v0.10.3 codex-2: cancel any pending scrollIntoView from a previous cycle
  // so a fast Replay doesn't yank the page mid-cycle.
  if (window._resultScrollTimer) {
    clearTimeout(window._resultScrollTimer);
    window._resultScrollTimer = null;
  }
}

/* v0.10.0a — build the 3-stage pipeline geometry.
 * Each agent gets a numbered chip (halo + body + "##" inside + label below).
 * Edges traverse the canonical flow:
 *   01 → 02/03/04 (fan-out tree)
 *   02/03/04 → 05 (fan-in tree)
 *   05 → Sign (diagonal out of Stage 1)
 *   Sign → 06 and Sign → 07 (parallel post-sign)
 * Edge `data-agent` is set to the DESTINATION agent so JS toggling `.active`
 * on the matching agent's edge produces the expected "approaching now" cue. */
(function buildDemoSvg() {
  // 2026-05-25: Option A removed the in-hero .demo widget markup, so the
  // SVG anchor nodes (#demoEdges, #demoNodes, #demoAnchor) no longer exist.
  // Bail early instead of throwing "Cannot read 'appendChild' of null"
  // which kills every script that follows (including the drawer toggle).
  if (!DEMO_EDGES || !DEMO_NODES) return;

  const SIGN_CX = 368, SIGN_CY = 138; // matches static anchor in markup

  // ---- Build edges ---------------------------------------------------------
  // 01 → fan-out tree (3 children: 02, 03, 04)
  function addEdge(x1, y1, x2, y2, agentId) {
    const e = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','line');
    e.setAttribute('x1', x1); e.setAttribute('y1', y1);
    e.setAttribute('x2', x2); e.setAttribute('y2', y2);
    e.setAttribute('class', 'edge');
    if (agentId) e.dataset.agent = agentId;
    DEMO_EDGES.appendChild(e);
  }
  // Every edge tagged with its DESTINATION agent so cachedCycle's data-agent
  // selector lights up the correct segments (codex review P2 fix).
  // Stage 1 → 1 (evidence-grader first parallel child)
  addEdge(165, 100, 165, 116, 'evidence'); // 01 trunk down to junction
  addEdge( 68, 116, 262, 116, 'evidence'); // junction horizontal — shared trunk
  addEdge( 68, 116,  68, 122, 'evidence'); // into 02
  addEdge(165, 116, 165, 122, 'rubric');   // into 03
  addEdge(262, 116, 262, 122, 'compliance'); // into 04

  // Parallel-outs + fan-in to auditor (all light up when auditor fires)
  addEdge( 68, 154,  68, 180, 'auditor');  // 02 down
  addEdge(165, 154, 165, 180, 'auditor');  // 03 down
  addEdge(262, 154, 262, 180, 'auditor');  // 04 down
  addEdge( 68, 180, 262, 180, 'auditor');  // fan-in horizontal
  addEdge(165, 180, 165, 198, 'auditor');  // into 05

  // 05 → Sign (auditor produces the bundle; Sign anchor lights separately post-loop)
  addEdge(183, 198, SIGN_CX - 22, SIGN_CY + 6, 'auditor');

  // Sign → Stage 3 (06 + 07 in parallel post-sign)
  addEdge(SIGN_CX + 22, SIGN_CY - 6, 484,  82, 'composer'); // Sign → 06
  addEdge(SIGN_CX + 22, SIGN_CY + 6, 484, 198, 'opinion');  // Sign → 07

  // ---- Build agent chips ---------------------------------------------------
  // v0.10.2 Phase G: chip body r=14→16, halo r=20→22. Subtle scale-up.
  // v0.10.3 ISSUE 3: each chip gets an extra .work-pulse rotating dashed ring
  // that fades in while the agent is .active — communicates "thinking now".
  AGENTS.forEach(a => {
    const g = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g');
    g.setAttribute('class', 'node');
    g.dataset.agent = a.id;
    g.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${a.cx},${a.cy})`);

    const halo = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','circle');
    halo.setAttribute('class', 'halo'); halo.setAttribute('r', '22');
    const work = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','circle');
    work.setAttribute('class', 'work-pulse'); work.setAttribute('r', '26');
    const body = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','circle');
    body.setAttribute('class', 'body'); body.setAttribute('r', '16');
    const num = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','text');
    num.setAttribute('class', 'num'); num.setAttribute('y', '3'); // optical center
    num.textContent = a.num;
    const label = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','text');
    label.setAttribute('class', 'label'); label.setAttribute('y', '30');
    label.textContent = a.label;

    g.append(halo, work, body, num, label);
    DEMO_NODES.appendChild(g);
  });

  // ---- Build sonar-ring pair for the SIGN moment (v0.10.3 ISSUE 3).
  // Two concentric rings that expand from SIGN anchor when fireSonar() runs.
  // Replaces the v0.10.2 8-particle burst with a single coherent visual event.
  // Ring 2 fires 280ms after ring 1 via JS for the sonar-pulse effect.
  const sonarGroup = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','g');
  sonarGroup.setAttribute('id', 'demoSonarGroup');
  sonarGroup.setAttribute('transform', `translate(${SIGN_CX},${SIGN_CY})`);
  for (let i=0; i<2; i++) {
    const r = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','circle');
    r.setAttribute('class', 'sonar-ring');
    r.setAttribute('id', 'sonarRing' + (i + 1));
    r.setAttribute('r', '18');
    sonarGroup.appendChild(r);
  }
  DEMO_NODES.appendChild(sonarGroup);
})();

/* v0.10.3 ISSUE 3: fire the sonar-ring expansion at the SIGN anchor.
 * Replaces v0.10.2 fireSignParticles (renamed for clarity; old name kept as
 * thin alias below for any orphan call sites). Ring 2 fires 280ms after
 * ring 1 for the sonar-pulse effect. */
function fireSonar() {
  const r1 = document.getElementById('sonarRing1');
  const r2 = document.getElementById('sonarRing2');
  function play(el) {
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('fire');
    void el.getBoundingClientRect();
    el.classList.add('fire');
    setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('fire'), 1700);
  }
  play(r1);
  setTimeout(() => play(r2), 280);
}
// Back-compat alias for any orphan call sites from v0.10.2.
function fireSignParticles() { fireSonar(); }

function sleep(ms) { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }

async function cachedCycle() {
  const myGen = ++cycleGen;
  const aborted = () => interrupt || myGen !== cycleGen;
  // v0.10.0c: cached cycle replays the real JFFD audit verbatim.
  const b = JFFD_BUNDLE;
  resetDemo(); streamClear();
  streamAdd(`POST /a2a/v1/tasks/send → ${b.brand}`, 'dim');
  await sleep(600); if (aborted()) return;
  streamAdd('task-cached · status: submitted', 'ok');
  await sleep(700); if (aborted()) return;
  streamAdd('orchestrator: asyncio.gather · 7 agents (4 ADK + 3 google.genai) on A2A v0.3');
  const nodes = DEMO_NODES.querySelectorAll('.node');
  /* STEPS narrate the actual JFFD audit findings — every number traceable
   * to the live run captured 2026-05-21. claim-extractor produced 3 claims;
   * evidence-grader pulled 7 papers; vet rubric returned 1-2/5 across the
   * board; compliance flagged 2 of 3 under FTC §255.1; auditor surfaced
   * 1 FAIL. v0.10.0a edge-by-data-agent matching (codex P2) still applies. */
  const STEPS = [
    'claim-extractor · ADK + httpx · 3 claims extracted from PDP',
    'evidence-grader · BioMCP → PubMed · 7 papers retrieved · L-Tryptophan + chamomile evidence reviewed',
    'vet-rubric · Gemini 2.5 Pro simulating 5-vet rubric (LLM role-play) · scores 1-2 / 5 across claims',
    'compliance · Vertex AI Search · FTC §255.1 general flag on 2 of 3 claims',
    'auditor (Falsifier v0) · PMID + claim-direction checks · 1 FAIL surfaced',
    'Agent 6 (Cert Composer) · 4622-byte branded cert · Gemini 2.5 Pro',
    'Agent 7 (Second Opinion) · 4 stress tests · 1 SURVIVES · 3 NEEDS REVIEW',
  ];
  function edgesFor(agentId) {
    return DEMO_EDGES.querySelectorAll(`.edge[data-agent="${agentId}"]`);
  }
  // v0.10.1c Phase C: kick off Stage 1 cinema + perimeter glow
  setStage('stage1');
  for (let i=0; i<nodes.length; i++) {
    if (aborted()) return;
    const agentId = nodes[i].dataset.agent;
    edgesFor(agentId).forEach(e => e.classList.add('active'));
    nodes[i].classList.add('active');
    // v0.10.2 Phase F: tag stream row with the firing agent so it gets the
    // colored left border + hover linkage back to the diagram chip.
    streamAdd(STEPS[i], '', agentId);
    await sleep(550);
  }
  await sleep(400); if (aborted()) return;
  for (let i=0; i<nodes.length; i++) {
    if (aborted()) return;
    const agentId = nodes[i].dataset.agent;
    nodes[i].classList.remove('active'); nodes[i].classList.add('done');
    edgesFor(agentId).forEach(e => { e.classList.remove('active'); e.classList.add('done'); });
    await sleep(120);
  }
  if (aborted()) return;
  // Stage-by-stage outcome lines that mirror what the buyer sees on a real run.
  b.per_claim.forEach((c) => {
    const flag = c.flag ? ' · FTC flag' : '';
    const cls = (c.audit === 'PASS' && !c.flag) ? 'ok' : 'err';
    streamAdd(`claim ${String(c.idx).padStart(2,'0')} · vet ${c.vet}/5 · ${c.ftc}${flag} · audit ${c.audit}`, cls, 'auditor');
  });
  // v0.10.1c Phase C: Stage 1 → Stage 2 (sign event, dramatic 3s flash)
  setStage('stage2');
  streamAdd('SequentialAgent · merge + sign · Ed25519', 'ok', 'sign');
  await sleep(500); if (aborted()) return;
  DEMO_ANCHOR.classList.add('done');
  // v0.10.2 Phase G: particle burst fires when the SIGN anchor turns moss-green
  // — the actual signature-being-written moment. Codex A-codex-2 stagger met:
  // moss flash on perimeter at t=0, anchor lights at t=+500ms, burst at +600ms.
  setTimeout(fireSignParticles, 100);
  streamAdd(`chain_anchor appended → ${b.anchor.slice(0,40)}…`, 'ok', 'sign');
  await sleep(2200); if (aborted()) return;  // let the Stage 2 flash play
  // v0.10.1c Phase C: Stage 2 → Stage 3 (adversarial double-check)
  setStage('stage3');
  await sleep(500); if (aborted()) return;
  // Inject the verbatim Agent 6 cert + Agent 7 Second Opinion via the SAME
  // render functions the live run uses. Structurally identical preview.
  renderCertHtml(JFFD_CERT_HTML);
  renderSecondOpinion(JFFD_SECOND_OPINION);
  streamAdd('bundle signed · cached preview matches real urn:pcec:claim:syrz7izwfbatx6go2hgn2ipy', 'ok', 'composer');
  // v0.10.1c Phase C: Stage 3 done → final verdict state (JFFD = FAIL → amber)
  await sleep(800);
  setStage('done-fail');
  // v0.10.3 ISSUE 1: cert is rendered into the external <section class="result-report">
  // by renderCertHtml(). Reveal it now so the user sees the full report appear below
  // the hero exactly when the verdict lands.
  showResultReport();
  await sleep(4200);
}

  if (text !== undefined) COVERAGE_TXT.textContent = text;
}

/* v0.10.0b / codex A8: three-tier inline error. */
function setError(problem, cause, fix) {
  if (!problem) { URL_ERROR.hidden = true; return; }
  URL_ERROR.querySelector('.err-problem').textContent = problem;
  URL_ERROR.querySelector('.err-cause').textContent = cause || '';
  URL_ERROR.querySelector('.err-fix').textContent = fix || '';
  URL_ERROR.hidden = false;
}

function setReady() {
  setMode('ready', 'Ready', 'click Verify to run · or Replay for a cached preview', 'PCEC v0.1');
  setCoverage('', 'Ready · paste a URL above and click Verify');
  clearStage(); // v0.10.1c: clear any leftover stage glow/cinema cards
}

/* Initial state — no animation. Static chips, static Sign anchor. */
(function init() {
  setReady();
})();

/* "Replay cached demo" — runs one cached cycle, then returns to ready.
 * No auto-loop reentry. Distinct from runMesh() so the user always knows
 * which mode is which. */
async function runCached(e) {
  if (e) e.preventDefault();
  if (demoMode === 'live' || demoMode === 'replay') return false;
  // Stop any pulse on Verify — the user has chosen a cached preview.
  RUN_BTN.classList.add('pulse-stop');
  REPLAY_BTN.disabled = true;
  interrupt = true; cycleGen++;
  await sleep(50);
  interrupt = false;
  setMode('replay', '▶ CACHED', 'pre-recorded demo · ~12s', 'CACHED');
  setCoverage('', 'Cached cycle running · pre-recorded data');
  setError();
  await cachedCycle();
  // After cycle: show coverage summary (cached uses fixed 3 claims).
  setMode('done', '✓ DONE', 'cached cycle complete · click Verify to run live', 'COMPLETED');
  setCoverage('completed', 'Verified 3 of 3 demo claims · cached bundle visible below');
  REPLAY_BTN.disabled = false;
  // Re-enable Verify pulse for the next run.
  RUN_BTN.classList.remove('pulse-stop');
  return false;
}

/* ============================================================
 * LIVE VERIFY — runMesh() drives the SAME demo container.
 * ============================================================ */
async function runMesh() {
  const url = URL_INPUT.value.trim();
  // v0.10.0b / codex A8: three-tier inline errors (problem · cause · fix).
  if (!url) {
    setError('Enter your product URL',
             'We need an HTTPS link to fetch the label.',
             'Try https://www.justfoodfordogs.com/product/calming-chews-for-dogs/50020180.html');
    URL_INPUT.focus();
    return;
  }
  if (!url.startsWith('http')) {
    setError("That doesn't look like a URL",
             'Expected https://example.com/path',
             'Paste the product page from your DTC site or retailer (Chewy, Petco, etc.)');
    URL_INPUT.focus();
    return;
  }
  setError(); // clear

  // Kill any in-flight cached cycle — bump generation, set interrupt, wait one frame for the
  // async cachedCycle to observe the abort, then reset DOM cleanly.
  cycleGen++;
  interrupt = true;
  await sleep(50);
  interrupt = false;
  resetDemo();
  streamClear();
  // Stop the Verify-button pulse — the user has clicked it.
  RUN_BTN.classList.add('pulse-stop');
  REPLAY_BTN.disabled = true;
  setMode('live', '● LIVE · YOUR URL', `${url.replace(/^https?:\/\//,'').slice(0,40)}…`, 'POST /a2a/v1/tasks/send');
  setCoverage('live', 'Live mesh running · ~60-180s typical · please wait');
  // v0.10.1c Phase C: kick off Stage 1 perimeter glow + cinema card for the live run.
  // Live mode stays on Stage 1 until orchestrator emits stage-2 progress (cert/sign);
  // backend currently only emits 2 progress msgs (codex S2E P2 known limitation),
  // so the cinema for live is intentionally simpler than the cached cycle.
  setStage('stage1');
  RUN_BTN.disabled = true;
  document.getElementById('demo').scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'start' });
  streamAdd(`POST /a2a/v1/tasks/send → ${url}`);

  try {
    const submit = await fetch('/a2a/v1/tasks/send', {
      method:'POST',
      headers:{ 'Content-Type':'application/json', 'X-API-Key':'demo-key-2026-06' },
      // v0.10.0b / codex A7: max_claims hardcoded to 3 (was user-selected from dropdown,
      // which was confusing buyer UX). Backend ranking isn't built; honest cap = first 3.
      body: JSON.stringify({ skill:'verify_claim', input:{ product_url:url, max_claims: 3 } }),
    });
    if (!submit.ok) throw new Error(`submit ${submit.status}`);
    const sub = await submit.json();
    const taskId = sub.task_id;
    _currentTaskId = taskId;
    streamAdd(`task ${taskId.slice(0,12)}… queued · status: submitted`, 'ok');
    streamAdd(`polling /a2a/v1/tasks/get/${taskId.slice(0,12)}… every 3s · ~60-180s typical`, 'dim');
    // visually mark all nodes active during the wait
    DEMO_NODES.querySelectorAll('.node').forEach(n => { n.classList.remove('done'); n.classList.add('active'); });
    DEMO_EDGES.querySelectorAll('.edge').forEach(e => { e.classList.remove('done'); e.classList.add('active'); });

    let attempts = 0; let lastMsg = ''; let lastStatus = ''; const t0 = Date.now();
    while (attempts < 80) {
      await sleep(3000);
      attempts++;
      const get = await fetch(`/a2a/v1/tasks/get/${taskId}`);
      if (!get.ok) throw new Error(`get ${get.status}`);
      const data = await get.json();
      const elapsed = Math.round((Date.now()-t0)/1000);
      // ALWAYS log the poll so user sees activity (codex S2E P2 — backend only emits 2 progress msgs)
      if (data.status !== lastStatus || (data.progress_message && data.progress_message !== lastMsg)) {
        lastStatus = data.status;
        if (data.progress_message && data.progress_message !== lastMsg) {
          lastMsg = data.progress_message;
          streamAdd(`mesh [${elapsed}s] · ${data.status} · ${lastMsg}`, 'ok');
          setCoverage('live', `Live mesh · ${elapsed}s · ${lastMsg}`);
        } else {
          streamAdd(`mesh [${elapsed}s] · ${data.status}`);
        }
      } else if (attempts % 3 === 0) {
        // heartbeat every 9s so the user knows polling is alive
        streamAdd(`[${elapsed}s] still ${data.status}… (poll ${attempts})`, 'dim');
        setCoverage('live', `Live mesh · ${elapsed}s elapsed · still ${data.status}`);
      }
      if (data.status === 'completed') { renderLive(data); RUN_BTN.disabled = false; REPLAY_BTN.disabled = false; return; }
      if (data.status === 'failed') {
        streamAdd(`task failed: ${data.error || '—'}`, 'err');
        setError('Live mesh task failed',
                 data.error || 'The orchestrator returned a failure status.',
                 'Click Verify again to retry, or click ▶ Replay cached demo to preview a working run.');
        // v0.10.0b codex review fix: reset demoMode so Replay isn't gated as 'live'.
        setMode('ready', 'Error', 'live mesh failed · retry or run cached', 'PCEC v0.1');
        setCoverage('error', 'Live mesh task failed');
        clearStage(); // v0.10.1c codex C.combined P2: stop the Stage 1 cyan pulse on failure
        RUN_BTN.disabled=false; REPLAY_BTN.disabled = false;
        return;
      }
    }
    streamAdd('polling timed out after 4min', 'err');
    // v0.10.0b / codex A8: timeout error with concrete fix path.
    setError('Verification ran longer than 4 minutes',
             'The mesh may be cold-starting (first Cloud Run hit takes ~120s).',
             'Click Verify again to retry, or click ▶ Replay cached demo to preview a pre-recorded run.');
    setMode('ready', 'Timeout', 'live mesh ran >4min · retry or run cached', 'PCEC v0.1');
    setCoverage('error', 'Live mesh timed out · retry or run cached demo');
    clearStage(); // v0.10.1c codex C.combined P2: clear stale animation on timeout
  } catch (err) {
    streamAdd(`error: ${err.message}`, 'err');
    setError('Live mesh hit an error',
             err.message || 'Unknown failure mode.',
             'Retry or click ▶ Replay cached demo to confirm the agent flow works.');
    setMode('ready', 'Error', 'live mesh error · retry or run cached', 'PCEC v0.1');
    setCoverage('error', `Live mesh error · ${err.message || 'unknown'}`);
    clearStage(); // v0.10.1c codex C.combined P2: clear stale animation on exception
  } finally {
    RUN_BTN.disabled = false;
    REPLAY_BTN.disabled = false;
    // v0.10.0b codex review fix: restore Verify pulse so the user knows
    // the button is clickable again after error or completion.
    RUN_BTN.classList.remove('pulse-stop');
  }
}

function renderLive(data) {
  const bundle = data.output || {};
  const audits = bundle.audit || [];
  const compliance = bundle.compliance || [];
  const vetScores = bundle.vet_scores || [];
  const allAuditsPass = audits.length > 0 && audits.every(a => (a.verdict||'').toUpperCase()==='PASS');
  const anyViolation = compliance.some(c => c.violation_flag);
  const passing = allAuditsPass && !anyViolation;
  // mark nodes done
  DEMO_NODES.querySelectorAll('.node').forEach(n => { n.classList.remove('active'); n.classList.add('done'); });
  DEMO_EDGES.querySelectorAll('.edge').forEach(e => { e.classList.remove('active'); e.classList.add('done'); });
  DEMO_ANCHOR.classList.add('done');
  // per-claim summary in stream
  audits.forEach((a,i) => {
    const vs = vetScores[i]?.score ?? '—';
    const c = compliance[i] || {};
    const flag = c.violation_flag ? ' · FTC flag' : '';
    streamAdd(`claim ${String(i+1).padStart(2,'0')} · vet ${vs}/5 · ${c.ftc_section || '—'}${flag} · audit ${a.verdict || '—'}`, (a.verdict==='PASS' && !c.violation_flag) ? 'ok' : 'err');
  });
  streamAdd('SequentialAgent · merge + sign · Ed25519', 'ok');
  streamAdd(`chain_anchor appended → ${(data.chain_anchor||'').slice(0,32)}…`, 'ok');
  // cert (static template — Agent 6 cert_html overlay will replace this once polled)
  document.getElementById('dcUrn').textContent = bundle.bundle_urn || '—';
  document.getElementById('dcHash').textContent = data.bundle_hash || '—';
  document.getElementById('dcAnchor').textContent = data.chain_anchor || '—';
  document.getElementById('dcSig').textContent = data.bundle_signature || '—';
  document.getElementById('dcVerdict').textContent = passing ? 'PASS · live' : 'NEEDS REVIEW · live';
  DEMO_CERT.classList.add('visible');
  setMode('done', '✓ DONE · LIVE', `signed bundle issued`, 'COMPLETED');
  // v0.10.0b: coverage line shows honest verified-count vs total claims found.
  const totalClaims = (bundle.claims && bundle.claims.length) ? bundle.claims.length : audits.length;
  setCoverage('completed', `Verified ${audits.length} of ${totalClaims} claims · ${passing ? 'PASS' : 'NEEDS REVIEW'} · signed bundle below`);
  // v0.10.1c Phase C: final perimeter glow state — moss for PASS, amber for FAIL/NEEDS REVIEW.
  setStage(passing ? 'done-pass' : 'done-fail');

  // v0.8.0: continue polling for Agent 6 (cert_html) + Agent 7 (second_opinion)
  // since they attach AFTER status=completed. Show them as they arrive.
  // v0.10.0b: STATUS.textContent calls removed — never defined, threw ReferenceError
  // silently since v0.8.4. Coverage-line updates replace them via setCoverage().
  streamAdd('waiting for Agent 6 (Cert Composer)…', 'dim');
  streamAdd('waiting for Agent 7 (Second Opinion) · ~15-20s w/ Google Search grounding', 'dim');
  // Insert a visible composing banner inside the cert pane
  const cert = document.getElementById('demoCert');
  if (cert && !cert.querySelector('.composing-banner')) {
    const banner = document.createElement('div');
    banner.className = 'composing-banner';
    banner.style.cssText = 'margin-top:14px;padding:10px 14px;background:var(--surface-2);border-left:3px solid var(--electric);font:500 11px/1.5 var(--mono);color:var(--electric);letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;animation:pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;';
    banner.innerHTML = '🔄 Agent 6 composing branded cert · Agent 7 running adversarial Second Opinion…';
    cert.appendChild(banner);
  }
  pollForAgent6and7(data.task_id || _currentTaskId);
}

let _currentTaskId = null;

async function pollForAgent6and7(taskId) {
  if (!taskId) return;
  let renderedCert = false, renderedSO = false;
  for (let i = 0; i < 30 && (!renderedCert || !renderedSO); i++) {
    await sleep(2500);
    try {
      const r = await fetch(`/a2a/v1/tasks/get/${taskId}`);
      if (!r.ok) break;
      const d = await r.json();
      if (!renderedCert && d.cert_html) {
        // v0.10.2 H.toggle: pass real URN to renderCertHtml so the bundle-link
        // in the cert footer routes to THIS task's signed bundle, not the cached one.
        renderCertHtml(d.cert_html, d.bundle_urn);
        // v0.10.3 ISSUE 1: reveal the external result-report section so the
        // cert appears as a full-width independent surface below the hero.
        showResultReport();
        renderedCert = true;
        streamAdd(`✓ Agent 6 (Cert Composer) delivered · ${d.cert_html.length} bytes of branded cert (Gemini 2.5 Pro)`, 'ok', 'composer');
        setCoverage('completed', `Cert composed · full report below · Agent 7 running adversarial Second Opinion…`);
      }
      if (!renderedSO && d.second_opinion) {
        renderSecondOpinion(d.second_opinion);
        renderedSO = true;
        const overall = (d.second_opinion.overall_verdict || '').toUpperCase();
        const tests = d.second_opinion.tests || [];
        const survived = tests.filter(t=>(t.verdict||'').toUpperCase()==='SURVIVES').length;
        const soTone = overall==='CONFIRMS' ? 'ok' : overall==='UNAVAILABLE' ? 'warn' : 'err';
        const soLine = overall==='UNAVAILABLE'
          ? `⚠ Agent 7 (Second Opinion) unavailable · base 5+1-agent bundle stands without adversarial confirmation`
          : `✓ Agent 7 (Second Opinion) delivered · ${overall} · ${survived}/${tests.length} stress tests survived`;
        streamAdd(soLine, soTone);
        setCoverage('completed', `All 7 agents complete · Second Opinion: ${overall}`);
      }
    } catch (_) { break; }
  }
}

function renderCertHtml(html, urn=null) {
  // v0.10.3 ISSUE 1: cert renders into the EXTERNAL <section class="result-report">
  // below the hero (not the in-container .demo-cert pane).
  // The in-container demoCert is kept for legacy paths but display:none in CSS.
  const u = urn || 'urn:pcec:claim:syrz7izwfbatx6go2hgn2ipy';
  const body = document.getElementById('resultBody');
  if (body) body.innerHTML = html;
  const urnPill = document.getElementById('resultUrnPill');
  if (urnPill) urnPill.textContent = u;
  const bundleLink = document.getElementById('resultBundleLink');
  if (bundleLink) bundleLink.href = '/pcec/v0/claim/' + encodeURIComponent(u);
  // Keep the legacy demoCert.visible call for any orphan paths that still
  // check it as a state signal — CSS hides it regardless.
  const legacy = document.getElementById('demoCert');
  if (legacy) legacy.classList.add('visible');
}

/* v0.10.3 ISSUE 1: reveal the full-width result-report section below the hero.
 * Called from cachedCycle / runMesh at the moment the verdict lands so the
 * full cert report appears immediately. Scrolls into view after a short delay
 * so the user sees the diagram's done state before the page jumps.
 * v0.10.3 codex-2: store the timer on window so resetDemo() can cancel it
 * — prevents a fast Replay from yanking the page to a now-hidden section. */
function showResultReport() {
  const sec = document.getElementById('result');
  if (!sec) return;
  sec.hidden = false;
  if (window._resultScrollTimer) clearTimeout(window._resultScrollTimer);
  window._resultScrollTimer = setTimeout(() => {
    // Re-check the section is still visible (in case resetDemo flipped hidden=true
    // between this setTimeout and now without clearing the timer fast enough)
    if (!sec.hidden) {
      sec.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' });
    }
    window._resultScrollTimer = null;
  }, 1200);
}

// pulse animation for the composing banner
(function _injectPulseKeyframe(){
  if (document.getElementById('_pulse_kf')) return;
  const s = document.createElement('style');
  s.id = '_pulse_kf';
  s.textContent = '@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0.55}}';
  document.head.appendChild(s);
})();

function renderSecondOpinion(so) {
  // v0.10.3 ISSUE 1: Second Opinion now lands inside the external
  // result-report section (#resultSecondOpinion), not the hidden demoCert pane.
  const cert = document.getElementById('resultSecondOpinion');
  if (!cert) return;
  cert.hidden = false;
  cert.innerHTML = ''; // replace on replay rather than accumulate
  const overall = (so.overall_verdict || '').toUpperCase();
  const summary = so.summary || '';
  const tests = so.tests || [];
  const survived = tests.filter(t => (t.verdict||'').toUpperCase()==='SURVIVES').length;
  const total = tests.length;
  const wrap = document.createElement('div');
  wrap.style.cssText = 'margin-top:14px;padding:14px 16px;background:var(--surface-2);border:1px solid var(--electric);border-radius:6px;font:500 11px/1.6 var(--mono);color:var(--ink);';
  const verdictColor = overall === 'CONFIRMS' ? 'var(--moss-glow)' : overall === 'UNAVAILABLE' ? 'var(--muted)' : 'var(--warning)';
  let testsHtml = tests.map(t => {
    const v = (t.verdict||'').toUpperCase();
    const c = v === 'SURVIVES' ? 'var(--moss-glow)' : 'var(--warning)';
    return `<div style="padding:6px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--border);"><span style="color:var(--electric);font-weight:700;">${t.name||'—'}</span> · <span style="color:${c};font-weight:600;">${v}</span><div style="color:var(--muted);font:400 11px/1.4 var(--sans);margin-top:2px;">${escapeHtml(t.rationale||'')}</div></div>`;
  }).join('');
  wrap.innerHTML = `
    <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:baseline;margin-bottom:10px;">
      <div style="color:var(--electric);font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0.18em;text-transform:uppercase;">Second Opinion · adversarial validation</div>
      <div style="color:${verdictColor};font-weight:700;">${overall} · ${survived}/${total}</div>
    </div>
    <div style="font:400 12.5px/1.55 var(--sans);color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:10px;">${escapeHtml(summary)}</div>
    <details><summary style="cursor:pointer;color:var(--electric);font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:0.16em;text-transform:uppercase;">View stress-test details</summary>
      <div style="margin-top:8px;">${testsHtml}</div>
      ${so.strongest_counter ? `<div style="margin-top:10px;padding:10px;background:var(--bg);border-left:3px solid var(--signal);font:400 12px/1.5 var(--sans);color:var(--muted);"><b style="color:var(--signal);">Strongest counter-argument:</b> ${escapeHtml(so.strongest_counter)}</div>` : ''}
    </details>
  `;
  cert.appendChild(wrap);
}

function escapeHtml(s) {
  return String(s||'').replace(/[&<>"']/g, c => ({ '&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
}

/* ============================================================
 * v0.10.0b / codex A6: Verify-button hover preview.
 * Mouse-enter on Verify flashes the 7 agent chips in stage order
 * over ~700ms — gives buyers/judges a 1-sec peek at what's about
 * to happen without committing to autoplay.
 * ============================================================ */
let _previewActive = false;
// 2026-05-25 (Omar A-v3+): the in-hero RUN_BTN was removed with the brand
// drawer cleanup. If it does not exist, skip this hover preview — it was
// only meaningful when the in-hero demo widget existed too.
if (RUN_BTN) RUN_BTN.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
  if (demoMode === 'live' || demoMode === 'replay' || _previewActive) return;
  // Don't preview if a cycle is currently in progress / completed (state would clash).
  const nodes = Array.from(DEMO_NODES.querySelectorAll('.node'));
  if (nodes.some(n => n.classList.contains('active') || n.classList.contains('done'))) return;
  _previewActive = true;
  let i = 0;
  const tick = () => {
    if (i > 0) nodes[i-1].classList.remove('preview-on');
    if (i >= nodes.length) {
      nodes.forEach(n => n.classList.remove('preview-on'));
      _previewActive = false;
      return;
    }
    nodes[i].classList.add('preview-on');
    i++;
    setTimeout(tick, 95);
  };
  tick();
});
