.scene-4 .product-info .rating { font: 500 13px var(--sans); color: var(--v-dim); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.scene-4 .product-info .rating .stars { color: #E8A92F; letter-spacing: 1px; }
.scene-4 .product-info .claims { background: var(--v-bg-card); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; margin-bottom: 24px; }
.scene-4 .product-info .claims-head { font: 600 10px var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--v-muted); margin-bottom: 10px; }
.scene-4 .product-info .claims ul { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; font: 400 13px/1.7 var(--sans); color: var(--v-text); }
.scene-4 .product-info .claims li::before { content: "✓ "; color: var(--v-sage); font-weight: 700; }
.scene-4 .product-info .buy-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; }
.scene-4 .buy-btn {
  flex: 1;
  background: var(--v-primary); color: #FFF;
  font: 600 15px var(--sans);
  padding: 18px 24px; border-radius: 12px;
  border: 0; cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(196,74,74,0.22);
}
.scene-4 .heart-btn { width: 56px; height: 56px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--v-line-strong); border-radius: 12px; font-size: 18px; cursor: pointer; }

/* Checkout overlay */
.checkout-overlay {
  position: fixed; inset: 0;
  background: rgba(43,31,18,0.45);
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: center;
  /* 2026-05-24 (Omar): the Model B receipt makes this card taller than the
     viewport. Allow vertical scroll inside the overlay; reserve ~110px at
     the bottom so the floating Prev/Next nav bar (position:fixed bottom:22px
     plus ~50px height) never overlaps the "View the signed bundle" action. */
  padding: 32px 20px 110px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  opacity: 0; visibility: hidden;
  transition: opacity 280ms, visibility 0ms 280ms;
  z-index: 100;
}
.scene-4.checkout .checkout-overlay { opacity: 1; visibility: visible; transition-delay: 0ms; }
.checkout-card {
  width: 100%; max-width: 440px;
  background: var(--v-bg-elev);
  border-radius: 18px;
  padding: 28px;
  box-shadow: 0 30px 80px rgba(43,31,18,0.30);
  transform: translateY(20px); opacity: 0;
  transition: all 320ms cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1);
}
.scene-4.checkout .checkout-card { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
.checkout-card .co-head { font: 600 12px var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--v-muted); margin-bottom: 8px; }
.checkout-card .co-title { font: 600 22px var(--serif); color: var(--v-text); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.checkout-card .co-sub { font: 400 13px var(--sans); color: var(--v-dim); margin-bottom: 18px; }
.checkout-card .co-line { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; font: 500 13px var(--sans); color: var(--v-text); padding: 8px 0; }
.checkout-card .co-line.total { border-top: 1px solid var(--v-line); margin-top: 6px; padding-top: 12px; font-weight: 700; }
.checkout-card .pay-options { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; margin-top: 18px; }
.pay-btn {
  width: 100%;
  font: 600 14px var(--sans);
  padding: 14px;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: 1px solid var(--v-line-strong);
  background: var(--v-bg-elev); color: var(--v-text);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
}
.pay-btn:hover { background: var(--v-bg-card); }
.pay-btn.primary { background: #1A1A1A; color: #FFF; border-color: #1A1A1A; }
.pay-btn.primary:hover { background: #000; }
.pay-btn.processing { background: var(--v-bg-card); color: var(--v-muted); cursor: wait; }
.pay-btn .spin { width: 14px; height: 14px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-top-color: #FFF; animation: spin 600ms linear infinite; }
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

.scene-4.confirmed .checkout-card .co-pay { display: none; }
.confirm-block { display: none; text-align: center; }
.scene-4.confirmed .confirm-block { display: block; }
.confirm-block .check {
  width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--v-sage); color: #FFF;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  margin: 0 auto 16px; font: 700 26px var(--sans);
  animation: pop-in 400ms cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1);
}
@keyframes pop-in {
  0% { transform: scale(0.4); opacity: 0; }
  60% { transform: scale(1.1); }
  100% { transform: scale(1); opacity: 1; }
}
.confirm-block .confirm-title { font: 600 22px var(--serif); color: var(--v-text); margin-bottom: 6px; }
.confirm-block .confirm-sub { font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--sans); color: var(--v-dim); margin-bottom: 18px; }
.confirm-block .pc-footer {
  background: rgba(111,174,122,0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(111,174,122,0.20);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 12px 14px;
  font: 500 12px/1.5 var(--sans);
  color: var(--v-text);
  text-align: left;
  display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px;
}
.confirm-block .pc-footer .seal {
  width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--pc-moss); color: #FFF;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font: 700 10px var(--mono);
  margin-top: 1px;
}
.confirm-block .pc-footer b { color: var(--pc-moss); }

/* Model B (2026-05-24 prototype): dual-signed PCEC purchase receipt.
   Auto-renders after the confirmation. Styled as a Stripe-style receipt
   with a PawConscious co-sign section at the bottom. */
.receipt-card {
  display: none;
  margin-top: 22px;
  padding: 22px 24px;
  background: #FFF;
  border: 1px solid var(--v-line);
  border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  text-align: left;
  opacity: 0; transform: translateY(8px);
  transition: opacity 480ms 220ms, transform 480ms 220ms;
}
.scene-4.confirmed .receipt-card { display: block; opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
.receipt-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; margin-bottom: 18px; }
.receipt-brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.receipt-logo { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
.receipt-title { font: 700 14px var(--sans); color: var(--v-text); letter-spacing: -0.005em; }
.receipt-sub { font: 500 11.5px var(--mono); color: var(--v-dim); letter-spacing: 0.04em; margin-top: 2px; }
.receipt-stripe {
  font: 600 10px var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: #635BFF;
  padding: 5px 10px;
  background: rgba(99, 91, 255, 0.08);
  border-radius: 5px;
}
.receipt-lines { border-top: 1px solid var(--v-line); padding-top: 12px; }
.receipt-line {
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between;
  font: 500 13px var(--sans); color: var(--v-text);
  padding: 6px 0;
}
.receipt-line.total {
  margin-top: 6px; padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--v-line);
  font-weight: 700;
}
.receipt-pc {
  margin-top: 18px; padding: 16px 18px;
  background: rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.05);
  border: 1px solid rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.22);
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.receipt-pc-row { display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: flex-start; }
.receipt-pc-seal {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 22px; height: 22px;
  background: var(--pc-moss);
  color: #FFF;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 50%;
  font: 700 12px var(--sans);
}
.receipt-pc-copy { flex: 1; }
.receipt-pc-title { font: 600 13px var(--sans); color: var(--v-text); margin-bottom: 4px; }
.receipt-pc-title b { color: var(--pc-moss); }
.receipt-pc-line { font: 400 12px/1.5 var(--sans); color: var(--v-dim); }
.receipt-pc-anchor {
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding-top: 12px;
  border-top: 1px dashed rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.25);
  display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.receipt-pc-anchor .anchor-label {
  font: 600 9.5px var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--pc-moss);
}
.receipt-pc-anchor .anchor-value {
  font: 500 11px var(--mono); color: var(--v-dim);
  word-break: break-all;
}
.receipt-pc-actions {
  margin-top: 12px;
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
  flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px;
}
.receipt-action {
  font: 600 11.5px var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  color: var(--pc-moss);
  text-decoration: none;
}
.receipt-action:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
.receipt-disclosure {
  font: 500 10px var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  color: var(--v-dim);
}
.confirm-block .pc-footer .anchor {
  display: block; margin-top: 4px;
  font: 500 10px/1.4 var(--mono); color: var(--v-dim);
  word-break: break-all;
}

/* ============================================================
   STACK STRIPE — always-on tech-judge footer (2026-05-24)
   ============================================================ */
.stack-stripe {
  position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
  height: 28px;
  padding: 0 18px;
  background: rgba(248,248,250,0.94);
  border-top: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  gap: 6px;
  z-index: 198;
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px) saturate(140%);
  overflow-x: auto;
  scrollbar-width: none;
}
.stack-stripe::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.stack-stripe .stack-label {
  font: 600 9px var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: rgba(0,0,0,0.42);
  margin-right: 4px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.stack-stripe .stack-chip {
  font: 500 10.5px var(--mono);
  color: rgba(0,0,0,0.62);
  background: #FFF;
  border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  padding: 3px 8px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  letter-spacing: 0.02em;
}

/* ============================================================
   CONTROLS — manual click-through bar
   ============================================================ */
.controls {
  /* 2026-05-24 night: nudged up so the stack-stripe (28px tall at bottom: 0)
     sits below cleanly. Was bottom: 22px → now bottom: 42px. */
  position: fixed; bottom: 42px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px;
  padding: 9px 16px;
  background: rgba(20,20,20,0.86);
  backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(140%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.10);
  border-radius: 100px;
  z-index: 200;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
}
.controls .btn {
  background: transparent; border: 0; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);
  font: 500 12px var(--mono); padding: 6px 10px; cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 100px; min-width: 28px; justify-content: center;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
  transition: all 200ms;
}
.controls .btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); color: #FFF; }
/* 2026-05-24 night: visible flash on click so the button feels responsive
   even when the scene change is brief or already on-screen. */
.controls .btn.flash {
  background: rgba(155,114,203,0.32);
  color: #FFF;
  transition: background 80ms;
}
/* Next button gets the Gemini brand treatment so it visually matches the
   in-scene "Click to ..." CTAs. Users learn one pattern: gradient = advance. */
.controls .btn#nextBtn {
  background: var(--g-grad); color: #FFF; font-weight: 600;
  padding: 7px 14px;
}
.controls .btn#nextBtn:hover { background: var(--g-grad); filter: brightness(1.1); }
.controls .dots { display: flex; gap: 6px; padding: 0 6px; border-left: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); border-right: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); }
.controls .dot { width: 22px; height: 3px; border-radius: 2px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18); cursor: pointer; transition: background 220ms; }
.controls .dot.active { background: var(--pc-electric); }
.controls .dot.done { background: var(--pc-moss); }

@media (max-width: 1100px) {
  .gem-app { grid-template-columns: 0 1fr; }
  .gem-sidebar { display: none; }
}

/* ===========================================================
 * SECTION 4 — scene-2b "block" scene. Mirrors scene-2's bento
 * layout but every card flips to BLOCKED state for the Native
 * Pet 60% anxiety claim. Codex-approved design 2026-05-23.
 * =========================================================== */
.scene-2b { display: none; }
.scene-2b.active { display: block; }

/* 2026-05-24 evening: scene-3 (Gemini recommendation) is no longer
   shown in the cinematic. The HTML stays in the DOM for runners-array
   contract continuity but never renders. The Verified Browser scene
   carries the brand-choice beat scene-3 used to convey. */
.scene-3 { display: none !important; }

/* SCENE POOL (2026-05-24): Verified Browser. Plays after BLOCK, before
 * VERIFY. Marketplace-style visual grid of verified alternatives. Sub-
 * state of scene-2 (no dedicated dot in the navigation). */
.scene-pool { display: none; background: #FAFAFB; }
.scene-pool.active { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 32px 24px; }
.pool-frame {
  width: 100%; max-width: 1080px;
  background: #FFF;
  border: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 28px 32px 24px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
}
.pool-chrome { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 22px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.pool-mark { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 600 14px var(--sans); color: var(--g-text); }
.pool-mark .star { width: 16px; height: 16px; }
.pool-mark b { font-weight: 700; }
.pool-meta { font: 500 11.5px var(--mono); color: var(--g-dim); letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.pool-meta .pool-sep { margin: 0 6px; }
.pool-meta .pool-disclosure { color: var(--g-dim); }
.pool-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 12px;
}
/* 2026-05-24 night: 15-card grid in 3 rows. Slightly smaller cards so all
   15 fit one viewport without scroll. */
.pool-grid-15 {
  grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr);
  grid-template-rows: repeat(3, auto);
  gap: 10px;
}
.pool-card {
  position: relative;
  background: #FFF;
  border: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: 10px;
  padding: 10px;
  text-decoration: none; color: inherit;
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  transition: all 0.18s ease;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.pool-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--pc-moss);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.12);
}
.pool-card.real {
  border-color: rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.6);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.05), #FFF 40%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.22);
}
.pool-img-wrap {
  height: 78px;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FBF7EE 0%, #F2EBDD 100%);
  border-radius: 6px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 7px;
}
.pool-img-wrap img { max-height: 100%; max-width: 100%; object-fit: contain; }
.pool-body { display: flex; flex-direction: column; flex: 1; }
.pool-name { font: 600 12px var(--sans); color: var(--g-text); margin-bottom: 2px; }
.pool-sub { font: 400 10.5px/1.35 var(--sans); color: var(--g-dim); margin-bottom: 7px; flex: 1; }
.pool-stats { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; font: 600 11px var(--mono); }
.pool-stats .pool-price { color: var(--g-text); }
/* 2026-05-24 night /devex-review: removed fabricated "trust 94/91/88"
   numbers. PawConscious is binary verified-or-not, no numerical rubric.
   Cards now show a green ✓ verified chip instead. */
.pool-stats .pool-verified {
  color: var(--pc-moss);
  font: 600 10px var(--mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
}
.pool-card .pool-tag {
  position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px;
  font: 600 8.5px var(--mono);
  color: #8C5A12;
  background: rgba(229, 165, 60, 0.10);
  border: 1px solid rgba(229, 165, 60, 0.32);
  padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 3px;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  z-index: 2;
}
.pool-footer {
  margin-top: 22px;
  display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.pool-pagination { font: 500 11px var(--mono); color: var(--g-dim); letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.pool-actions { display: flex; gap: 10px; align-items: center; }
.pool-refresh {
  padding: 8px 14px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px solid var(--g-line);
  border-radius: 6px;
  font: 500 11.5px var(--mono);
  color: var(--g-muted);
  letter-spacing: 0.04em;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.18s ease;
}
.pool-refresh:hover { border-color: var(--pc-moss); color: var(--pc-moss); }

/* 2026-05-24 evening: pool primary CTA gets the rainbow gradient that
   matches the cinematic's other primary CTAs (was rendering as a flat
   dark button because .advance-cta gradient was scoped to .post-tool-row). */
.pool-actions .pool-cta,
.pool-actions .advance-cta {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  background: var(--g-grad); color: #FFF;
  font: 600 13px var(--sans);
  padding: 11px 20px;
  border: 0; border-radius: 100px;
  cursor: pointer;
  box-shadow: 0 8px 22px rgba(155,114,203,0.30);
  transition: transform 200ms, box-shadow 200ms, filter 200ms;
}
.pool-actions .pool-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); filter: brightness(1.05); }
.pool-actions .pool-cta .arrow { transition: transform 200ms; }
.pool-actions .pool-cta:hover .arrow { transform: translateX(3px); }

/* Card "selected" state after the pointer clicks it during the autonomous
   pool journey. Pulses briefly to communicate "this is what we picked". */
.pool-card.selected {
  border-color: var(--pc-moss);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.35), 0 12px 28px rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.18);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* Grid refresh state — quick fade-out then in to suggest "new feed loaded" */
.pool-grid.refreshing {
  animation: poolRefresh 800ms ease;
}
@keyframes poolRefresh {
  0%   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
  35%  { opacity: 0.35; transform: translateY(6px); }
  65%  { opacity: 0.35; transform: translateY(-6px); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

/* 2026-05-24 night /devex-review pass: the two-page cycling pattern was
   replaced with a single 15-card grid (faster, more honest, more impactful
   visually). Page-2 swap CSS removed. */

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  .pool-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}
@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .pool-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
}

/* Header status pill for BLOCKED */
.scene-2b .tool-use-card .tool-use-status {
  background: rgba(229, 80, 80, 0.12);
  color: #E55050;
  border-color: rgba(229, 80, 80, 0.28);
}
.scene-2b .tool-use-title b { color: #B83434; }

/* Block card styling — red borders + warning palette */
.scene-2b .bento.light .b-card.block.done {
  background: #FFF6F6;
  border-color: rgba(229, 80, 80, 0.32);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(229, 80, 80, 0.08);
}
.scene-2b .bento.light .b-card.block.done .head .badge {
  background: rgba(229, 80, 80, 0.10); color: #B83434;
}
.scene-2b .bento.light .b-card.block.done .latency { color: #B83434; }
.scene-2b .bento.light .b-card.block.done .latency::before { background: #E55050; }

/* Block-specific card contents */
.scene-2b .ev-item.mismatch .tag {
  background: rgba(229, 80, 80, 0.12); color: #B83434;
}
.scene-2b .vet-score.fail { color: #B83434; }
.scene-2b .ftc-result.fail { color: #B83434; font-weight: 600; }
.scene-2b .sign-key.fail { color: #B83434; }
.scene-2b .sign-hash.fail { color: #B83434; opacity: 0.85; }

/* Placeholder tag — visible honest disclosure that this part of the
   cinematic is synthetic. 2026-05-24: bumped from 9px / very low contrast
   to 10.5px / amber border so a skimming judge sees it. Better to
   over-disclose than to be caught looking like we're hiding it. */
.scene-2b .placeholder-tag {
  display: inline-block;
  margin-left: 6px;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: rgba(229, 165, 60, 0.10);
  color: #8C5A12;
  border: 1px solid rgba(229, 165, 60, 0.35);
  font: 600 10px/1 var(--mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

/* Synthetic-content disclosure banner. 2026-05-24 evening: compressed
   to free vertical space on the BLOCK scene so it fits one viewport. */
.scene-2b .synthetic-banner {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  padding: 5px 10px;
  background: rgba(229, 165, 60, 0.08);
  border: 1px solid rgba(229, 165, 60, 0.30);
  border-radius: 6px;
  font: 500 10.5px/1.4 var(--sans);
  color: #8C5A12;
}
.scene-2b .synthetic-banner b { color: #5F3A02; font-weight: 700; }

/* Block banner — the "Single-agent claim. Mesh blocks it." card */
/* 2026-05-24 evening: block-banner compressed. Smaller seal, tighter
   padding, smaller body font. Frees vertical space for the CTA below. */
.scene-2b .block-banner {
  margin-top: 8px;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #FFF8F8 0%, #FFF 100%);
  border: 1px solid rgba(229, 80, 80, 0.22);
  border-left: 3px solid #E55050;
  border-radius: 8px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
  gap: 10px;
  align-items: center;
}
.scene-2b .block-banner .seal {
  width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 12px;
  background: #E55050; color: #fff;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
  font: 700 14px/1 var(--sans);
}
.scene-2b .block-banner .copy {
  font: 500 12px/1.45 var(--sans); color: var(--g-text);
}
.scene-2b .block-banner .headline {
  font: 700 12.5px/1.4 var(--sans); color: #B83434;
  margin-bottom: 2px;
}
.scene-2b .block-banner .replacement {
  margin-top: 6px;
  padding-top: 8px;
  border-top: 1px dashed rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
  font: 500 13px/1.5 var(--sans); color: var(--g-text);
}
.scene-2b .block-banner .replacement code {
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
  padding: 1px 6px;
  border-radius: 4px;
  font: 500 12px/1.4 var(--mono);
  color: var(--g-text);
}

/* Verified-pool widget (2026-05-24): surfaces the future-state placement-
 * bidding mechanism. 1 real public-COA brand (Green Gruff EASE) + 4
 * synthetic example brands, all disclosed honestly via the "example"
 * chip and the header disclosure line. Shown only on BLOCK scene. */
.scene-2b .verified-pool {
  margin-top: 20px;
  padding: 16px 18px;
  background: rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.04);
  border: 1px solid rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.18);
  border-radius: 10px;
}
.scene-2b .vp-head {
  display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: space-between;
  margin-bottom: 12px; gap: 12px;
}
.scene-2b .vp-eyebrow {
  font: 600 11px var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--pc-moss);
}
.scene-2b .vp-disclosure { font: 500 10px var(--mono); color: var(--g-dim); letter-spacing: 0.04em; }
.scene-2b .vp-grid {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); gap: 8px;
}
.scene-2b .vp-card {
  position: relative; padding: 11px 12px;
  background: #FFF; border: 1px solid var(--g-line); border-radius: 7px;
  cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.18s ease;
  text-decoration: none; color: inherit; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
}
.scene-2b .vp-card:hover {
  border-color: var(--pc-moss);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.12);
}
.scene-2b .vp-card.real {
  border-color: rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.55);
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.06), #FFF 50%);
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.22);
}
.scene-2b .vp-card .vp-name { font: 600 12px var(--sans); color: var(--g-text); margin-bottom: 3px; }
.scene-2b .vp-card .vp-meta { font: 400 10.5px/1.4 var(--sans); color: var(--g-dim); margin-bottom: 8px; flex: 1; }
.scene-2b .vp-card .vp-stats { font: 500 10.5px var(--mono); color: var(--g-text); display: flex; justify-content: space-between; }
.scene-2b .vp-card .vp-stats .trust { color: var(--pc-moss); font-weight: 600; }
.scene-2b .vp-card .vp-tag {
  position: absolute; top: 6px; right: 6px;
  font: 600 8.5px var(--mono);
  color: #8C5A12;
  background: rgba(229, 165, 60, 0.10);
  border: 1px solid rgba(229, 165, 60, 0.28);
  padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 3px;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
}
.scene-2b .vp-more {
  margin-top: 12px;
  padding: 7px 13px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px dashed var(--pc-moss);
  border-radius: 6px;
  font: 500 11px var(--mono);
  color: var(--pc-moss);
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  cursor: pointer;
}
.scene-2b .vp-more:hover { background: rgba(99, 154, 96, 0.06); }

@media (max-width: 900px) {
  .scene-2b .vp-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
}

/* CTA pair on scene-2b. 2026-05-24 fix: base .post-tool-row sets
 * opacity:0 and only .scene-2.complete activates it. Scene-2b had no
 * equivalent activator so the BLOCK CTAs stayed invisible. Explicitly
 * unhide here, the bento animation already provides the "now click this"
 * moment via the pointer hint. */
.scene-2b .post-tool-row {
  display: flex; gap: 12px; align-items: center;
  margin-top: 14px;
  opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0);
}
.scene-2b .advance-cta.secondary {
  background: transparent;
  color: var(--g-muted);
  border: 1px solid var(--g-line);
}
.scene-2b .advance-cta.secondary:hover {
  background: var(--g-bg-soft);
  color: var(--g-text);
}

/* ===========================================================
 * SECTION 5 — Judge Mode overlay. Adds a per-card strip naming
 * the framework / tool each agent uses. Default OFF on the live
 * URL. Activates via body.judge-mode (set by ?judge=1 query param,
 * the bottom-right toggle, or localStorage). Sync-fades with the
 * card .active animation so labels light up as agents fire.
 * =========================================================== */
/* 2026-05-24: per-card stack labels are now ALWAYS-ON. Previously gated
 * by body.judge-mode and the bottom-right toggle, both removed. The
 * labels show the Google tool driving each agent (ADK LlmAgent, BioMCP
 * PubMed, Document AI OCR, etc.) and earn their keep on every render. */
.judge-label {
  display: block;
  font: 600 10px/1 var(--mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.10em;
  padding: 5px 8px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  border-left: 2px solid var(--g-muted);
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  color: var(--g-muted);
  opacity: 0.4;
  transition: opacity 320ms, color 320ms, border-color 320ms;
}
.bento .b-card.active .judge-label,
.bento .b-card.done .judge-label {
  opacity: 1; color: var(--g-text);
}
/* Per-stage accent colors */
.bento .b-card.b-claim.active .judge-label,
.bento .b-card.b-claim.done .judge-label {
  border-color: #6B5BD2; color: #4A3FB0;
}
.bento .b-card.b-evidence.active .judge-label,
.bento .b-card.b-evidence.done .judge-label {
  border-color: #00B5DC; color: #007A95;
}
.bento .b-card.b-vet.active .judge-label,
.bento .b-card.b-vet.done .judge-label {
  border-color: #C8920E; color: #7A5A09;
}
.bento .b-card.b-ftc.active .judge-label,
.bento .b-card.b-ftc.done .judge-label {
  border-color: #4185F4; color: #1A5DD0;
}
.bento .b-card.b-lab.active .judge-label,
.bento .b-card.b-lab.done .judge-label {
  border-color: #34A853; color: #1E6B33;
}
.bento .b-card.b-sign.active .judge-label,
.bento .b-card.b-sign.done .judge-label {
  border-color: #6FAE7A; color: #467850;
}
/* Block-state labels keep red palette consistent with the BLOCK scene */
.scene-2b .bento.light .b-card.block.done .judge-label {
  border-color: #E55050; color: #B83434;
}

/* Show-stack toggle button and footer band removed 2026-05-24:
 * - The toggle button was opaque internal vocabulary ("Judge Mode") and
 *   later "Show stack" still required user discovery.
 * - The footer band was position:fixed and clipped the BLOCK scene's CTA.
 * - Stack labels now always-on (per-card chips above each bento agent).
 * Compatibility selectors kept as no-ops so any stale markup still hides. */
.judge-toggle, .judge-footer { display: none !important; }

/* Scene-2 secondary CTA — "Show me a claim we BLOCK" */
.scene-2 .show-block-link {
  margin-left: 14px;
  padding: 8px 14px;
  background: transparent;
  border: 1px dashed rgba(229, 80, 80, 0.40);
  color: #B83434;
  border-radius: 8px;
  font: 600 12px/1 var(--mono);
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: background 200ms, transform 180ms;
}
.scene-2 .show-block-link:hover {
  background: rgba(229, 80, 80, 0.06);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}
.scene-2:not(.complete) .show-block-link { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
.scene-2.complete .show-block-link { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; transition: opacity 400ms 300ms; }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<svg class="gstar-grad" aria-hidden="true">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="gstarGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4285F4"/>
      <stop offset="50%" stop-color="#9B72CB"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#D96570"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
</svg>

<div class="stage" id="stage" data-world="llm">

  <!-- =========================================================
       SCENE 0 — combined cinematic intro
       macOS desktop → click Chrome → URL types → Gemini loads →
       query types → "Click to ask Gemini" tooltip
       ========================================================= -->
  <section class="scene scene-0" data-scene="0">

    <!-- Skip intro: top-right corner CTA, jumps straight to query-armed state -->
    <button class="skip-intro" id="skipIntroBtn">Skip intro <span class="arrow">→</span></button>

    <!-- macOS menu bar -->
    <div class="mac-menubar">
      <span class="apple"></span>
      <span class="menu-item">Finder</span>
      <span class="menu-item">File</span>
      <span class="menu-item">Edit</span>
      <span class="menu-item">View</span>
      <span class="menu-item">Window</span>
      <span class="menu-item">Help</span>
      <div class="right-cluster">
        <span>🔋</span><span>🔆</span><span>🔍</span>
        <span class="clock">Fri 22 May 6:24 PM</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Desktop wallpaper + dock -->
    <div class="mac-desktop">
      <div class="mac-desktop-icons">
        <div class="desk-icon"><div class="glyph">📁</div><div>Projects</div></div>
        <div class="desk-icon"><div class="glyph">📸</div><div>Screenshots</div></div>
      </div>
      <div class="mac-dock">
        <div class="app finder" title="Finder">🗂</div>
        <div class="app mail" title="Mail">✉</div>
        <div class="app safari" title="Safari">🧭</div>
        <div class="app notes" title="Notes">📝</div>
        <div class="app spotify" title="Spotify">♫</div>
        <div class="app slack" title="Slack">⌗</div>
        <div class="app chrome" id="dock-chrome" title="Google Chrome"></div>
        <div class="app trash" title="Trash">🗑</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Chrome window (appears after click) -->
    <div class="chrome-window" id="chromeWindow">
      <div class="chrome-bar">
        <div class="chrome-traffic">
          <div class="tl red"></div>
          <div class="tl yellow"></div>
          <div class="tl green"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="chrome-tabs">
          <div class="chrome-tab">
            <svg class="favicon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="url(#gstarGrad)"><path d="M12 2 L14 10 L22 12 L14 14 L12 22 L10 14 L2 12 L10 10 Z"/></svg>
            <span>Gemini</span>
            <span class="x">×</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="chrome-urlbar">
        <div class="nav-btn">‹</div>
        <div class="nav-btn">›</div>
        <div class="nav-btn">↻</div>
        <div class="url-pill" id="urlPill">
          <span class="lock">🔒</span>
          <span class="url-text" id="urlText"></span>
          <span class="url-cursor" id="urlCursor"></span>
        </div>
        <div class="right-icons"><span>⋮</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="chrome-page">
        <div class="loading-bar"></div>
        <!-- Gemini app appears inside the Chrome page once URL types out -->
        <div class="gem-app">
          <aside class="gem-sidebar">
            <div class="top">
              <button class="menu">≡</button>
              <div class="wordmark">Gemini</div>
            </div>
            <button class="new-chat">+ &nbsp;New chat</button>
            <div class="section-label">Recent</div>
            <div class="convo current">Hip and joint chews…</div>
            <div class="convo">Morning routine ideas</div>
            <div class="convo">Boston Marathon split…</div>
            <div class="convo">Q3 OKR draft</div>
            <div class="convo">Trip to Cape Cod</div>
          </aside>
          <main class="gem-main">
            <div class="gem-topbar">
              <div class="model-picker">
                <svg class="star" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="url(#gstarGrad)"><path d="M12 2 L14 10 L22 12 L14 14 L12 22 L10 14 L2 12 L10 10 Z"/></svg>
                <span>Gemini 2.5 Pro</span>
                <span class="chev">▾</span>
              </div>
              <div class="actions"><div class="av">O</div></div>
            </div>
            <div class="gem-hero">
              <div class="greeting">Hello, Omar</div>
            </div>
            <div style="padding: 0 32px 28px; width: 100%; display: flex; justify-content: center; position: relative;">
              <div class="gem-input" id="s0-input">
                <div class="left-icons">
                  <button class="icon-btn">+</button>
                  <button class="icon-btn">⊞</button>
                </div>
                <div class="query-area">
                  <div class="query" id="s0-query"><span class="cursor"></span></div>
                </div>
                <div class="right-icons">
                  <button class="icon-btn">🎤</button>
                  <button class="icon-btn submit-btn" id="s0-submit">↑</button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div class="click-to-ask" id="s0-cta-tip">Click to ask Gemini <span>→</span></div>
            </div>
          </main>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>

  </section>

  <!-- =========================================================
       SCENE 2 — Gemini answering with 3 product candidates
       ========================================================= -->
  <section class="scene scene-1" data-scene="1">
    <div class="gem-app">
      <aside class="gem-sidebar">
        <div class="top"><button class="menu">≡</button><div class="wordmark">Gemini</div></div>
        <button class="new-chat">+ &nbsp;New chat</button>
        <div class="section-label">Recent</div>
        <div class="convo current">Hip and joint chews…</div>
        <div class="convo">Morning routine ideas</div>
        <div class="convo">Boston Marathon split…</div>
        <div class="convo">Q3 OKR draft</div>
      </aside>
      <main class="gem-main">
        <div class="gem-topbar">
          <div class="model-picker">
            <svg class="star" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="url(#gstarGrad)"><path d="M12 2 L14 10 L22 12 L14 14 L12 22 L10 14 L2 12 L10 10 Z"/></svg>
            <span>Gemini 2.5 Pro</span>
            <span class="chev">▾</span>
          </div>
          <div class="actions"><div class="av">O</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="gem-thread">
          <div class="gem-thread-inner">
            <div class="user-msg">What are the best hip and joint soft chews for an older dog with inflammation?</div>
            <div class="assistant-msg">
              <svg class="av" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="url(#gstarGrad)"><path d="M12 2 L14 10 L22 12 L14 14 L12 22 L10 14 L2 12 L10 10 Z"/></svg>
              <div class="body">
                <div class="thinking-row">
                  Searching pet supplements
                  <span class="dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></span>
                </div>
                <div class="text">
                  I found three soft-chew options for older dogs with joint inflammation. Before I recommend one, I'll call <b>PawConscious</b> to verify the evidence and FTC §255 compliance on each.
                </div>
                <div class="products">
                  <div class="product-card">
                    <div class="img-wrap"><img src="/assets/wellpaw-hip-joint.png" alt="MaxJoint Pro" onerror="this.parentElement.innerHTML='<div style=&quot;color:#80868B;font:600 12px monospace&quot;>MaxJoint Pro</div>'"></div>
                    <div class="meta">
                      <div class="name">MaxJoint Pro <span class="placeholder-tag" style="font-size:9px;color:#80868B;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:0.12em;">example</span></div>
                      <div class="brand">"Reverses arthritis in 7 days"</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="row-bottom">
                      <div class="price">$32.99</div>
                      <div class="badge">Checking…</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="product-card">
                    <div class="img-wrap"><img src="/assets/goldenpaw-hip-joint.png" alt="Goldenpaw" onerror="this.parentElement.innerHTML='<div style=&quot;color:#80868B;font:600 12px monospace&quot;>Goldenpaw</div>'"></div>
                    <div class="meta">
                      <div class="name">Joint Care Complex</div>
                      <div class="brand">Goldenpaw · 120 soft chews</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="row-bottom">
                      <div class="price">$36.50</div>
                      <div class="badge">Checking…</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div class="product-card">
                    <div class="img-wrap"><img src="/assets/native-pet-hip-joint-alt-warm.png" alt="Green Gruff EASE" onerror="this.style.display='none'"></div>
                    <div class="meta">
                      <div class="name">Green Gruff EASE · Joint &amp; Hip</div>
                      <div class="brand">Public lab certificate</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="row-bottom">
                      <div class="price">$54.99</div>
                      <div class="badge">Checking…</div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div class="ping-banner">
                  <span class="pulse-dot"></span>
                  <div>Gemini's first pick: the cheapest candidate, <b>MaxJoint Pro</b> ($32.99). Calling <b>PawConscious</b> to verify before recommending.</div>
                  <button class="advance-btn" id="goToPawConscious">Click to verify with PawConscious <span class="arrow">→</span></button>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  </section>

  <!-- =========================================================
       SCENE 3 — PawConscious bento grid
       ========================================================= -->
  <section class="scene scene-2" data-scene="2">
    <div class="gem-app">
      <aside class="gem-sidebar">
        <div class="top"><button class="menu">≡</button><div class="wordmark">Gemini</div></div>
        <button class="new-chat">+ &nbsp;New chat</button>
        <div class="section-label">Recent</div>
        <div class="convo current">Hip and joint chews…</div>
        <div class="convo">Morning routine ideas</div>
        <div class="convo">Boston Marathon split…</div>
        <div class="convo">Q3 OKR draft</div>
      </aside>
      <main class="gem-main">
        <div class="gem-topbar">
          <div class="model-picker">
            <svg class="star" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="url(#gstarGrad)"><path d="M12 2 L14 10 L22 12 L14 14 L12 22 L10 14 L2 12 L10 10 Z"/></svg>
            <span>Gemini 2.5 Pro</span>
            <span class="chev">▾</span>
          </div>
          <div class="actions"><div class="av">O</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="gem-thread">

<!-- Show-stack toggle removed 2026-05-24. Stack labels are now always-on
     (see .judge-label CSS). -->


<script>
// Show-stack toggle removed 2026-05-24. Per-card stack labels are
// always visible (see .judge-label CSS, no body class condition).

// Path B (2026-05-24): the cinematic now defaults to BLOCK first on the
// hip-joint scenario, then routes to the verified alternative (Green Gruff
// EASE). The prior `?intro=block` URL-param swap that re-skinned the cold
// open to a calming-chews flow is removed; the new default IS the block
// flow. Single canonical query.
const QUERY = "What are the best hip and joint soft chews for an older dog with inflammation?";

// ---------- Sound design (Web Audio API, no asset deps) ----------
// Tasteful, subtle. Browsers gate audio behind a user-gesture, so we lazy-init
// the AudioContext on the first user interaction.
let _audio = null;
let _muted = false;
function ensureAudio() {
  if (_audio) return _audio;
  try {
    _audio = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
  } catch (_) { _audio = null; }
  return _audio;
}
function playTone(opts) {
  if (_muted) return;
  const ac = ensureAudio(); if (!ac) return;
  const { freq = 440, dur = 0.12, type = 'sine', vol = 0.06, glideTo = null } = opts || {};
  const o = ac.createOscillator();
  const g = ac.createGain();
  o.type = type;
  o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ac.currentTime);
  if (glideTo) o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(glideTo, ac.currentTime + dur * 0.9);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0, ac.currentTime);
  g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol, ac.currentTime + 0.012);
  g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, ac.currentTime + dur);
  o.connect(g).connect(ac.destination);
  o.start();
  o.stop(ac.currentTime + dur + 0.02);
}
const sfx = {
  click()      { playTone({ freq: 1400, dur: 0.06, type: 'square', vol: 0.04 }); },
  type()       { playTone({ freq: 720, dur: 0.03, type: 'square', vol: 0.012 }); },
  load()       { playTone({ freq: 580, dur: 0.22, type: 'sine', vol: 0.05, glideTo: 880 }); },
  verified()   { playTone({ freq: 660, dur: 0.18, type: 'sine', vol: 0.07, glideTo: 990 });
                 setTimeout(() => playTone({ freq: 1320, dur: 0.20, type: 'sine', vol: 0.06 }), 110); },
  purchased()  { playTone({ freq: 880, dur: 0.16, type: 'sine', vol: 0.08, glideTo: 1320 });
                 setTimeout(() => playTone({ freq: 1760, dur: 0.32, type: 'sine', vol: 0.06 }), 130); },
};
// Init audio context on first click/key anywhere (user-gesture requirement).
['click', 'keydown'].forEach(ev => document.addEventListener(ev, ensureAudio, { once: true }));

const stage = document.getElementById('stage');
const scenes = {
  0: document.querySelector('.scene-0'),
  1: document.querySelector('.scene-1'),
  2: document.querySelector('.scene-2'),
  3: document.querySelector('.scene-3'),
  4: document.querySelector('.scene-4'),
};
// Section 4 — scene-2b sibling. Not in the dots/runners array; sub-state of scene 2.
const scene2b = document.querySelector('.scene-2b');
const scenePool = document.querySelector('.scene-pool');
const dots = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[data-jump]'));
const SCENE_WORLD = { 0:'llm', 1:'llm', 2:'llm', 3:'llm', 4:'vendor' };

let currentScene = 0;
let runToken = 0;

function setWorld(scene) { stage.setAttribute('data-world', SCENE_WORLD[scene] || 'llm'); }

function showScene(n) {
  currentScene = n;
  Object.entries(scenes).forEach(([k, el]) => { el.classList.toggle('active', Number(k) === n); });
  // Sub-state activators are mutually exclusive with the main scene index.
  if (scene2b) scene2b.classList.remove('active');
  if (scenePool) scenePool.classList.remove('active');
  setWorld(n);
  // 2026-05-24: dots use data-jump (not array index) because scene-3 dot
  // was removed when the Gemini recommendation scene was eliminated.
  dots.forEach((d) => {
    const idx = parseInt(d.dataset.jump, 10);
    d.classList.remove('active', 'done');
    if (idx < n) d.classList.add('done');
    else if (idx === n) d.classList.add('active');
  });
}

// Section 4 — sub-state activator. Hides scene-2's main card, shows scene-2b.
// Keeps currentScene=2 so left/right arrow navigation stays intuitive.
function showScene2b() {
  if (!scene2b) return;
  scenes[2].classList.remove('active');
  if (scenePool) scenePool.classList.remove('active');
  scene2b.classList.add('active');
  setWorld(2);
  // Dot 2 stays "active" — scene-2b is sub-state, no dedicated dot.
}

// 2026-05-24: Verified Browser sub-state. Plays after BLOCK, before
// VERIFY. Same dot-state pattern as scene-2b.
function showScenePool() {
  if (!scenePool) return;
  scenes[2].classList.remove('active');
  if (scene2b) scene2b.classList.remove('active');
  scenePool.classList.add('active');
  setWorld(2);
}

function wait(ms, token) {
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    setTimeout(() => { if (token !== runToken) resolve('aborted'); else resolve(); }, ms);
  });
}

// ---- per-scene animators ----

// Scene 0: macOS desktop → Chrome opens → URL types → Gemini loads →
// query types → submit armed + "Click to ask Gemini" tooltip.
// Auto-plays the whole sequence. Ends waiting for user submit click.
const URL_TEXT = "gemini.google.com";

async function runScene0(token) {
  showScene(0);
  const s = scenes[0];
  // Reset all phases.
  s.classList.remove('phase-browser', 'phase-loading', 'phase-gemini');
  const chromeIcon = document.getElementById('dock-chrome');
  const urlText = document.getElementById('urlText');
  const urlCursor = document.getElementById('urlCursor');
  const input = document.getElementById('s0-input');
  const queryEl = document.getElementById('s0-query');
  const ctaTip = document.getElementById('s0-cta-tip');
  urlText.textContent = '';
  urlCursor.style.display = '';
  queryEl.innerHTML = '<span class="cursor"></span>';
  input.classList.remove('typing', 'armed', 'clicked');
  ctaTip.classList.remove('show');
  pointerHide();

  // -- Phase: desktop. Hold for a beat so the user reads the dock.
  await wait(900, token); if (token !== runToken) return;

  // -- Cursor enters from bottom-right, lands on Chrome dock icon.
  await pointerMoveTo(chromeIcon, { fromOffscreen: true });
  if (token !== runToken) return;
  chromeIcon.classList.add('hi-lite');
  await wait(180, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  await pointerClick(chromeIcon);
  sfx.click();
  if (token !== runToken) return;
  chromeIcon.classList.remove('hi-lite');

  // -- Phase: browser opens with empty URL bar.
  s.classList.add('phase-browser');
  pointerHide();
  await wait(620, token); if (token !== runToken) return;

  // -- Type the URL character by character (~1.2s).
  for (let i = 0; i < URL_TEXT.length; i++) {
    if (token !== runToken) return;
    urlText.textContent = URL_TEXT.slice(0, i + 1);
    if (i % 3 === 0) sfx.type();
    await wait(60, token);
  }
  urlCursor.style.display = 'none';
  await wait(280, token); if (token !== runToken) return;

  // -- Loading bar fills, then Gemini app fades in.
  s.classList.add('phase-loading');
  await wait(580, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  s.classList.add('phase-gemini');
  sfx.load();
  await wait(700, token); if (token !== runToken) return;

  // -- Phase: query types into Gemini input.
  input.classList.add('typing');
  for (let i = 0; i < QUERY.length; i++) {
    if (token !== runToken) return;
    queryEl.innerHTML = QUERY.slice(0, i + 1) + '<span class="cursor"></span>';
    await wait(26, token);
  }
  await wait(320, token); if (token !== runToken) return;

  // -- Arm the submit button + show tooltip.
  input.classList.add('armed');
  const submitBtn = document.getElementById('s0-submit');
  const btnRect = submitBtn.getBoundingClientRect();
  const inputContainer = input.parentElement;
  const containerRect = inputContainer.getBoundingClientRect();
  ctaTip.style.left = (btnRect.left - containerRect.left - 130) + 'px';
  ctaTip.style.top = (btnRect.top - containerRect.top - 42) + 'px';
  await wait(60, token);
  ctaTip.classList.add('show');

  // -- Hint: briefly fly the cursor over the submit button so a cold judge
  // knows exactly where to click. Pointer fades out after 1.5s.
  await wait(280, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  await pointerMoveTo(submitBtn, { fromOffscreen: true });
  if (token !== runToken) return;
  await wait(1500, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  pointerHide();
  // Waits for user to click submit (or Next).
}

// Scene 1: Gemini answer with 3 product candidates.
async function runScene1(token) {
  showScene(1);
  scenes[1].classList.remove('show-products', 'pinging');
  pointerHide();
  await wait(500, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  scenes[1].classList.add('show-products');
  await wait(800, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  scenes[1].classList.add('pinging');
  await wait(450, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  // Hint: fly the pointer over the advance CTA so the user sees the next step.
  const ctaBtn = document.getElementById('goToPawConscious');
  if (ctaBtn) {
    await pointerMoveTo(ctaBtn, { fromOffscreen: true });
    if (token !== runToken) return;
    await wait(1400, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
    pointerHide();
  }
}

// Scene 2: PawConscious bento grid (the trust layer in action).
async function runScene2(token) {
  showScene(2);
  scenes[2].classList.remove('complete');
  document.getElementById('s3-status').textContent = 'VERIFYING';
  const cards = scenes[2].querySelectorAll('#s3-bento .b-card');
  cards.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active', 'done'));
  await wait(360, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  for (const c of cards) {
    if (token !== runToken) return;
    c.classList.add('active');
    await wait(520, token);
    c.classList.remove('active');
    c.classList.add('done');
  }
  await wait(180, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  scenes[2].classList.add('complete');
  document.getElementById('s3-status').textContent = 'VERIFIED';
  sfx.verified();
  // 2026-05-24 Omar review: do not auto-advance to scene 3. The verified
  // scene should pause so the user can read the Trust Report, click PMIDs,
  // open the COA, and click "Try this on your own product →". Pointer
  // hint over the primary "Continue →" CTA (was "Click to see Gemini's answer", rewritten to not duplicate what the bento already shows).
  await wait(1200, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  const recBtn = document.getElementById('goToRecommend');
  if (recBtn) {
    await pointerMoveTo(recBtn, { fromOffscreen: true });
    if (token !== runToken) return;
    await wait(1400, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
    pointerHide();
  }
}

// Verified Browser scene-pool — single 15-card grid with a kinetic pointer.
// 2026-05-24 night (Omar /devex-review): the 4-card-220ms tour felt slow
// and static. New behaviour: pointer makes 2 quick scout visits with a
// brief "visited" glow on each card it touches, then lock-on to Green
// Gruff. Cards retain their visual receipt so the judge sees the path
// the pointer took.
async function runScenePool(token) {
  showScene(2);
  showScenePool();
  pointerHide();
  await wait(200, token); if (token !== runToken) return;

  const grid         = scenePool.querySelector('.pool-grid-15');
  const greenGruffCd = scenePool.querySelector('.pool-card.real');
  const ctaBtn       = document.getElementById('poolPickGreenGruff');
  const allCards     = grid.querySelectorAll('.pool-card');

  // Reset any visual state from a previous replay.
  allCards.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('selected', 'visited'));

  // Scout: only 2 cards, ~100ms each. Cards keep a green "visited" glow
  // so the path is visible after the pointer moves on.
  const scoutIdxs = [7, 12];
  for (let n = 0; n < scoutIdxs.length; n++) {
    if (token !== runToken) return;
    const card = allCards[scoutIdxs[n]];
    if (!card) continue;
    await pointerMoveTo(card, n === 0 ? { fromOffscreen: true } : {});
    if (token !== runToken) return;
    card.classList.add('visited');
    await wait(110, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  }

  // Lock-on to Green Gruff: a deliberate sharper approach. Tiny pause
  // immediately before the click reads as "found it."
  if (greenGruffCd) {
    await pointerMoveTo(greenGruffCd, {});
    if (token !== runToken) return;
    await wait(180, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
    await pointerClick(greenGruffCd);
    sfx.click();
    if (token !== runToken) return;
    greenGruffCd.classList.add('selected');
    await wait(320, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  }

  // Drift to the CTA and hand off.
  if (ctaBtn) {
    await pointerMoveTo(ctaBtn, {});
    if (token !== runToken) return;
    await wait(900, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
    pointerHide();
  }
}

// Path B (2026-05-24): scene-2b BLOCK is now the FIRST mesh beat. After the
// block lands, the bridge UI ("See verified alternatives") surfaces and
// the pointer hints toward it. User clicks → runScenePool → user picks →
// runScene2 (verify bento). Per-card cadence unchanged so the visual
// rhythm matches scene-2.
async function runScene2b(token) {
  // Path B: scene-2b runs as the primary scene-2 beat. showScene(2) first
  // so currentScene+dots+world stay correct (otherwise Next freezes by
  // re-playing the block scene). Then showScene2b() flips the visible card.
  showScene(2);
  showScene2b();
  document.getElementById('s2b-status').textContent = 'VERIFYING';
  const cards = scene2b.querySelectorAll('#s2b-bento .b-card');
  cards.forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active', 'done'));
  await wait(360, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  for (const c of cards) {
    if (token !== runToken) return;
    c.classList.add('active');
    await wait(520, token);
    c.classList.remove('active');
    c.classList.add('done');
  }
  await wait(220, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  document.getElementById('s2b-status').textContent = 'BLOCKED';
  // Path B pointer hint over the new "Verify the recommended brand" CTA.
  await wait(900, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  const ctaBtn = document.getElementById('goToRecommendFromBlock');
  if (ctaBtn) {
    await pointerMoveTo(ctaBtn, { fromOffscreen: true });
    if (token !== runToken) return;
    await wait(1400, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
    pointerHide();
  }
}

// Scene 3 (Gemini recommendation) removed from the cinematic per Omar
// 2026-05-24 evening review. Pass-through to runScene4 (vendor page +
// checkout). The Verified Browser scene now carries the brand-choice
// beat the recommendation scene used to convey. Scene-3 HTML stays in
// the DOM but is hidden via CSS to keep the runners array contract
// and not break the dot navigation indexing for older bookmarks.
async function runScene3(token) {
  runScene4(token);
}

// Scene 4: vendor + autonomous checkout with animated cursor.
async function runScene4(token) {
  showScene(4);
  scenes[4].classList.remove('checkout', 'confirmed');
  const cn = scenes[4].querySelector('.cart-num');
  if (cn) cn.textContent = '0';
  const payBtn = document.getElementById('payBtn');
  const payLbl = document.getElementById('payLabel');
  if (payBtn) payBtn.classList.remove('processing');
  if (payLbl) payLbl.textContent = ' Pay with Apple Pay';
  pointerHide();

  await wait(900, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  const buyBtn = document.getElementById('buyBtn');
  await pointerMoveTo(buyBtn, { fromOffscreen: true });
  if (token !== runToken) return;
  await pointerClick(buyBtn);
  sfx.click();
  if (token !== runToken) return;

  scenes[4].classList.add('checkout');
  if (cn) cn.textContent = '1';
  await wait(800, token); if (token !== runToken) return;

  const payBtnEl = document.getElementById('payBtn');
  await pointerMoveTo(payBtnEl, {});
  if (token !== runToken) return;
  await pointerClick(payBtnEl);
  sfx.click();
  if (token !== runToken) return;

  if (payBtn) payBtn.classList.add('processing');
  if (payLbl) payLbl.innerHTML = '<span class="spin"></span>&nbsp; Processing';
  pointerHide();
  await wait(1100, token); if (token !== runToken) return;
  scenes[4].classList.add('confirmed');
  sfx.purchased();
}

// ---------- Pointer helpers ----------
const pointerEl = document.getElementById('demoPointer');
const rippleEl = document.getElementById('demoRipple');

function pointerHide() {
  if (!pointerEl) return;
  pointerEl.classList.remove('show', 'click');
}

function pointerMoveTo(target, opts) {
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    if (!pointerEl || !target) { resolve(); return; }
    const r = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    // Point the cursor's tip at the center-left-ish of the button (where a
    // hand would naturally land) so the click ripple aligns visually.
    const targetX = r.left + r.width * 0.5 - 4;
    const targetY = r.top + r.height * 0.5 - 4;

    if (opts && opts.fromOffscreen) {
      // Start from below-right of the target so the entry feels natural.
      pointerEl.style.transition = 'none';
      pointerEl.style.left = (window.innerWidth - 80) + 'px';
      pointerEl.style.top  = (window.innerHeight - 60) + 'px';
      pointerEl.classList.remove('show', 'click');
      // Force reflow before re-enabling transition.
      void pointerEl.offsetWidth;
      pointerEl.style.transition = '';
      pointerEl.classList.add('show');
    } else if (!pointerEl.classList.contains('show')) {
      pointerEl.classList.add('show');
    }

    pointerEl.style.left = targetX + 'px';
    pointerEl.style.top  = targetY + 'px';
    // Wait for the CSS movement transition (matches .demo-pointer transition).
    setTimeout(resolve, 760);
  });
}

function pointerClick(target) {
  return new Promise(resolve => {
    if (!pointerEl || !target) { resolve(); return; }
    const r = target.getBoundingClientRect();
    // Position the ripple over the button center.
    rippleEl.style.left = (r.left + r.width / 2 - 22) + 'px';
    rippleEl.style.top  = (r.top + r.height / 2 - 22) + 'px';
    rippleEl.classList.remove('fire');
    // Force reflow so the animation restarts.
    void rippleEl.offsetWidth;
    rippleEl.classList.add('fire');
    pointerEl.classList.add('click');
    setTimeout(() => {
      pointerEl.classList.remove('click');
      setTimeout(resolve, 200);
    }, 280);
  });
}

/* 2026-05-24 Path B: cinematic now goes Block FIRST, then route to a
   verified alternative. playScene(2) enters scene 2 visually but runs the
   BLOCK animation (runScene2b). The "verify the recommended brand" CTA on
   the block scene then triggers runScene2 (verified Green Gruff EASE),
   which at its end auto-advances to runScene3. */
const runners = [runScene0, runScene1, runScene2b, runScene3, runScene4];

function playScene(n) {
  runToken += 1;
  const myToken = runToken;
  runners[n](myToken);
}

// ---- Manual click-through ----

// 2026-05-24 night (Omar): Prev/Next buttons get a brief visual flash so the
// user sees the click registered. Previously a Prev press felt dumb because
// the page only re-renders on a real scene change.
function flashBtn(btn) {
  if (!btn) return;
  btn.classList.add('flash');
  setTimeout(() => btn.classList.remove('flash'), 280);
}
function next() {
  flashBtn(document.getElementById('nextBtn'));
  if (currentScene < 4) playScene(currentScene + 1);
}
function prev() {
  flashBtn(document.getElementById('prevBtn'));
  // Scene 3 is a pass-through to scene 4 (the Gemini recommendation beat
  // was removed). Going from scene 4 → scene 3 would re-enter scene 4
  // and feel like nothing happened. Skip directly to runScene2 (VERIFY).
  if (currentScene === 4) {
    runToken += 1;
    runScene2(runToken);
    return;
  }
  if (currentScene > 0) playScene(currentScene - 1);
}
function restart() {
  flashBtn(document.getElementById('replayBtn'));
  playScene(0);
}

document.getElementById('prevBtn').addEventListener('click', prev);
document.getElementById('nextBtn').addEventListener('click', next);
document.getElementById('replayBtn').addEventListener('click', restart);
// 2026-05-24: dot click uses data-jump (not array index) since scene-3 dot
// was removed. Dot at array index 3 now jumps to scene 4 via data-jump=4.
dots.forEach((d) => d.addEventListener('click', () => playScene(parseInt(d.dataset.jump, 10))));

// Submit button inside scene 0 (Gemini input) advances to scene 1.
// First plays the dive-in zoom (Chrome window fills the viewport, macOS +
// browser chrome fade out) so scene 1 feels like a continuation, not a cut.
document.getElementById('s0-submit').addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (currentScene !== 0) return;
  const s0 = scenes[0];
  // Kill the breathing pulse + tooltip; user has acted.
  document.getElementById('s0-cta-tip').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('s0-input').classList.add('clicked');
  // Play the dive.
  s0.classList.add('phase-zooming');
  setTimeout(() => playScene(1), 720);
});

// Scene-specific advance buttons
document.getElementById('goToPawConscious').addEventListener('click', () => playScene(2));
document.getElementById('goToRecommend').addEventListener('click', () => playScene(3));
document.getElementById('goToVendor').addEventListener('click', () => playScene(4));

// Path B (2026-05-24): the "Show me a claim we BLOCK" secondary button
// was replaced by a "Try this on your own product →" anchor that links
// to /agents. Block scene now plays as the FIRST mesh beat, so the
// goToBlock toggle is obsolete. Handler removed; element no longer has
// id="goToBlock".
// Path B + Pool (2026-05-24): block scene's "See verified alternatives"
// CTA opens the Verified Browser. The browser's "Verify Green Gruff EASE"
// CTA then triggers the VERIFIED-ALTERNATIVE beat. Two clicks total
// between BLOCK and VERIFY, surfacing the choice moment.
document.getElementById('goToRecommendFromBlock').addEventListener('click', () => {
  runToken += 1;
  runScenePool(runToken);
});
const poolPickBtn = document.getElementById('poolPickGreenGruff');
if (poolPickBtn) {
  poolPickBtn.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    runToken += 1;
    runScene2(runToken);
  });
}
document.getElementById('backToVerified').addEventListener('click', () => {
  // Return to scene-2 in its completed/verified state without rerunning the
  // bento animation. Keeps the trust-report visible.
  runToken += 1;
  showScene(2);
  scenes[2].classList.add('complete');
});

// Skip intro: jump to the query-armed state inside scene 0.
document.getElementById('skipIntroBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  runToken += 1;
  const s = scenes[0];
  s.classList.add('phase-browser', 'phase-loading', 'phase-gemini');
  s.classList.remove('phase-zooming');
  document.getElementById('urlText').textContent = URL_TEXT;
  document.getElementById('urlCursor').style.display = 'none';
  const input = document.getElementById('s0-input');
  const queryEl = document.getElementById('s0-query');
  const ctaTip = document.getElementById('s0-cta-tip');
  queryEl.innerHTML = QUERY + '<span class="cursor"></span>';
  input.classList.add('typing', 'armed');
  // Position tooltip after the next paint.
  requestAnimationFrame(() => {
    const submitBtn = document.getElementById('s0-submit');
    const btnRect = submitBtn.getBoundingClientRect();
    const containerRect = input.parentElement.getBoundingClientRect();
    ctaTip.style.left = (btnRect.left - containerRect.left - 130) + 'px';
    ctaTip.style.top = (btnRect.top - containerRect.top - 42) + 'px';
    ctaTip.classList.add('show');
  });
  pointerHide();
});

// Replay scene 4 (vendor + checkout) without restarting the whole demo.
document.getElementById('replaySceneBtn').addEventListener('click', () => playScene(4));

// Buy + pay (manual fallbacks; the cursor in runScene4 normally fires them)
document.getElementById('buyBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  scenes[4].classList.add('checkout');
  const cn = scenes[4].querySelector('.cart-num');
  if (cn) cn.textContent = '1';
});
document.getElementById('payBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const btn = document.getElementById('payBtn');
  const lbl = document.getElementById('payLabel');
  btn.classList.add('processing');
  lbl.innerHTML = '<span class="spin"></span>&nbsp; Processing';
  setTimeout(() => { scenes[4].classList.add('confirmed'); }, 1100);
});

// Keyboard
document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); next(); }
  else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') prev();
  else if (e.key === 'r' || e.key === 'R') restart();
});

// Boot
window.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
  setTimeout(() => playScene(0), 200);
  // Keyboard hint surfaces briefly during the first scene.
  const hint = document.getElementById('kbdHint');
  setTimeout(() => hint.classList.add('show'), 1800);
  setTimeout(() => hint.classList.remove('show'), 8800);
});
</script>
</body>
</html>

    border-color: var(--electric); color: var(--electric);
    background: rgba(0,212,255,0.06);
    animation: chip-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  }
  .stage-chip.done {
    border-color: var(--moss-glow); color: var(--moss-glow);
    background: rgba(99,154,96,0.06);
  }
  @keyframes chip-pulse {
    0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(0,212,255,0.42); }
    50%      { box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px rgba(0,212,255,0); }
  }

  @media (max-width: 720px) {
    .latency-explainer { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    /* 2026-05-25 audit: pre code blocks were extending past viewport on 390px
       (681 > 390). Force them to scroll inside the container. */
    pre { max-width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; }
    .container { padding: 36px 14px 64px; }
    .stage-strip { gap: 6px; }
    .stage-chip { font-size: 10px; padding: 5px 7px; }
  }

  /* Bundle render panel (codex P0 from /agents audit: surface the cert HTML
   * + bundle JSON + Second Opinion + Ed25519 instead of 5 lines of plaintext). */
  .bundle-panel {
    display: none;
    margin-top: 18px;
    background: var(--bg-elev);
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 10px;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .bundle-panel.visible { display: block; }
  .bundle-tabs {
    display: flex;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.18);
  }
  .bundle-tab {
    flex: 0 0 auto;
    padding: 11px 18px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    color: var(--dim);
    font: 600 11px/1 var(--mono);
    letter-spacing: 0.10em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    border-bottom: 2px solid transparent;
    transition: color 160ms, border-color 160ms;
  }
  .bundle-tab:hover { color: var(--ink); }
  .bundle-tab.active { color: var(--electric); border-bottom-color: var(--electric); }
  .bundle-tab-panel { display: none; padding: 18px 22px; }
  .bundle-tab-panel.active { display: block; }
  .bundle-tab-panel iframe.cert-frame {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 520px;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    background: #fff;
  }
  .bundle-tab-panel pre.bundle-json {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 16px 18px;
    background: #07080A;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    font: 400 12px/1.55 var(--mono);
    color: var(--muted);
    max-height: 520px;
    overflow: auto;
  }
  .bundle-tab-panel pre.bundle-json .json-k { color: var(--electric); }
  .bundle-tab-panel pre.bundle-json .json-s { color: var(--moss-glow); }
  .bundle-tab-panel pre.bundle-json .json-n { color: #C8A464; }
  .bundle-tab-panel pre.bundle-json .json-b { color: var(--warning); }
  .so-table {
    width: 100%;
    border-collapse: collapse;
    font: 400 13px/1.5 'Inter', sans-serif;
  }
  .so-table th {
    text-align: left;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    font: 600 11px/1 var(--mono);
    letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--dim);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  }
  .so-table td {
    padding: 12px 14px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
    color: var(--ink);
    vertical-align: top;
  }
  .so-table tr:last-child td { border-bottom: 0; }
  .so-table td.verdict-pass { color: var(--moss-glow); font-weight: 600; }
  .so-table td.verdict-fail { color: var(--warning); font-weight: 600; }
  .so-table td.verdict-review { color: #C8A464; font-weight: 600; }
  .verify-panel {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 14px;
  }
  .verify-panel .sig-row {
    background: #07080A;
    border: 1px solid var(--border);
    border-radius: 6px;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    font: 400 12px/1.5 var(--mono);
    color: var(--muted);
    word-break: break-all;
  }
  .verify-panel .sig-row .label {
    display: block;
    font: 600 10px/1 var(--mono);
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: var(--dim);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }
  .verify-panel .sig-row .val { color: var(--electric); }
  .verify-btn {
    align-self: flex-start;
    padding: 10px 18px;
    background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid rgba(0, 181, 220, 0.40);
    color: var(--electric);
    border-radius: 6px;
    font: 600 12px/1 var(--mono);
    letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;

  }
  .verify-btn:hover { background: rgba(0, 181, 220, 0.08); }

    border-color: rgba(111, 174, 122, 0.42);

<body>

<!--GLOBAL_NAV-->

<main class="container">

  <section class="hero">
    <div class="eyebrow">PawConscious for Agents · A2A v0.3 reference</div>
    <h1>Call the <span class="accent">trust layer</span> in one A2A request.</h1>
    <p class="lede">One curl call. 60-90 seconds per claim (typical product = 2 to 4 minutes total). A2A v0.3 + JSON-RPC 2.0 envelopes, Ed25519-signed PCEC v0.1 bundles, idempotency keys, discoverable agent card. Drop-in for any A2A v0.3 client. Demo key for GFS judges below.</p>
  </section>

  <!-- Google-stack proof (2026-05-27): names every Google Cloud tool in the
       mesh so a Technical-30% judge maps the stack in one glance. Each chip is
       the real, shipped integration; the protocol chips follow. -->
  <div class="mandates" aria-label="Built on Google Cloud">
    <span class="mandate" style="border-color:var(--electric);color:var(--electric);">Built on Google Cloud</span>
    <span class="mandate">Gemini 2.5 Pro + Flash</span>
    <span class="mandate">ADK 2.0 · 4 of 7 agents</span>
    <span class="mandate">Vertex AI Search</span>
    <span class="mandate">Google Search grounding</span>
    <span class="mandate">Vertex AI Agent Engine</span>
    <span class="mandate">Cloud Run</span>
    <span class="mandate">Firestore transparency log</span>
    <span class="mandate">A2A v0.3 · JSON-RPC 2.0</span>
    <span class="mandate">Ed25519 · did:web</span>
  </div>

  <section class="quickstart">
    <span class="badge">connect in 30 seconds</span>
    <h3>One curl. 2 to 4 minutes. Real signed bundle.</h3>
    <p style="margin:0 0 16px;">Demo key for GFS judges: <code class="inline">demo-key-2026-06</code>. Add as <code class="inline">X-API-Key</code> header. Live latency reference: a 3-claim product runs in 2 to 4 minutes today (Cloud Run cold-start adds 20-40 seconds on the first call).</p>

    <div class="tabs">
      <button class="tab active" data-tab="curl">curl</button>
      <button class="tab" data-tab="py">Python</button>
      <button class="tab" data-tab="ts">TypeScript</button>
    </div>

    <div class="tab-panel active" id="panel-curl">
      <pre class="with-copy" data-copy><button class="copy-btn">copy</button><code><span class="tok-cmt"># A2A v0.3 standard envelope</span>
curl -X POST <span class="tok-str">"<!--PUBLIC_BASE_URL-->/a2a/v1/tasks/send"</span> \
  -H <span class="tok-str">"X-API-Key: demo-key-2026-06"</span> \
  -H <span class="tok-str">"Content-Type: application/json"</span> \
  -d <span class="tok-str">'{
    "message": {
      "role": "user",
      "parts": [
        {"type":"text","text":"https://www.nativepet.com/products/hip-joint"}
      ]
    },
    "skill": "verify_claim"
  }'</span>

<span class="tok-cmt"># → HTTP 202 { task_id, poll_url, head_anchor_at_submit }
# Poll until status=completed (~60-90s per claim, 2-4 min typical)</span>

curl <span class="tok-str">"<!--PUBLIC_BASE_URL-->/a2a/v1/tasks/get/&lt;task_id&gt;"</span> \
  -H <span class="tok-str">"X-API-Key: demo-key-2026-06"</span></code></pre>
    </div>

    <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-py">
      <pre class="with-copy" data-copy><button class="copy-btn">copy</button><code><span class="tok-key">import</span> httpx, time

BASE = <span class="tok-str">"<!--PUBLIC_BASE_URL-->"</span>
HEADERS = {<span class="tok-str">"X-API-Key"</span>: <span class="tok-str">"demo-key-2026-06"</span>}

<span class="tok-cmt"># Submit via A2A v0.3 standard envelope</span>
r = httpx.post(<span class="tok-str">f"{BASE}/a2a/v1/tasks/send"</span>, headers=HEADERS, json={
    <span class="tok-str">"message"</span>: {<span class="tok-str">"role"</span>: <span class="tok-str">"user"</span>, <span class="tok-str">"parts"</span>: [
        {<span class="tok-str">"type"</span>: <span class="tok-str">"text"</span>, <span class="tok-str">"text"</span>: <span class="tok-str">"https://www.nativepet.com/products/hip-joint"</span>}
    ]},
    <span class="tok-str">"skill"</span>: <span class="tok-str">"verify_claim"</span>,
})
task_id = r.json()[<span class="tok-str">"task_id"</span>]

<span class="tok-cmt"># Poll for completion</span>
<span class="tok-key">while</span> <span class="tok-num">True</span>:
    s = httpx.get(<span class="tok-str">f"{BASE}/a2a/v1/tasks/get/{task_id}"</span>, headers=HEADERS).json()
    <span class="tok-key">if</span> s[<span class="tok-str">"status"</span>] <span class="tok-key">in</span> (<span class="tok-str">"completed"</span>, <span class="tok-str">"failed"</span>):
        <span class="tok-key">break</span>
    time.sleep(<span class="tok-num">3</span>)

<span class="tok-cmt"># s["bundle_signature"], s["chain_anchor"], s["output"]</span></code></pre>
    </div>

    <div class="tab-panel" id="panel-ts">
      <pre class="with-copy" data-copy><button class="copy-btn">copy</button><code><span class="tok-key">const</span> BASE = <span class="tok-str">"<!--PUBLIC_BASE_URL-->"</span>;
<span class="tok-key">const</span> headers = {
  <span class="tok-str">"X-API-Key"</span>: <span class="tok-str">"demo-key-2026-06"</span>,
  <span class="tok-str">"Content-Type"</span>: <span class="tok-str">"application/json"</span>,
};

<span class="tok-cmt">// A2A v0.3 standard envelope</span>
<span class="tok-key">const</span> r = <span class="tok-key">await</span> fetch(<span class="tok-str">`${BASE}/a2a/v1/tasks/send`</span>, {
  method: <span class="tok-str">"POST"</span>, headers,
  body: JSON.stringify({
    message: { role: <span class="tok-str">"user"</span>, parts: [
      { type: <span class="tok-str">"text"</span>, text: <span class="tok-str">"https://www.nativepet.com/products/hip-joint"</span> }
    ]},
    skill: <span class="tok-str">"verify_claim"</span>,
  })
});
<span class="tok-key">const</span> { task_id } = <span class="tok-key">await</span> r.json();

<span class="tok-key">while</span> (<span class="tok-num">true</span>) {
  <span class="tok-key">const</span> s = <span class="tok-key">await</span> (<span class="tok-key">await</span> fetch(<span class="tok-str">`${BASE}/a2a/v1/tasks/get/${task_id}`</span>, { headers })).json();
  <span class="tok-key">if</span> ([<span class="tok-str">"completed"</span>, <span class="tok-str">"failed"</span>].includes(s.status)) <span class="tok-key">break</span>;
  <span class="tok-key">await</span> <span class="tok-key">new</span> Promise(r =&gt; setTimeout(r, <span class="tok-num">3000</span>));
}</code></pre>
    </div>
  </section>


  <h2>Authentication</h2>
  <p>Every A2A request requires an API key passed as the <code class="inline">X-API-Key</code> HTTP header. During the GFS hackathon window, the demo key below works against every public endpoint. Post-hackathon, brands and shopping agents receive per-tenant keys via the contracting flow.</p>
  <div style="background:#07080A; border:1px solid var(--border); border-radius:8px; padding:16px 20px; margin: 12px 0;">
    <div style="font: 600 11px/1 var(--mono); letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--dim); margin-bottom: 8px;">Demo key · GFS judges</div>
    <code class="inline" style="font-size: 14px; color: var(--electric);">X-API-Key: demo-key-2026-06</code>
    <p style="margin: 12px 0 0; font: 500 12px/1.55 var(--sans); color: var(--muted);">Calls without the header receive <code class="inline">HTTP 401 missing_api_key</code>. Calls with an unknown key receive <code class="inline">HTTP 401 invalid_api_key</code>. The demo key has no rate limit during the judging window; production keys ship with per-tenant pacing.</p>
  </div>

  <h2 id="try">Live API sandbox</h2>

Just want the brand-facing verdict and certificate? <a href="/" style="color:var(--electric);">See the Product page &rarr;</a></p>

  <!-- 2026-05-25 (Omar): two-tier latency story panel. Frames the latency

        Bundles are immutable: a re-run produces the same signed evidence, so the cached
        bundle is semantically identical. Used by agent-to-agent traffic at scale.

    </div>
    <div class="le-tier le-cold">

    <!-- Bundle render panel · surfaces when a task completes.
         4 tabs: Cert HTML (iframe) · Bundle JSON · Second Opinion · Verify offline. -->
    <div class="bundle-panel" id="bundlePanel">

        <button class="bundle-tab active" data-btab="cert">Cert</button>
        <button class="bundle-tab" data-btab="json">Bundle JSON</button>
