```html
  <!-- Verify it yourself · consolidated proof (2026-05-26). Moved the old
       offline-verify section up next to the try-it widget and added the real
       ShopperAgent + tamper test. Three ways, zero-setup first. -->
  <h2>Verify it yourself — don't trust us</h2>
  <p>Every bundle is Ed25519-signed over a transport-stable canonical (the signed JSON, minus its <code class="inline">signature</code> and the derived <code class="inline">bundle_urn</code>) against the key published at <code class="inline">/.well-known/did.json</code>. Three ways to check it, no setup first:</p>

  <p><strong>1 · In the browser.</strong> The <strong>Verify signature</strong> tab on the try-it widget above runs the Ed25519 check client-side on the bundle you just generated. It never trusts this API's verdict.</p>

  <p><strong>2 · A real external agent.</strong> <code class="inline">examples/shopper_agent.py</code> discovers the agent card, looks up a signed bundle, verifies it against the published key, decides RECOMMEND or SKIP from the verdict, then forges a FAIL into a PASS and watches the signature reject it:</p>
  <pre class="with-copy" data-copy><button class="copy-btn">copy</button><code>$ python examples/shopper_agent.py

  Cosequin     signature VALID ✅   CONDITIONAL · §255.3   → RECOMMEND WITH CAVEAT
  Green Gruff  signature VALID ✅   FAIL · §255.1          → SKIP
  JFFD         signature VALID ✅   UNVERIFIED             → NO RECOMMENDATION

  TAMPER TEST · forge Green Gruff's FAIL into a PASS, keep the signature:
  signature INVALID ❌ → forged bundle rejected</code></pre>
  <p>Or run every live check for the whole submission with <code class="inline">./verify.sh</code> (7/7 green against prod).</p>

  <p><strong>3 · From scratch, offline.</strong> The same check in a few lines of Python:</p>
  <pre class="with-copy" data-copy><button class="copy-btn">copy</button><code>from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.ed25519 import Ed25519PublicKey
import base58, base64, json, httpx

did = httpx.get("<!--PUBLIC_BASE_URL-->/.well-known/did.json").json()
mb  = did["verificationMethod"][0]["publicKeyMultibase"]          # z6Mk… did:key
raw = base58.b58decode(mb[1:])                                    # strip multibase 'z'
pub = Ed25519PublicKey.from_public_bytes(raw[2:34])               # drop 0xed01 prefix

b   = httpx.get("<!--PUBLIC_BASE_URL-->/a2a/v1/lookup?url=...").json()
canon = json.dumps({k: v for k, v in b["output"].items()
                    if k not in ("signature", "bundle_urn")},
                   sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":")).encode()
sig = base64.b64decode(b["bundle_signature"].rsplit(":", 1)[1])   # ed25519:&lt;did&gt;:&lt;b64&gt;
pub.verify(sig, canon)   # raises InvalidSignature if the bundle was tampered</code></pre>

  <h2>Discovery · well-knowns</h2>
  <p>Standards-compliant A2A clients discover us by fetching the agent card. Everything below is publicly accessible.</p>
  <div class="endpoints">
    <div class="endpoint">
      <div class="path">/.well-known/agent-card.json</div>
      <div class="desc">A2A v0.3 agent card. Declares skills, envelopes, auth, Agent Engine resource.</div>
      <a href="/.well-known/agent-card.json" target="_blank">fetch ↗</a>
    </div>
    <div class="endpoint">
      <div class="path">/.well-known/did.json</div>
      <div class="desc">did:web document with Ed25519 verification method. Verify bundle signatures offline.</div>
      <a href="/.well-known/did.json" target="_blank">fetch ↗</a>
    </div>
    <div class="endpoint">
      <div class="path">/pcec/v0/chain/head</div>
      <div class="desc">Current transparency-log chain anchor. Bundles link back to this in publication order.</div>
      <a href="/pcec/v0/chain/head" target="_blank">fetch ↗</a>
    </div>
    <div class="endpoint">
      <div class="path">/pcec/v0/claim/&lt;urn&gt;</div>
      <div class="desc">Fetch any historically-signed bundle by its <code class="inline">urn:pcec:claim:*</code> URN.</div>
      <a href="/pcec/v0/chain/head" target="_blank">chain head ↗</a>
    </div>
  </div>


  <h2>What we return</h2>
  <p>A completed task's <code class="inline">output</code> contains the signed PCEC v0.1 evidence bundle. Sample shape:</p>
  <pre class="with-copy" data-copy><button class="copy-btn">copy</button><code>{
  <span class="tok-key">"task_id"</span>: <span class="tok-str">"task-44acb19bf7c74b9a"</span>,
  <span class="tok-key">"status"</span>: <span class="tok-str">"completed"</span>,
  <span class="tok-key">"bundle_hash"</span>: <span class="tok-str">"sha256:9e3f...a04c"</span>,
  <span class="tok-key">"bundle_signature"</span>: <span class="tok-str">"z6Mk...Bxk"</span>,    <span class="tok-cmt">// multibase Ed25519</span>
  <span class="tok-key">"chain_anchor"</span>: <span class="tok-str">"sha256:426fe5283278..."</span>,
  <span class="tok-key">"output"</span>: {
    <span class="tok-key">"claims"</span>: [...],                  <span class="tok-cmt">// from claim_extractor agent</span>
    <span class="tok-key">"evidence"</span>: [...],                <span class="tok-cmt">// BioMCP + Semantic Scholar PMIDs</span>
    <span class="tok-key">"vet_rubric"</span>: [...],              <span class="tok-cmt">// 5-criterion 1-5 score per claim</span>
    <span class="tok-key">"compliance"</span>: [...],              <span class="tok-cmt">// FTC §255 + AAFCO + NASC mapping</span>
    <span class="tok-key">"audit_verdict"</span>: <span class="tok-str">"FAIL"</span>,        <span class="tok-cmt">// Falsifier auditor verdict</span>
    <span class="tok-key">"second_opinion"</span>: {...}            <span class="tok-cmt">// Google Search grounded adversarial</span>
  },
  <span class="tok-key">"cert_html"</span>: <span class="tok-str">"&lt;executive cert HTML&gt;..."</span>
}</code></pre>


  <h2>Wire into Vertex AI Agent Engine (ADK)</h2>
  <p>The documented ADK path for consuming a remote A2A peer is <code class="inline">RemoteA2aAgent</code>. PawConscious publishes a standard A2A v0.3 agent card, so any ADK 2.0 host can wrap it and call <code class="inline">verify_claim</code> as a sub-agent. Marketplace-ready, Gemini Enterprise-ready.</p>
  <pre class="with-copy" data-copy><button class="copy-btn">copy</button><code><span class="tok-cmt"># 1. PawConscious publishes its agent card at:</span>
<span class="tok-cmt">#    <!--PUBLIC_BASE_URL-->/.well-known/agent-card.json</span>

<span class="tok-cmt"># 2. Wrap it as a remote A2A sub-agent in your ADK host</span>
<span class="tok-key">from</span> google.adk.agents <span class="tok-key">import</span> LlmAgent
<span class="tok-key">from</span> google.adk.agents.remote_a2a_agent <span class="tok-key">import</span> RemoteA2aAgent

pawconscious = RemoteA2aAgent(
    name=<span class="tok-str">"pawconscious"</span>,
    agent_card=<span class="tok-str">"<!--PUBLIC_BASE_URL-->/.well-known/agent-card.json"</span>,
)

shopper = LlmAgent(
    name=<span class="tok-str">"shopper"</span>,
    model=<span class="tok-str">"gemini-2.5-pro"</span>,
    sub_agents=[pawconscious],
    instruction=<span class="tok-str">"Before recommending any pet supplement, call pawconscious with the product URL and gate on a PASS verdict."</span>,
)

<span class="tok-cmt"># 3. Pass demo-key-2026-06 via the X-API-Key header on the underlying</span>
<span class="tok-cmt">#    A2A transport during the hackathon window.</span>
<span class="tok-cmt"># 4. Deploy to Vertex AI Agent Engine:</span>
<span class="tok-cmt">#    gcloud beta ai reasoning-engines deploy ...</span></code></pre>
  <p style="font: 500 12px/1.6 var(--mono); color: var(--dim); margin-top: 12px;">Agent card declares the <code class="inline">verify_claim</code> skill, the public Ed25519 verification key, and the async task lifecycle. Bundle signatures verify offline against <code class="inline">/.well-known/did.json</code>. Reference: <a href="https://google.github.io/adk-docs/agents/a2a/" style="color:var(--electric);" target="_blank">ADK A2A docs</a>.</p>

  <h2>Errors</h2>
  <p>HTTP responses currently emitted by <code class="inline">/a2a/v1/*</code>.
  The mesh's internal failure modes surface through the task envelope, not the
  transport. A 200 with <code class="inline">status: "failed"</code> in the
  task is the common shape for agent-stage errors.</p>
  <table class="ref-tbl">
    <thead>
      <tr><th>HTTP</th><th>Meaning</th><th>Recover</th></tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td><code class="inline">200</code></td><td>Task fetched (GET), including replay of an idempotent submission.</td><td>Read <code class="inline">output</code>; check <code class="inline">status</code> for agent-stage failures.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code class="inline">202</code></td><td>Task accepted async. Body has <code class="inline">task_id</code>. Idempotent re-submit of the same key also returns 202 with the original id.</td><td>Poll <code class="inline">GET /a2a/v1/tasks/get/{task_id}</code>.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code class="inline">400</code></td><td>Semantic error. For example, missing <code class="inline">product_url</code> on a <code class="inline">verify_claim</code> envelope, or skill+input shape mismatch.</td><td>Check shape against the A2A v0.3 example above.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code class="inline">401</code></td><td>Missing or invalid <code class="inline">X-API-Key</code>.</td><td>Add the demo key <code class="inline">demo-key-2026-06</code> for hackathon access.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code class="inline">404</code></td><td>Unknown <code class="inline">skill</code>, unknown <code class="inline">task_id</code>, or expired task.</td><td>Re-submit the verify_claim task with a known skill.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code class="inline">409</code></td><td>Returned by <code class="inline">/a2a/v1/tasks/cancel/{task_id}</code> when the task is already in a terminal state (completed / failed / canceled).</td><td>Don't retry. The task is already done. Fetch it via <code class="inline">/a2a/v1/tasks/get/{task_id}</code>.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code class="inline">422</code></td><td>FastAPI validation. Malformed JSON body, missing required field, or wrong type. Distinct from <code class="inline">400</code> (semantic) and <code class="inline">404</code> (unknown skill).</td><td>Response body has the specific field path. Fix the payload and re-submit.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code class="inline">5xx</code></td><td>Cloud Run / upstream Vertex AI / Firestore unavailability.</td><td>Retry with exponential backoff.</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:-24px;">Per-skill
  <code class="inline">403</code> and rate-limit <code class="inline">429 / Retry-After</code>
  are on the v0.2 roadmap once a real rate-limiter and per-key authorization land.</p>


  <h2>Rate limits (recommended pacing)</h2>
  <p>The hackathon mesh runs without a per-key rate limiter. The numbers below
  are <em>recommended pacing</em> for integrators, not enforced quotas. The
  only enforced backpressure today is the platform layer (Cloud Run instance
  concurrency); exceed it and you'll see latency, not <code class="inline">429</code>s.</p>
  <table class="ref-tbl">
    <thead>
      <tr><th>Endpoint</th><th>Recommended sustained</th><th>OK burst</th><th>Why</th></tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr><td>Hackathon window<br><span style="font:500 11px var(--mono);color:var(--dim);">now → 2026-06-30</span></td><td>No explicit per-key cap</td><td>Cloud Run default concurrency</td><td>Each <code class="inline">verify_claim</code> is 30-60s of model latency; one concurrent task per integrator recommended.</td></tr>
      <tr><td>Discovery (well-knowns + resolver GETs)</td><td>~5 req/s</td><td>10 req/s for 3s</td><td>Static + Firestore reads. Cached at the platform layer.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code class="inline">verify_claim</code> async POST</td><td>1 req/s sustained</td><td>3 req/s for 10s</td><td>Mesh fan-out dominates; faster than this risks Cloud Run cold starts.</td></tr>
      <tr><td><code class="inline">fetch_substantiation_bundle</code></td><td>10 req/s</td><td>30 req/s for 5s</td><td>Read-only resolver path; idempotent against the transparency log.</td></tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
  <p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--dim);margin-top:-24px;">Real per-key
  quotas + <code class="inline">429 / Retry-After</code> ship on the v0.2
  roadmap alongside post-hackathon per-claim pricing.</p>

</main>

<script>
  // Copy buttons
  document.querySelectorAll('pre[data-copy]').forEach(pre => {
    const btn = pre.querySelector('.copy-btn');
    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const txt = pre.querySelector('code').innerText;
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt).then(() => {
        btn.textContent = 'copied';
        btn.classList.add('copied');
        setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = 'copy'; btn.classList.remove('copied'); }, 1400);
      });
    });
  });

  // Tabs
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const target = tab.dataset.tab;
      tab.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      tab.classList.add('active');
      const container = tab.closest('.quickstart');
      container.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
      container.querySelector('#panel-' + target).classList.add('active');
    });
  });

  // Try-it live mesh call
  const tryitBtn = document.getElementById('tryit-go');
  const tryitUrl = document.getElementById('tryit-url');
  const tryitOut = document.getElementById('tryit-out');
  const tryitStatus = document.getElementById('tryit-status');
  const BASE = window.location.origin;
  const KEY = 'demo-key-2026-06';

  // Bundle render panel (codex P0 amend from /agents audit · 2026-05-24).
  // Surfaces cert HTML, bundle JSON, Second Opinion verdicts, and Ed25519
  // signature with a browser-side verify button. Replaces 5 lines of plaintext.
  const bundlePanel = document.getElementById('bundlePanel');
  const certFrame = document.getElementById('certFrame');
  const bundleJsonEl = document.getElementById('bundleJson');
  const soTbody = document.getElementById('soTbody');
  const vfHash = document.getElementById('vfHash');
  const vfSig = document.getElementById('vfSig');
  const vfAnchor = document.getElementById('vfAnchor');
  const verifyBtn = document.getElementById('verifyBtn');
  const verifyResult = document.getElementById('verifyResult');
  let lastBundle = null;

  function syntaxHighlightJson(obj) {
    const json = JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2);
    return json
      .replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      .replace(/("(?:\\u[a-fA-F0-9]{4}|\\[^u]|[^\\"])*"\s*:)/g, '<span class="json-k">$1</span>')
      .replace(/:\s*"((?:\\u[a-fA-F0-9]{4}|\\[^u]|[^\\"])*)"/g, ': <span class="json-s">"$1"</span>')
      .replace(/:\s*(true|false)/g, ': <span class="json-b">$1</span>')
      .replace(/:\s*(-?\d+(\.\d+)?([eE][+\-]?\d+)?)/g, ': <span class="json-n">$1</span>');
  }

  function renderBundle(s) {
    lastBundle = s;
    bundlePanel.classList.add('visible');

    // Cert HTML in iframe (sandbox = "" = no scripts, no top-level nav, no forms)
    if (s.cert_html) {
      const blob = new Blob([s.cert_html], { type: 'text/html' });
      certFrame.src = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    } else {
      certFrame.srcdoc = '<div style="padding:24px; font-family: -apple-system, sans-serif; color:#666;">No cert_html in response.</div>';
    }

    // Bundle JSON, syntax-highlighted
    const trimmed = {
      task_id: s.task_id,
      status: s.status,
      bundle_urn: s.bundle_urn,
      bundle_hash: s.bundle_hash,
      bundle_signature: s.bundle_signature,
      chain_anchor: s.chain_anchor,
      chain_anchor_status: s.chain_anchor_status,
      output: s.output || null,
    };
    bundleJsonEl.innerHTML = syntaxHighlightJson(trimmed);

    // Second Opinion verdicts
    const so = s.second_opinion;
    if (so && Array.isArray(so.tests) && so.tests.length) {
      const rows = so.tests.map(t => {
        const v = (t.verdict || '').toUpperCase();
        const cls = v === 'PASS' ? 'verdict-pass'
                  : v === 'FAIL' ? 'verdict-fail'
                  : 'verdict-review';
        return `<tr>
          <td><strong>${t.name || t.kind || '?'}</strong></td>
          <td class="${cls}">${v || '—'}</td>
          <td>${(t.reasoning || t.summary || '').slice(0, 240)}</td>
        </tr>`;
      });
      const headerRow = `<tr style="background: rgba(0,212,255,0.04)">
        <td colspan="3"><strong>Overall:</strong> ${(so.overall_verdict || '—').toUpperCase()}${so.note ? ' · ' + so.note : ''}</td>
      </tr>`;
      soTbody.innerHTML = headerRow + rows.join('');
    } else {
      soTbody.innerHTML = '<tr><td colspan="3" style="color:var(--dim)">No Second Opinion returned (adversarial pass unavailable).</td></tr>';
    }

    // Signature row
    vfHash.textContent = s.bundle_hash || '(missing)';
    vfSig.textContent = s.bundle_signature || '(missing)';
    vfAnchor.textContent = s.chain_anchor || '(missing)';
    verifyBtn.disabled = !s.bundle_signature || !s.bundle_hash;
    verifyResult.textContent = '';
    verifyResult.className = 'verify-result';
    verifyBtn.classList.remove('verified');
    verifyBtn.textContent = 'Verify signature in browser';
  }

  // Bundle-panel tabs
  document.querySelectorAll('.bundle-tab').forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
      const target = tab.dataset.btab;
      document.querySelectorAll('.bundle-tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
      tab.classList.add('active');
      document.querySelectorAll('.bundle-tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
      document.getElementById('btab-' + target).classList.add('active');
    });
  });

  // Verify-offline button: fetches did.json, extracts the Ed25519 public key,
  // verifies the bundle signature against the canonical bundle hash. Pure
  // browser-side (Web Crypto) so the judge sees the check happen on their machine.
  function multibaseToBytes(mb) {
    // multibase 'z' prefix = base58btc. Strip the 'z'.
    if (!mb || mb[0] !== 'z') return null;
    const alphabet = '123456789ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz';
    let buffer = [0];
    for (const ch of mb.slice(1)) {
      const idx = alphabet.indexOf(ch);
      if (idx < 0) return null;
      let carry = idx;
      for (let i = 0; i < buffer.length; i++) {
        carry += buffer[i] * 58;
        buffer[i] = carry & 0xff;
        carry >>= 8;
      }
      while (carry) { buffer.push(carry & 0xff); carry >>= 8; }
    }
    for (const ch of mb.slice(1)) { if (ch !== '1') break; buffer.push(0); }
    return new Uint8Array(buffer.reverse());
  }

  verifyBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    if (!lastBundle) return;
    verifyBtn.disabled = true;
    verifyResult.className = 'verify-result';
    verifyResult.textContent = 'Fetching did.json + computing canonical hash…';
    try {
      const did = await (await fetch('/.well-known/did.json')).json();
      const vm = (did.verificationMethod || [])[0];
      const pkMb = vm && (vm.publicKeyMultibase || vm.publicKeyMultibase58);
      const raw = pkMb ? multibaseToBytes(pkMb) : null;
      // Multicodec prefix for Ed25519-pub is 0xed 0x01 (2 bytes); strip them.
      const pubKeyBytes = raw && raw.length > 2 && raw[0] === 0xed && raw[1] === 0x01
        ? raw.slice(2) : raw;
      if (!pubKeyBytes || pubKeyBytes.length !== 32) {
        throw new Error('failed to extract 32-byte Ed25519 public key from did.json');
      }
      // Reproduce the server's transport-stable canonical (shared.canonical_bundle_bytes):
      // recursively sort keys, drop `signature` + the derived `bundle_urn`, compact separators.
      const canon = (o) => Array.isArray(o)
        ? '[' + o.map(canon).join(',') + ']'
        : (o && typeof o === 'object')
          ? '{' + Object.keys(o).sort().map(k => JSON.stringify(k) + ':' + canon(o[k])).join(',') + '}'
          : JSON.stringify(o);
      const signed = { ...lastBundle.output };
      delete signed.signature; delete signed.bundle_urn;
      const msg = new TextEncoder().encode(canon(signed));
      // Parse signature: format is `ed25519:<did>#owner:<base64>`
      const sigStr = lastBundle.bundle_signature || '';
      const sigB64 = sigStr.split(':').pop();
      const sigBytes = Uint8Array.from(atob(sigB64.replace(/-/g, '+').replace(/_/g, '/')),
                                       c => c.charCodeAt(0));
      const cryptoKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', pubKeyBytes,
        { name: 'Ed25519' }, false, ['verify']);
      const ok = await crypto.subtle.verify('Ed25519', cryptoKey, sigBytes, msg);
      if (ok) {
        verifyResult.className = 'verify-result pass';
        verifyResult.textContent = '✓ VERIFIED in your browser. The mesh signed this bundle with the Ed25519 key advertised in /.well-known/did.json.';
        verifyBtn.classList.add('verified');
        verifyBtn.textContent = '✓ Verified';
      } else {
        verifyResult.className = 'verify-result fail';
        verifyResult.textContent = '✗ Signature did NOT verify against the published key — this bundle does not match what the mesh signed (tampered or altered in transit).';
        verifyBtn.disabled = false;
      }
    } catch (err) {
      verifyResult.className = 'verify-result fail';
      verifyResult.textContent = '✗ Verify failed: ' + (err.message || err);
      verifyBtn.disabled = false;
    }
  });

  function log(msg, cls) {
    const span = cls ? `<span class="${cls}">${msg}</span>` : msg;
    tryitOut.innerHTML += span + '\n';
    tryitOut.scrollTop = tryitOut.scrollHeight;
  }

  // 2026-05-25 (Omar L1+timer): timer + stage progress + hot-path lookup.
  const timerEl   = document.getElementById('tryit-timer');
  const elapsedEl = document.getElementById('tt-elapsed');
  const labelEl   = document.getElementById('tt-label');
  const stageStripEl = document.getElementById('stageStrip');
  const stageChips   = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.stage-chip'));

  function fmtElapsed(ms) {
    const total = ms / 1000;
    const m = String(Math.floor(total / 60)).padStart(2, '0');
    const s = (total % 60).toFixed(1).padStart(4, '0');
    return `${m}:${s}`;
  }

  let _timerHandle = null;
  function startTimer(label = 'elapsed', mode = '') {
    timerEl.hidden = false;
    timerEl.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
    labelEl.textContent = label;
    const t0 = performance.now();
    clearInterval(_timerHandle);
    elapsedEl.textContent = '00:00.0';
    _timerHandle = setInterval(() => {
      elapsedEl.textContent = fmtElapsed(performance.now() - t0);
    }, 100);
    return t0;
  }
  function stopTimer(finalMs, mode = 'done', label = 'total') {
    clearInterval(_timerHandle);
    timerEl.setAttribute('data-mode', mode);
    labelEl.textContent = label;
    elapsedEl.textContent = fmtElapsed(finalMs);
  }

  // Map progress_message tokens → stage chip data-stage attribute.
  // The mesh log strings are stable; this maps prefix substrings to chips.
  const STAGE_PATTERNS = [
    { match: /claim extraction|claim_ext/i,     stage: 'claim' },
    { match: /evidence|evidence_grad|pubmed/i,  stage: 'evidence' },
    { match: /vet rubric|vet_rubric|vet sim/i,  stage: 'vet' },
    { match: /compliance|ftc/i,                 stage: 'compliance' },
    { match: /auditor|audit|pre-sign/i,         stage: 'auditor' },
    { match: /sign|ed25519|merge/i,             stage: 'sign' },
    { match: /second opinion|adversarial|composer/i, stage: 'adversarial' },
  ];
  // Canonical stage order. The mesh runs evidence/vet/compliance/auditor in a
  // silent asyncio.gather (no per-agent progress message), so reaching a later
  // stage is the signal that all earlier ones finished — a signed bundle proves
  // evidence/vet/compliance/auditor ran. Light every preceding chip too.
  const STAGE_ORDER = ['claim', 'evidence', 'vet', 'compliance', 'auditor', 'sign', 'adversarial'];
  let _stagesSeen = new Set();
  function updateStage(progressMsg) {
    if (!progressMsg) return;
    for (const { match, stage } of STAGE_PATTERNS) {
      if (match.test(progressMsg)) {
        const idx = STAGE_ORDER.indexOf(stage);
        stageChips.forEach(ch => {
          const ci = STAGE_ORDER.indexOf(ch.dataset.stage);
          if (ci > -1 && ci < idx) {          // every stage before this one is done
            ch.classList.remove('running'); ch.classList.add('done');
            _stagesSeen.add(ch.dataset.stage);
          }
          if (ch.dataset.stage === stage) ch.classList.add('running');
        });
        _stagesSeen.add(stage);
        return;
      }
    }
  }
  function finalizeStages() {
    // "completed" == signed bundle + second opinion delivered → all 7 ran.
    stageChips.forEach(ch => { ch.classList.remove('running'); ch.classList.add('done'); });
  }
  function resetStages() {
    _stagesSeen.clear();
    stageChips.forEach(ch => { ch.classList.remove('running', 'done'); });
  }

  tryitBtn.addEventListener('click', async () => {
    const url = tryitUrl.value.trim();
    if (!url.startsWith('http')) {
      tryitOut.innerHTML = '';
      log('error: paste a full https:// URL', 'fail');
      return;
    }
    tryitBtn.disabled = true;
    tryitOut.innerHTML = '';
    resetStages();
    stageStripEl.hidden = true;

    // ---- HOT PATH FIRST: GET /a2a/v1/lookup ----
    log(`GET ${BASE}/a2a/v1/lookup?url=${encodeURIComponent(url).slice(0, 60)}…`, 'head');
    log(`# In-memory cache check before triggering the full mesh.`);
    log('');
    const t0 = startTimer('hot path', 'hot');
    try {
      const lookupRes = await fetch(`${BASE}/a2a/v1/lookup?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}`);
      const lookupMs = performance.now() - t0;
      if (lookupRes.ok) {
        const cached = await lookupRes.json();
        stopTimer(lookupMs, 'done', 'hot path · cache hit');
        log(`HTTP 200 · cached bundle returned in ${lookupMs.toFixed(0)} ms`, 'ok');
        log(`served_from=${cached.served_from}`);
        log(`age_seconds=${(cached.age_seconds || 0).toFixed(1)} s`);
        log(`bundle_hash=${cached.bundle_hash}`);
        log(`chain_anchor=${cached.chain_anchor}`);
        log('');
        log(`✓ HOT PATH · repeat queries skip the 7-agent mesh.`, 'ok');
        tryitStatus.textContent = `cache hit · ${lookupMs.toFixed(0)} ms`;
        renderBundle(cached);
        tryitBtn.disabled = false;
        return;
      }
      log(`HTTP 404 · not cached. Falling through to cold-path mesh.`);
      log('');
    } catch (err) {
      log(`hot-path lookup failed: ${err.message} · falling through`, 'fail');
    }

    // ---- COLD PATH: POST /a2a/v1/tasks/send ----
    stageStripEl.hidden = false;
    const tCold = startTimer('cold path · 7-agent mesh', 'cold');
    log(`POST ${BASE}/a2a/v1/tasks/send`, 'head');
    log(`X-API-Key: demo-key-2026-06`);
    log(`body: {message:{role:"user",parts:[{type:"text",text:"${url}"}]}, skill:"verify_claim"}`);
    log('');

    try {
      const r = await fetch(`${BASE}/a2a/v1/tasks/send`, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'X-API-Key': KEY, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          message: { role: 'user', parts: [{ type: 'text', text: url }] },
          skill: 'verify_claim',
        }),
      });
      if (!r.ok) {
        const detail = await r.text();
        log(`HTTP ${r.status}: ${detail}`, 'fail');
        tryitStatus.textContent = 'failed';
        stopTimer(performance.now() - tCold, 'done', 'failed');
        tryitBtn.disabled = false;
        return;
      }
      const sub = await r.json();
      log(`HTTP 202 task_id=${sub.task_id}`, 'ok');
      log(`head_anchor_at_submit=${sub.head_anchor_at_submit}`);
      log(`estimated_seconds=${sub.estimated_seconds}`);
      log('');

      // Poll
      let attempts = 0;
      let completedAttempt = -1;   // poll# when status first hit "completed"
      const maxAttempts = 60;  // ~3 min cap
      while (attempts < maxAttempts) {
        attempts++;
        await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 3000));
        const sr = await fetch(`${BASE}/a2a/v1/tasks/get/${sub.task_id}`, {
          headers: { 'X-API-Key': KEY },
        });
        const s = await sr.json();
        tryitStatus.textContent = `${s.status} · poll ${attempts}`;
        if (s.progress_message) {
          log(`  · ${s.progress_message}`);
          updateStage(s.progress_message);
        }
        if (s.status === 'completed') {
          if (completedAttempt < 0) {
            completedAttempt = attempts;
            const totalMs = performance.now() - tCold;
            stopTimer(totalMs, 'done', 'cold path · complete');
            finalizeStages();
            log('');
            log(`✓ COMPLETED in ${(totalMs / 1000).toFixed(1)} s`, 'ok');
            log(`bundle_hash=${s.bundle_hash}`);
            log(`bundle_signature=${(s.bundle_signature || '').slice(0,40)}…`);
            log(`chain_anchor=${s.chain_anchor}`);
            if (s.output) {
              // Mirrors shared/verdict.py: folds in vet rubric + Second Opinion,
              // never a green PASS for unsubstantiated claims.
              const out = s.output;
              const av = (out.audit || []).map(a => a && a.verdict).filter(Boolean);
              const vet = (out.vet_scores || []).map(v => v && v.score).filter(x => typeof x === 'number');
              const testable = vet.filter(x => x > 1);
              const ftc = (out.compliance || []).filter(c => c && c.violation_flag);
              const so = String((s.second_opinion || {}).overall_verdict || '').toUpperCase();
              let verdict;
              if (av.includes('FAIL') || so === 'FAIL') verdict = 'FAIL';
              else if (vet.length && !testable.length) verdict = 'UNVERIFIED (no substantiated claim)';
              else if (so === 'NEEDS REVIEW' || av.includes('CONDITIONAL') || ftc.length) verdict = 'CONDITIONAL';
              else if (testable.length && testable.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/testable.length < 2.5) verdict = 'CONDITIONAL';
              else if (testable.length) verdict = 'VERIFIED';
              else verdict = 'ISSUED';
              log(`claims=${(out.claims || []).length}`);
              log(`verdict=${verdict}`);
            }
          }
          renderBundle(s);   // re-render as cert_html + second_opinion attach post-sign
          // The bundle is signed (status flips to "completed") a few seconds
          // BEFORE the cert + second opinion attach. Keep polling until cert_html
          // arrives (or a short grace) so the CERT tab isn't rendered empty.
          // Break when the cert has attached, OR the backend signals the final
          // post-sign step is done, OR a grace (~54s) elapses. The grace must
          // outlast the server's 40s cert-composer timeout + static-cert attach,
          // so even a Gemini stall still lands the deterministic fallback cert.
          // The verdict + chips already rendered; this only waits for the cert tab.
          const finalized = /second opinion delivered/i.test(s.progress_message || '');
          if (s.cert_html || finalized || (attempts - completedAttempt) >= 18) {
            tryitStatus.textContent = 'completed';
            log('');
            log(`ⓘ This bundle is now cached. A repeat lookup for this URL will hit the hot path.`);
            break;
          }
          tryitStatus.textContent = 'completed · finalizing cert…';
        }
        if (s.status === 'failed') {
          stopTimer(performance.now() - tCold, 'done', 'failed');
          log(`✗ FAILED: ${s.error || 'unknown'}`, 'fail');
          tryitStatus.textContent = 'failed';
          break;
        }
      }
      if (attempts >= maxAttempts) {
        stopTimer(performance.now() - tCold, 'done', 'timeout');
        log('timeout. Task still running. Poll manually: /a2a/v1/tasks/get/' + sub.task_id, 'fail');
        tryitStatus.textContent = 'timeout';
      }
    } catch (e) {
      stopTimer(performance.now() - tCold, 'done', 'error');
      log(`error: ${e.message}`, 'fail');
      tryitStatus.textContent = 'error';
    }
    tryitBtn.disabled = false;
  });
</script>

<!--GLOBAL_FOOTER-->

</body>
</html>
```

The AI-simulated vet rubric scored them 4/5 and 3/5 respectively, citing a moderate body of evidence for the core ingredients.     "second_opinion": {
```json
      "tests": [
        {
          "name": "COURT",
          "verdict": "NEEDS REVIEW",
          "rationale": "Recent class-action settlements, like the $11.5M Cosequin case, show that plaintiffs are successfully challenging pet joint health claims that lack robust scientific substantiation, creating a significant legal risk for similar marketing language. "
        },
        {
          "name": "REGULATOR",
          "verdict": "NEEDS REVIEW",
          "rationale": "The FDA's official position is that CBD is an unapproved food additive, making CBD pet supplements technically illegal and subject to enforcement actions or warning letters, which have been issued to numerous companies for similar products. "
        },
        {
          "name": "SCIENTIFIC CONSENSUS",
          "verdict": "NEEDS REVIEW",
          "rationale": "A 2023 systematic review and meta-analysis concluded that the evidence for CBD's efficacy in treating canine osteoarthritis is of \"very low\" certainty, contradicting the claim that it is \"known for helping maintain joint health.\" "
        },
        {
          "name": "PUBLIC SKEPTICISM",
          "verdict": "NEEDS REVIEW",
          "rationale": "A skeptical buyer would find that veterinary organizations like Canine Arthritis Management state there are \"too many uncertainties\" to recommend CBD, and the FDA has not approved it for animal use, creating a credible counter-narrative to positive user reviews. "
        }
      ],
      "strongest_counter": "The FDA has not approved CBD for any use in animals, considers it an illegal food additive, and actively issues warning letters to companies making health claims for pet CBD supplements, meaning this product exists in a state of regulatory non-compliance.",
      "overall_verdict": "NEEDS REVIEW",
      "summary": "The market is ahead of the science and the law; while customers seem happy, we're operating in a regulatory gray zone with claims that lack strong scientific backing and could attract legal or regulatory challenges."
    },
    "cert_html": "<div class=\"cert-composed\">\n  <style>\n    .cert-composed {\n      background: #111;\n      border: 1px solid #333;\n      padding: 24px;\n      border-radius: 8px;\n      color: var(--ink, #EAEAEA);\n      font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, \"Segoe UI\", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif, \"Apple Color Emoji\", \"Segoe UI Emoji\", \"Segoe UI Symbol\";\n      font-size: 16px;\n      line-height: 1.6;\n    }\n    .cert-headline {\n      font-size: 1.25rem;\n      font-weight: 600;\n      margin-bottom: 16px;\n    }\n    .cert-headline .brand {\n      color: var(--muted, #999);\n    }\n    .cert-headline .verdict-fail {\n      color: var(--warning, #FF5C35);\n    }\n    .cert-narrative {\n      margin-bottom: 24px;\n      max-width: 75ch;\n    }\n    .cert-actions h3 {\n      font-size: 1rem;\n      font-weight: 600;\n      letter-spacing: 0.02em;\n      margin: 24px 0 12px 0;\n      color: var(--electric, #00D4FF);\n    }\n    .cert-actions ol {\n      padding-left: 20px;\n      margin: 0;\n    }\n    .cert-actions li {\n      margin-bottom: 8px;\n    }\n    .cert-footer {\n      margin-top: 32px;\n      padding-top: 16px;\n      border-top: 1px solid #333;\n      font-family: \"JetBrains Mono\", monospace;\n      font-size: 0.75rem;\n      color: var(--muted, #999);\n      line-height: 1.5;\n    }\n    .cert-disclosure-inline {\n        display: block;\n        margin-top: 8px;\n        font-size: 0.62rem;\n        color: var(--muted, #999);\n        line-height: 1.4;\n        max-width: 80ch;\n    }\n    :root {\n      --mono: \"JetBrains Mono\", monospace;\n    }\n  </style>\n\n  <div class=\"cert-headline\">\n    <span class=\"brand\">Green Gruff</span> \u00b7 Joint & Hip CBD Supplements For Dogs \u00b7 <span class=\"verdict-fail\">FAIL</span>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"cert-narrative\">\n    This bundle covers three efficacy claims for the EASE supplement, revealing significant compliance risks. The primary claim, \"Joint & Hip CBD Supplements For Dogs,\" received a FAIL verdict from the Falsifier auditor. The FTC \u00a7255 substantiation check flagged this claim as deceptive under \u00a7255.1, as it is a structure-function claim presented without any PubMed-retrieved papers in the evidence bundle. A second claim, \"known for helping maintain joint health,\" was also flagged and received a CONDITIONAL audit verdict. While supported by six papers, the AI vet-rubric simulation scored it a 3 out of 5, noting mixed evidence. A third, weaker claim (\"may maintain healthy function\") passed the audit and FTC check, but the AI-simulated vet rubric gave it a low 2/5 score, citing sparse evidence for the target population. Two of three claims require immediate attention before launch.\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"cert-actions\">\n    <h3>Ship-Before-Launch Fixes</h3>\n    <ol>\n      <li>Remove or substantiate the primary \"Joint & Hip\" claim. It currently has a FAIL verdict, an FTC violation flag, and zero supporting papers.</li>\n      <li>Revise the \"known for helping...\" claim. The FTC \u00a7255 substantiation check flagged this phrasing as an unsubstantiated efficacy claim. Consider weaker, qualified language like \"formulated to support...\".</li>\n      <li>Strengthen the evidence bundle for all claims. The AI vet-rubric simulation returned low-to-moderate scores (2, 3, and 4 out of 5), citing \"sparse\" and \"mixed\" evidence. Adding higher-quality, species-specific studies would improve substantiation.</li>\n    </ol>\n  </div>\n\n  <div class=\"cert-footer\">\n    urn:pcec:claim:gamfi6bie72bttd63kxufqjg<br>\n    sha256:301854782827f419cc7edaaf42c126b517b3cc914a14491eee61fe600e330a21<br>\n    <span class=\"cert-disclosure-inline\">Disclosure: AI-derived attestation \u00b7 vet rubric is an LLM simulation \u00b7 audit + Second Opinion are LLM agents over real evidence (PubMed, FTC \u00a7255, Google Search) \u00b7 Ed25519 signed</span>\n    <details style=\"margin-top:6px;\">\n      <summary style=\"cursor:pointer;color:var(--electric);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:0.62rem;letter-spacing:0.16em;text-transform:uppercase;\">Show full scope of attestation</summary>\n      <ul style=\"margin:8px 0 0 0;padding-left:18px;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:0.62rem;color:var(--dim);line-height:1.6;list-style:none;\">\n        <li>\u00b7 Vet rubric: Gemini 2.5 Pro simulating a 5-vet panel. Not licensed-DVM attestation. Replaced by the attest_expert A2A skill in v0.2.</li>\n        <li>\u00b7 Evidence retrieval: BioMCP \u2192 PubMed (real papers) + Semantic Scholar citation grading. Real-existence verification of PMIDs is PMID-format only at v0.1; citation_enricher extends to existence + influence.</li>\n        <li>\u00b7 Compliance: Vertex AI Search over public FTC 16 CFR \u00a7255 + AAFCO PF7 + NASC public seal corpus. No licensed handbooks ingested.</li>\n        <li>\u00b7 Auditor (Falsifier v0): claim-direction + PMID-format checks only.</li>\n        <li>\u00b7 Second Opinion: Gemini 2.5 Pro + Google Search grounding.</li>\n        <li>\u00b7 Signed: Ed25519 with mesh's own key (did:web:mesh-api-...). Not a 3rd-party accredited co-signature; partner co-signing tier (NASC / NSF / vet-school) is v0.2 roadmap.</li>\n      </ul>\n    </details>\n  </div>\n</div>"
```

#### `demo/captures/gen_captions_v5_1.py` — 109 lines

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate v5.1 SRT captions from the 8 VO beat MP3 durations.

Each beat is rendered as 1-2 SRT cues (split on sentence boundaries
where the VO has a natural breath). Captions are timed to the beat
windows in the v5.1 plan, NOT the raw MP3 durations (we want them
aligned to the visual cuts).

Args: vo_dir srt_out
"""
import sys
from pathlib import Path

# v5.1 beat windows (start, end, list-of-cues per beat).
BEAT_WINDOWS = [
    # Beat 1 — 0:00-0:10
    (0, 10, [
        "Watch what an AI agent recommends",
        "when nobody is checking.",
        "A calming chew that claims to reduce anxiety by 60 percent.",
    ]),
    # Beat 2 — 0:10-0:18 (8s title)
    (10, 18, [
        "PawConscious Mesh is the check every AI shopping agent",
        "should run before recommending a product.",
    ]),
    # Beat 3 — 0:18-0:38 (20s BLOCK)
    (18, 38, [
        "Same claim. Five specialized agents.",
        "BioMCP finds no canine trial.",
        "Vertex AI Search flags two FTC violations.",
        "The vet rubric scores it one out of five.",
        "The bundle is signed and rejected.",
    ]),
    # Beat 4 — 0:38-0:48 (10s replacement copy)
    (38, 48, [
        "Here's what the brand can ship instead.",
        "Honest copy, evidence-graded.",
        "The brand stays out of court.",
    ]),
    # Beat 5 — 0:48-1:03 (15s PASS + chain anchor)
    (48, 63, [
        "The mesh also clears the products that are real.",
        "Three claims. Multiple PubMed papers. Zero FTC flags.",
        "Signed Ed25519. Anchored to a public chain.",
    ]),
    # Beat 6 — 1:03-1:20 (17s architecture)
    (63, 80, [
        "Seven agents on Google Cloud.",
        "ADK orchestrates five reasoning agents that fan out per claim.",
        "Two adversarial agents stress-test the signed bundle",
        "before it leaves the mesh.",
    ]),
    # Beat 7 — 1:20-1:40 (20s audit trail)
    (80, 100, [
        "If we're wrong, the brand has the receipt.",
        "Every verdict links to the previous one through a public chain anchor.",
        "A plaintiff, a retailer, a judge.",
        "Anyone can audit the entire history.",
    ]),
    # Beat 8 — 1:40-2:00 (20s enterprise close)
    (100, 120, [
        "Signed proof for every product claim",
        "before any shopping agent recommends it.",
        "PawConscious Mesh is live.",
        "Brands subscribe from $99 to $499 a month.",
        "Shopping agents pay per verified claim.",
        "Open the URL. Paste a product page. See it run.",
    ]),
]


def ts(seconds: float) -> str:
    """SRT format HH:MM:SS,ms"""
    ms = int(round(seconds * 1000))
    h = ms // 3_600_000
    m = (ms // 60_000) % 60
    s = (ms // 1000) % 60
    msr = ms % 1000
    return f"{h:02d}:{m:02d}:{s:02d},{msr:03d}"


def main() -> int:
    if len(sys.argv) < 3:
        print("usage: gen_captions_v5_1.py <vo_dir> <srt_out>", file=sys.stderr)
        return 2
    out = Path(sys.argv[2])

    cue_idx = 1
    lines: list[str] = []
    for (start, end, cues) in BEAT_WINDOWS:
        window = end - start
        per_cue = window / len(cues)
        for i, cue in enumerate(cues):
            cue_start = start + i * per_cue
            cue_end = cue_start + per_cue - 0.05  # tiny gap between cues
            lines.append(str(cue_idx))
            lines.append(f"{ts(cue_start)} --> {ts(cue_end)}")
            lines.append(cue)
            lines.append("")
            cue_idx += 1

    out.write_text("\n".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[srt] wrote {cue_idx - 1} cues to {out}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

#### `demo/captures/gen_music.py` — 114 lines

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate a ~45s music bed via Lyria 2 on Vertex AI (o22-dev project).
Three 15s clips, slightly different prompt seeds for tonal variety, then
crossfaded via ffmpeg into one continuous bed.

Output: demo/captures/music-v2/bed.wav (45s)
"""
import base64
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv(Path.home() / "Desktop" / "o22-studio" / ".env")
GCP_PROJECT = os.environ.get("GCP_PROJECT", "o22-dev")
GCP_LOCATION = os.environ.get("GCP_LOCATION", "us-central1")

OUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "music-v2"
OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# v2.1: modern atmospheric texture - no obvious melody, just sub-bass + air.
# Founder-demo / tech-keynote feel (think Apple product film score).
PROMPTS = [
    "soft ambient synth pad with subtle sub-bass pulse, atmospheric, no melody, no percussion, modern technology film score, instrumental",
    "minimal electronic texture with warm sub-bass and gentle high-frequency shimmer, contemplative, sparse, modern tech aesthetic, no vocals",
    "atmospheric drone with quiet synth wash, slow movement, no melody, no rhythm, ambient film score, instrumental",
]


def get_access_token() -> str:
    r = subprocess.run(
        ["gcloud", "auth", "print-access-token"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
    )
    return r.stdout.strip()


def gen_clip(idx: int, prompt: str, token: str) -> Path:
    url = (
        f"https://{GCP_LOCATION}-aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/"
        f"{GCP_PROJECT}/locations/{GCP_LOCATION}/publishers/google/models/"
        f"lyria-002:predict"
    )
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    body = json.dumps({
        "instances": [{"prompt": prompt}],
        "parameters": {"sample_count": 1},
    }).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=90) as resp:
            data = json.loads(resp.read())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        body = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:400]
        print(f"[ERR] clip {idx} HTTP {e.code}: {body}", file=sys.stderr)
        return None
    audio_b64 = data["predictions"][0]["bytesBase64Encoded"]
    out = OUT_DIR / f"clip-{idx}.wav"
    out.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(audio_b64))
    print(f"[ok] clip-{idx}.wav ({out.stat().st_size // 1024} KB)")
    return out


def main():
    token = get_access_token()
    print(f"[lyria] using project={GCP_PROJECT} location={GCP_LOCATION}")
    clips = []
    for i, p in enumerate(PROMPTS, 1):
        path = gen_clip(i, p, token)
        if path:
            clips.append(path)
        time.sleep(1.0)

    if len(clips) < 1:
        print("[ERR] no clips generated", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)

    # Crossfade them into one 45s bed via ffmpeg. If we got fewer than 3
    # clips, repeat what we have. Each clip is ~30s by default (Lyria 2),
    # but our budget needs ~45s. Strategy: take first ~22s of clip 1, crossfade
    # into clip 2 over 2s, take next ~20s, crossfade into clip 3 for 2s tail.
    bed = OUT_DIR / "bed.wav"
    if len(clips) >= 2:
        # acrossfade is the cleanest way to glue two clips.
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y"]
        for c in clips:
            cmd += ["-i", str(c)]
        if len(clips) == 2:
            filter_cmd = "[0:a][1:a]acrossfade=d=3:c1=tri:c2=tri,atrim=0:45,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[out]"
        else:  # 3 clips
            filter_cmd = (
                "[0:a][1:a]acrossfade=d=3:c1=tri:c2=tri[ab];"
                "[ab][2:a]acrossfade=d=3:c1=tri:c2=tri,atrim=0:45,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[out]"
            )
        cmd += ["-filter_complex", filter_cmd, "-map", "[out]", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", str(bed)]
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, capture_output=True)
    else:
        # single clip: loop + trim to 45s
        cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-stream_loop", "5", "-i", str(clips[0]),
               "-t", "45", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", str(bed)]
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, capture_output=True)

    dur_cmd = ["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration",
               "-of", "default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1", str(bed)]
    dur = subprocess.run(dur_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    print(f"\n[ok] bed -> {bed} ({dur}s)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""V3 submission video music bed via Lyria 2 on Vertex AI (o22-dev).

Single bed, 75 BPM atmospheric, no melody, sub-bass + air. Concatenated
to 150 seconds via ffmpeg. A swell layer is mixed in at beat 7 (01:18)
and peaks at beat 9 (01:44) - that's handled at mix time, not here.

Output: demo/captures/music-v3/bed.wav (150s total)
"""
import base64
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv(Path.home() / "Desktop" / "o22-studio" / ".env")
GCP_PROJECT = os.environ.get("GCP_PROJECT", "o22-dev")
GCP_LOCATION = os.environ.get("GCP_LOCATION", "us-central1")

OUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "music-v3"
OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# V3: founder-keynote / Apple product film aesthetic. Slightly warmer than
# v2 because the submission video is longer (2:30 vs 45s teaser) and the
# bed needs to feel intentional under VO across 12 beats. Lyria 2 clips are
# ~30s each by default; we generate 6 with slight prompt drift, crossfade
# into one 150s bed.
PROMPTS = [
    "Soft ambient synth pad with subtle sub-bass pulse, no melody, no percussion, modern technology film score, 75 BPM, warm low end, instrumental, contemplative",
    "Minimal electronic texture with warm sub-bass and gentle high-frequency shimmer, 75 BPM, sparse, modern tech aesthetic, no vocals, no drums",
    "Atmospheric drone with quiet synth wash, slow movement, no melody, no rhythm, 75 BPM, ambient film score, instrumental, breathing space",
    "Warm pad with gentle shimmer, 75 BPM, slow attack, no rhythm, contemplative tech keynote score, no vocals, sub-bass present",
    "Minimal ambient texture, atmospheric, no melody, no kick, 75 BPM, soft synth pad with brief shimmer, modern instrumental, breathing space",
    "Warm sustained pad with sub-bass pulse, no melody, no drums, 75 BPM, contemplative ambient, modern technology film score, instrumental",
]


def get_access_token() -> str:
    r = subprocess.run(
        ["gcloud", "--configuration=o22", "auth", "print-access-token"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
    )
    return r.stdout.strip()


def gen_clip(idx: int, prompt: str, token: str) -> Path | None:
    url = (
        f"https://{GCP_LOCATION}-aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/"
        f"{GCP_PROJECT}/locations/{GCP_LOCATION}/publishers/google/models/"
        f"lyria-002:predict"
    )
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
    body = json.dumps({
        "instances": [{"prompt": prompt}],
        "parameters": {"sample_count": 1},
    }).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body, headers=headers)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=90) as resp:
            data = json.loads(resp.read())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        msg = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:400]
        print(f"[err] clip {idx} HTTP {e.code}: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
        return None
    audio_b64 = data["predictions"][0]["bytesBase64Encoded"]
    out = OUT_DIR / f"clip-{idx}.wav"
    out.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(audio_b64))
    print(f"[ok] clip-{idx}.wav ({out.stat().st_size // 1024} KB)")
    return out


def main():
    token = get_access_token()
    print(f"[lyria v3] project={GCP_PROJECT} location={GCP_LOCATION}")
    clips = []
    for i, p in enumerate(PROMPTS, 1):
        path = gen_clip(i, p, token)
        if path:
            clips.append(path)
        time.sleep(1.0)

    if len(clips) < 2:
        print("[err] need at least 2 clips for crossfade", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)

    bed = OUT_DIR / "bed.wav"
    # Crossfade 6 clips (each ~30s) into a 150s bed with 3s crossfades.
    # Each clip contributes ~25s after the crossfade math.
    cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y"]
    for c in clips:
        cmd += ["-i", str(c)]

    if len(clips) >= 6:
        filter_cmd = (
            "[0:a][1:a]acrossfade=d=3:c1=tri:c2=tri[ab];"
            "[ab][2:a]acrossfade=d=3:c1=tri:c2=tri[abc];"
            "[abc][3:a]acrossfade=d=3:c1=tri:c2=tri[abcd];"
            "[abcd][4:a]acrossfade=d=3:c1=tri:c2=tri[abcde];"
            "[abcde][5:a]acrossfade=d=3:c1=tri:c2=tri,atrim=0:150,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[out]"
        )
    elif len(clips) >= 3:
        filter_cmd = (
            "[0:a][1:a]acrossfade=d=3:c1=tri:c2=tri[ab];"
            "[ab][2:a]acrossfade=d=3:c1=tri:c2=tri,aloop=loop=-1:size=44100*150,atrim=0:150,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[out]"
        )
    else:
        filter_cmd = (
            "[0:a][1:a]acrossfade=d=3:c1=tri:c2=tri,aloop=loop=-1:size=44100*150,atrim=0:150,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS[out]"
        )

    cmd += ["-filter_complex", filter_cmd, "-map", "[out]", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", str(bed)]
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, capture_output=True)

    dur_cmd = [
        "ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration",
        "-of", "default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1", str(bed),
    ]
    dur = subprocess.run(dur_cmd, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    print(f"\n[ok] bed -> {bed} ({dur}s)")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

#### `demo/captures/gen_veo_labrador.py` — 142 lines

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""V3 submission video · Beat 10 hero clip via Veo 3.1 on Vertex AI.

One 8-second cinematic B-roll of a Labrador at golden hour with an
owner's hand holding a phone in foreground. Codex-locked storyboard
(2026-05-23).

Output: demo/captures/veo-v3/labrador-golden-hour.mp4
"""
import base64
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from dotenv import load_dotenv

load_dotenv(Path.home() / "Desktop" / "o22-studio" / ".env")
GCP_PROJECT = os.environ.get("GCP_PROJECT", "o22-dev")
GCP_LOCATION = "us-central1"
MODEL = "veo-3.1-generate-001"  # GA endpoint (Nov 2025)

OUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "veo-v3"
OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

PROMPT = (
    "Soft golden-hour light streams through a kitchen window onto a hardwood floor. "
    "A relaxed yellow Labrador, 8 years old, lies on a wool rug with its head on its "
    "paws, slow blink. In the foreground, slightly out of focus, a person's hand holds "
    "an iPhone, screen barely visible but warm-toned. Camera slow push-in 8 seconds, "
    "shallow depth of field, 35mm lens look, no people's faces visible, no text on screen. "
    "Color grade: warm cream highlights, cool shadow lift. Cinematic, photoreal, "
    "documentary calm. 24fps motion blur."
)


def get_token() -> str:
    r = subprocess.run(
        ["gcloud", "--configuration=o22", "auth", "print-access-token"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=True,
    )
    return r.stdout.strip()


def submit_job(token: str) -> str:
    """Returns the long-running operation name."""
    url = (
        f"https://{GCP_LOCATION}-aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/"
        f"{GCP_PROJECT}/locations/{GCP_LOCATION}/publishers/google/models/"
        f"{MODEL}:predictLongRunning"
    )
    body = json.dumps({
        "instances": [{"prompt": PROMPT}],
        "parameters": {
            "durationSeconds": 8,
            "aspectRatio": "16:9",
            "resolution": "1080p",
            "sampleCount": 1,
            "personGeneration": "allow_adult",
        },
    }).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url, data=body,
        headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
            d = json.loads(resp.read())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        msg = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:600]
        print(f"[err] submit HTTP {e.code}: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    op_name = d.get("name")
    print(f"[ok] op_name: {op_name}")
    return op_name


def poll_until_done(op_name: str, token: str, timeout_s: int = 600) -> dict:
    """Poll the LRO until done. Returns the response dict."""
    url = (
        f"https://{GCP_LOCATION}-aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/"
        f"{GCP_PROJECT}/locations/{GCP_LOCATION}/publishers/google/models/"
        f"{MODEL}:fetchPredictOperation"
    )
    body = json.dumps({"operationName": op_name}).encode()
    start = time.time()
    while time.time() - start < timeout_s:
        req = urllib.request.Request(
            url, data=body,
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}", "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        )
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
                d = json.loads(resp.read())
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            msg = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:400]
            print(f"[warn] poll HTTP {e.code}: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
            time.sleep(8)
            continue
        if d.get("done"):
            return d
        print(f"[..] polling ({int(time.time() - start)}s elapsed)")
        time.sleep(8)
    raise SystemExit("[err] poll timeout")


def extract_video(resp: dict) -> Path:
    """The response embeds the video bytes base64."""
    response = resp.get("response") or {}
    videos = response.get("videos") or response.get("generatedSamples") or []
    if not videos:
        # Try other possible shapes
        preds = response.get("predictions") or []
        for p in preds:
            if p.get("bytesBase64Encoded"):
                videos.append(p)
    if not videos:
        print("[err] no video in response:", json.dumps(resp, indent=2)[:600], file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    v = videos[0]
    b64 = v.get("bytesBase64Encoded") or v.get("video", {}).get("bytesBase64Encoded")
    if not b64:
        print("[err] no bytes in video entry:", str(v)[:400], file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    out = OUT_DIR / "labrador-golden-hour.mp4"
    out.write_bytes(base64.b64decode(b64))
    print(f"[ok] saved -> {out} ({out.stat().st_size // 1024} KB)")
    return out


def main():
    token = get_token()
    print(f"[veo v3] {MODEL} on {GCP_PROJECT}/{GCP_LOCATION}")
    op = submit_job(token)
    resp = poll_until_done(op, token)
    extract_video(resp)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```

```python
def submit(token):
    url = (f"https://{GCP_LOCATION}-aiplatform.googleapis.com/v1/projects/"
           f"{GCP_PROJECT}/locations/{GCP_LOCATION}/publishers/google/models/"
           f"{MODEL}:predictLongRunning")
    body = json.dumps({
        "instances": [{"prompt": PROMPT}],
        "parameters": {"durationSeconds": 8, "aspectRatio": "16:9",
                       "resolution": "1080p", "sampleCount": 1,
                       "personGeneration": "allow_adult"},

    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=body,
```

#### `demo/captures/gen_vo.py` — 82 lines

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Generate the 6 VO segments for the PawConscious demo video via ElevenLabs.

Outputs one MP3 per narration beat so the recorder can sync each beat to its
exact visual moment in ffmpeg. Total run = ~40 seconds of voiceover.

Run: python demo/captures/gen_vo.py
"""
import os
import sys
import json
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path
from dotenv import load_dotenv

# Reuse the O22 .env for the ElevenLabs key (already verified working).
load_dotenv(Path.home() / "Desktop" / "o22-studio" / ".env")

ELEVEN_KEY = os.environ.get("ELEVENLABS_API_KEY")
if not ELEVEN_KEY:
    print("ERROR: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY missing from o22-studio/.env", file=sys.stderr)
    sys.exit(1)

# Rachel — neutral, professional, female. Codex pick over GUARDIAN-Design-1.
VOICE_ID = "21m00Tcm4TlvDq8ikWAM"
MODEL = "eleven_multilingual_v2"
# Calm, founder-demo cadence. Lower stability = more natural emphasis; higher
# similarity boost = consistent per-clip tone across all 6 segments.
SETTINGS = {
    "stability": 0.55,
    "similarity_boost": 0.85,
    "style": 0.25,
    "use_speaker_boost": True,
}

BEATS = [
    ("01", "AI shopping recommendations are confident. They aren't always verified."),
    ("02", "A pet owner asks Gemini for hip and joint chews for their dog."),
    ("03", "Gemini finds three options, then routes the claims to PawConscious."),
    ("04", "PawConscious is the trust layer. Evidence. FTC rules. Vet rubric. Every claim signed."),
    ("05", "One pick comes back verified. One click opens the vendor."),
    ("06", "The recommendation isn't trusted because it's confident. It's trusted because it's verified."),
]

OUT_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "vo"
OUT_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)


def gen_beat(beat_id: str, text: str) -> Path:
    out = OUT_DIR / f"beat-{beat_id}.mp3"
    url = f"https://api.elevenlabs.io/v1/text-to-speech/{VOICE_ID}"
    payload = json.dumps({
        "text": text,
        "model_id": MODEL,
        "voice_settings": SETTINGS,
    }).encode()
    req = urllib.request.Request(
        url,
        data=payload,
        headers={
            "xi-api-key": ELEVEN_KEY,
            "Content-Type": "application/json",
            "Accept": "audio/mpeg",
        },
        method="POST",
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=60) as resp:
            audio = resp.read()
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        body = e.read().decode(errors="ignore")[:300]
        print(f"[ERR] beat {beat_id} HTTP {e.code}: {body}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(2)
    out.write_bytes(audio)
    print(f"[ok]  beat-{beat_id}.mp3 ({len(audio) // 1024} KB) :: {text[:60]}")
    return out


if __name__ == "__main__":
    for beat_id, text in BEATS:
        gen_beat(beat_id, text)
    print(f"\nAll 6 VO segments written to {OUT_DIR}")
```

```python
def gen_beat(idx: int, text: str) -> Path:

        "Content-Type": "application/json",

        "model_id": MODEL,
        "voice_settings": SETTINGS,

    data = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, headers=headers, method="POST")
    out = OUT_DIR / f"beat-{idx:02d}.mp3"

        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=90) as resp:
            out.write_bytes(resp.read())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        msg = e.read().decode("utf-8", errors="replace")[:400]
        print(f"[err] beat {idx} HTTP {e.code}: {msg}", file=sys.stderr)
        return None
    print(f"[ok] beat-{idx:02d}.mp3 ({out.stat().st_size // 1024} KB)  · {len(text.split())} words")
    return out


def main() -> int:
    print(f"[v3 vo] generating {len(BEATS)} beats to {OUT_DIR}")
    total = 0
    failures = 0
    for i, text in enumerate(BEATS, 1):
        path = gen_beat(i, text)
        if path is None:
            failures += 1
        else:
            total += len(text.split())
    print(f"\n[v3 vo] total words: {total}")
    print(f"[v3 vo] failures: {failures}/{len(BEATS)}")
    return 0 if failures == 0 else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

```python
        return None
```

```python
def main():
```

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Mix the silent demo recording with the 6 ElevenLabs VO segments at exact
# timestamps. Output: pawconscious-demo-v1.mp4 (H.264 + AAC, ~33s).
#
# Beat timestamps (start, seconds from t=0):
#   beat-01.mp3  start at  1.0s
#   beat-02.mp3  start at  5.0s
#   beat-03.mp3  start at  9.5s
#   beat-04.mp3  start at 13.5s   (hero moment - bento lighting up)
#   beat-05.mp3  start at 19.8s
#   beat-06.mp3  start at 24.5s

set -euo pipefail

DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
RAW="$DIR/raw/recording.webm"
VO_DIR="$DIR/vo"
OUT="$DIR/pawconscious-demo-v1.mp4"

[ -f "$RAW" ] || { echo "missing $RAW" >&2; exit 1; }
for n in 01 02 03 04 05 06; do
  [ -f "$VO_DIR/beat-$n.mp3" ] || { echo "missing beat-$n.mp3" >&2; exit 1; }
done

# Build a single mixed VO track by padding each beat with silence to its
# start offset, then mixing all six.
TMP_VO="$DIR/_vo_mixed.m4a"

ffmpeg -y \
  -i "$VO_DIR/beat-01.mp3" \
  -i "$VO_DIR/beat-02.mp3" \
  -i "$VO_DIR/beat-03.mp3" \
  -i "$VO_DIR/beat-04.mp3" \
  -i "$VO_DIR/beat-05.mp3" \
  -i "$VO_DIR/beat-06.mp3" \
  -filter_complex "
    [0:a]adelay=1000|1000[a0];
    [1:a]adelay=5000|5000[a1];
    [2:a]adelay=9500|9500[a2];
    [3:a]adelay=13500|13500[a3];
    [4:a]adelay=19800|19800[a4];
    [5:a]adelay=27500|27500[a5];
    [a0][a1][a2][a3][a4][a5]amix=inputs=6:duration=longest:dropout_transition=0:normalize=0,
    volume=1.4,
    apad=whole_dur=33
  " \
  -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 44100 -ac 2 \
  "$TMP_VO" 2>&1 | tail -5

# Combine silent video with the mixed VO. Cap to 33 seconds.
ffmpeg -y \
  -i "$RAW" \
  -i "$TMP_VO" \
  -map 0:v -map 1:a \
  -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p -preset slow -crf 18 \
  -c:a aac -b:a 192k \
  -t 33 \
  -movflags +faststart \
  "$OUT" 2>&1 | tail -5

rm -f "$TMP_VO"

echo
echo "FINAL: $OUT"
ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration,bit_rate -show_entries stream=codec_name,width,height -of default=noprint_wrappers=1 "$OUT"
echo "Size: $(du -h "$OUT" | cut -f1)"
```

#### `demo/captures/mix_video_v2.sh` — 155 lines

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# v2 mixer: intro card + main demo + end card with Antoni VO and Lyria music bed.
# Music ducks under VO by 3 dB, drops to silence for 1s at the bento reveal.
# Total target: ~45s.
#
# Layout:
#   0:00 - 0:02   intro_card.png
#   0:02 - 0:42   recording.webm (40s of demo)
#   0:42 - 0:45   end_card.png
#
# VO timestamps (relative to final 45s video):
#   beat 1 (5.29s)  starts at  2.0s
#   beat 2 (4.04s)  starts at  8.5s
#   beat 3 (4.41s)  starts at 13.5s
#   beat 4 (13.19s) starts at 19.0s   (HERO - aligns with bento lighting up)
#   beat 5 (2.79s)  starts at 33.0s
#   beat 6 (3.99s)  starts at 36.5s

set -euo pipefail

DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
RAW="$DIR/raw-v2/recording.webm"
VO_DIR="$DIR/vo-v2"
MUSIC="$DIR/music-v2/bed.wav"
INTRO_PNG="$DIR/intro_card.png"
END_PNG="$DIR/end_card.png"
OUT="$DIR/pawconscious-demo-v2.mp4"

[ -f "$RAW" ] || { echo "missing $RAW" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -f "$MUSIC" ] || { echo "missing $MUSIC" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -f "$INTRO_PNG" ] || { echo "missing $INTRO_PNG" >&2; exit 1; }
[ -f "$END_PNG" ] || { echo "missing $END_PNG" >&2; exit 1; }
for n in 01 02 03 04 05 06; do
  [ -f "$VO_DIR/beat-$n.mp3" ] || { echo "missing beat-$n.mp3" >&2; exit 1; }
done

WORK="$DIR/_work_v2"
mkdir -p "$WORK"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 1: build the visual track (intro + main + end), 45s total, no audio.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
INTRO_MP4="$WORK/intro.mp4"
END_MP4="$WORK/end.mp4"
MAIN_MP4="$WORK/main.mp4"

# intro card -> 2s silent mp4
ffmpeg -y -loop 1 -i "$INTRO_PNG" -t 2 -pix_fmt yuv420p \
  -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -r 30 \
  -vf "scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:color=#0E1218" \
  "$INTRO_MP4" 2>&1 | tail -3

# main recording trimmed to 40s, transcoded to h264 for clean concat
ffmpeg -y -i "$RAW" -t 40 -pix_fmt yuv420p \
  -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -r 30 \
  -vf "scale=1920:1080" \
  -an \
  "$MAIN_MP4" 2>&1 | tail -3

# end card -> 3s silent mp4
ffmpeg -y -loop 1 -i "$END_PNG" -t 3 -pix_fmt yuv420p \
  -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -r 30 \
  -vf "scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=decrease,pad=1920:1080:(ow-iw)/2:(oh-ih)/2:color=#0E1218" \
  "$END_MP4" 2>&1 | tail -3

# Concat: intro + main + end -> visual.mp4 (45s, silent)
VIDEO_FULL="$WORK/visual.mp4"
cat > "$WORK/concat.txt" <<EOF
file '$INTRO_MP4'
file '$MAIN_MP4'
file '$END_MP4'
EOF
ffmpeg -y -f concat -safe 0 -i "$WORK/concat.txt" -c copy "$VIDEO_FULL" 2>&1 | tail -3

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 2: build the VO chain at the locked timestamps.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
VO_FULL="$WORK/vo.m4a"
ffmpeg -y \
  -i "$VO_DIR/beat-01.mp3" \
  -i "$VO_DIR/beat-02.mp3" \
  -i "$VO_DIR/beat-03.mp3" \
  -i "$VO_DIR/beat-04.mp3" \
  -i "$VO_DIR/beat-05.mp3" \
  -i "$VO_DIR/beat-06.mp3" \
  -filter_complex "
    [0:a]adelay=2000|2000[a0];
    [1:a]adelay=8500|8500[a1];
    [2:a]adelay=13500|13500[a2];
    [3:a]adelay=19000|19000[a3];
    [4:a]adelay=33000|33000[a4];
    [5:a]adelay=36500|36500[a5];
    [a0][a1][a2][a3][a4][a5]amix=inputs=6:duration=longest:dropout_transition=0:normalize=0,
    volume=1.5,
    apad=whole_dur=45,
    atrim=0:45,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS
  " \
  -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 44100 -ac 2 \
  "$VO_FULL" 2>&1 | tail -3

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 3: build the music bed with the 1s drop at the bento reveal (T=18-19s).
# Trim to 45s, apply -8 dB baseline, drop to -30 dB for 1s before beat 4.
# Then we'll sidechain-duck under the VO when amixing.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
MUSIC_DUCKED="$WORK/music_ducked.m4a"
ffmpeg -y -i "$MUSIC" \
  -filter_complex "
    [0:a]
    atrim=0:45,
    asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,
    volume='if(between(t,18.0,19.0), 0.03, 0.25)':eval=frame
    [out]
  " \
  -map "[out]" \
  -c:a aac -b:a 160k -ar 44100 -ac 2 \
  "$MUSIC_DUCKED" 2>&1 | tail -3

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 4: mix VO (front) + music (behind, ducked under VO). VO at full gain,
# music compressed -3 dB when VO is active. Use sidechaincompress for clean
# duck under VO.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
AUDIO_FULL="$WORK/audio.m4a"
ffmpeg -y \
  -i "$VO_FULL" \
  -i "$MUSIC_DUCKED" \
  -filter_complex "
    [1:a][0:a]sidechaincompress=threshold=0.05:ratio=8:attack=20:release=400:makeup=1[ducked];
    [0:a][ducked]amix=inputs=2:duration=longest:normalize=0,
    alimiter=limit=0.95
  " \
  -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 44100 -ac 2 \
  "$AUDIO_FULL" 2>&1 | tail -3

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 5: combine visual + audio -> final mp4.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ffmpeg -y \
  -i "$VIDEO_FULL" \
  -i "$AUDIO_FULL" \
  -map 0:v -map 1:a \
  -c:v copy \
  -c:a copy \
  -movflags +faststart \
  -t 45 \
  "$OUT" 2>&1 | tail -3

echo
echo "FINAL: $OUT"
ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration,bit_rate -show_entries stream=codec_name,width,height -of default=noprint_wrappers=1 "$OUT"
echo "Size: $(du -h "$OUT" | cut -f1)"

# Clean intermediates
# rm -rf "$WORK"
```

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# V3 submission video mixer.
#
# Inputs:
#   raw-v3/passA.webm       cold open + BLOCK story (beats 1-2 + 4-5)
#   raw-v3/passB.webm       PASS + recommendation + checkout (beats 6-8)
#   raw-v3/passC.webm       /architecture pan (beat 9)
#   raw-v3/title_beat3.png  title card (beat 3, 14s)
#   raw-v3/title_beat10.png 12-word headline card (overlay tail of beat 10)
#   raw-v3/end_card.png     end card (beats 11-12, ~20s)
#   veo-v3/labrador-golden-hour.mp4   Veo 3.1 hero (beat 10, 8s)
#   vo-v3/beat-NN.mp3       Antoni voiceover, 12 beats, 160.82s total
#   music-v3/bed.wav        Lyria 2 atmospheric bed, 150s
#
# Output: pawconscious-demo-v3.mp4 (~2:41 total)
#
# Beat timing map (matches actual VO durations):
#   beat 1  00:00.0 - 00:11.15
#   beat 2  00:11.15 - 00:18.35
#   beat 3  00:18.35 - 00:33.0
#   beat 4  00:33.0 - 00:47.07
#   beat 5  00:47.07 - 00:57.15
#   beat 6  00:57.15 - 01:15.26
#   beat 7  01:15.26 - 01:30.21
#   beat 8  01:30.21 - 01:42.33
#   beat 9  01:42.33 - 02:00.35
#   beat 10 02:00.35 - 02:17.16
#   beat 11 02:17.16 - 02:36.01
#   beat 12 02:36.01 - 02:40.84
#
# Music: bed plays 0-150s at -22 LUFS baseline. Ducks to -28 LUFS during
# beat 5 (47-57s, the protected frame). Fades to silence over the last 5s.
# VO sits front at full gain; sidechaincompress under VO across the whole
# track to keep clarity.

set -euo pipefail

DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
RAW="$DIR/raw-v3"
VO="$DIR/vo-v3"
MUSIC="$DIR/music-v3"
VEO="$DIR/veo-v3"
OUT="$DIR/pawconscious-demo-v3.mp4"
WORK="$DIR/_work_v3"

mkdir -p "$WORK"

# Sanity
for f in "$RAW/passA.webm" "$RAW/passB.webm" "$RAW/passC.webm" \
         "$RAW/title_beat3.png" "$RAW/title_beat10.png" "$RAW/end_card.png" \
         "$VEO/labrador-golden-hour.mp4" "$MUSIC/bed.wav"; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || { echo "missing $f" >&2; exit 1; }
done
for n in 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12; do
  [ -f "$VO/beat-$n.mp3" ] || { echo "missing beat-$n.mp3" >&2; exit 1; }
done

W=1920
H=1080
FPS=30

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 1 — build the visual track (silent concat of all segments).
# Beat windows and source mapping:
#   beat 1+2   passA[0-18.35]
#   beat 3     title_beat3.png 14.65s (matches VO 18.35→33.0)
#   beat 4+5   passA[18.35-end] (we'll trim from same source)  ← see note
#   beat 6+7+8 passB.webm full
#   beat 9     passC.webm full
#   beat 10    labrador.mp4 (8s) + title_beat10.png (~8.8s)
#   beat 11+12 end_card.png (~23.7s, fades final 2s)
#
# Note: passA contains scene-0+1 (~18s) THEN scene-2b (BLOCK, ~17s).
# We need to split passA into the cold-open half [0-18s] and the BLOCK
# half [start-of-scene-2b → end]. Easiest: re-encode passA into two clips.

PASSA_DUR=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$RAW/passA.webm")
echo "[mix] passA total: ${PASSA_DUR}s"

# Split passA: 0→18.5s = cold open (beats 1-2). 18.5→end = BLOCK (beats 4-5).
ffmpeg -y -i "$RAW/passA.webm" -t 18.5 -an -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -r $FPS -vf "scale=$W:$H,format=yuv420p" "$WORK/seg_b1b2.mp4" 2>&1 | tail -1
ffmpeg -y -ss 18.5 -i "$RAW/passA.webm" -t 24 -an -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -r $FPS -vf "scale=$W:$H,format=yuv420p" "$WORK/seg_b4b5.mp4" 2>&1 | tail -1

# Title card beat 3: 14.65s
ffmpeg -y -loop 1 -i "$RAW/title_beat3.png" -t 14.65 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -r $FPS -vf "scale=$W:$H" "$WORK/seg_b3.mp4" 2>&1 | tail -1

# Pass B as beats 6-8 (one continuous clip ~46s but VO beats 6+7+8 = 45.2s)
PASSB_DUR=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$RAW/passB.webm")
echo "[mix] passB total: ${PASSB_DUR}s (need 45.2s for beats 6-8)"
ffmpeg -y -i "$RAW/passB.webm" -t 45.2 -an -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -r $FPS -vf "scale=$W:$H,format=yuv420p" "$WORK/seg_b6b7b8.mp4" 2>&1 | tail -1

# Pass C beat 9: 18.02s
ffmpeg -y -i "$RAW/passC.webm" -t 18.02 -an -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -r $FPS -vf "scale=$W:$H,format=yuv420p" "$WORK/seg_b9.mp4" 2>&1 | tail -1

# Beat 10: Veo Labrador 8s + headline card ~8.8s
ffmpeg -y -i "$VEO/labrador-golden-hour.mp4" -t 8 -an -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -r $FPS -vf "scale=$W:$H,format=yuv420p" "$WORK/seg_b10a_veo.mp4" 2>&1 | tail -1
ffmpeg -y -loop 1 -i "$RAW/title_beat10.png" -t 8.81 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -r $FPS -vf "scale=$W:$H" "$WORK/seg_b10b_card.mp4" 2>&1 | tail -1

# Beats 11+12 = end card 23.68s. Fade to black last 2s.
ffmpeg -y -loop 1 -i "$RAW/end_card.png" -t 23.68 -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 18 -r $FPS \
  -vf "scale=$W:$H,fade=t=out:st=21.68:d=2:color=#0E1218" "$WORK/seg_b11b12.mp4" 2>&1 | tail -1

# Concat all segments → visual.mp4
cat > "$WORK/concat.txt" <<EOF
file '$WORK/seg_b1b2.mp4'
file '$WORK/seg_b3.mp4'
file '$WORK/seg_b4b5.mp4'
file '$WORK/seg_b6b7b8.mp4'
file '$WORK/seg_b9.mp4'
file '$WORK/seg_b10a_veo.mp4'
file '$WORK/seg_b10b_card.mp4'
file '$WORK/seg_b11b12.mp4'
EOF
ffmpeg -y -f concat -safe 0 -i "$WORK/concat.txt" -c copy "$WORK/visual.mp4" 2>&1 | tail -1
VISUAL_DUR=$(ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration -of default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1 "$WORK/visual.mp4")
echo "[mix] visual.mp4 ${VISUAL_DUR}s"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 2 — build VO chain.
# Each beat is delayed to its start time and amix'd.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
declare -a STARTS=(0 11150 18350 33000 47070 57150 75260 90210 102330 120350 137160 156010)
declare -a BEATS=(01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08 09 10 11 12)

# Build the amix expression
FILTER=""
INPUTS=""
for i in "${!BEATS[@]}"; do
  b=${BEATS[$i]}
  ms=${STARTS[$i]}
  INPUTS="$INPUTS -i $VO/beat-$b.mp3"
  FILTER="$FILTER[$i:a]adelay=${ms}|${ms}[a$i];"
done
MIXES=""
for i in "${!BEATS[@]}"; do MIXES="$MIXES[a$i]"; done
FILTER="${FILTER}${MIXES}amix=inputs=${#BEATS[@]}:duration=longest:normalize=0,apad=whole_dur=161,atrim=0:161,asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS"

ffmpeg -y $INPUTS -filter_complex "$FILTER" -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 44100 -ac 2 "$WORK/vo.m4a" 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "[mix] vo.m4a built"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 3 — music bed dynamics.
# Bed at 0.22 baseline, ducks to 0.06 for beat 5 (47-57s), fades last 5s.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ffmpeg -y -i "$MUSIC/bed.wav" -filter_complex "
  [0:a]
  atrim=0:161,
  asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,
  volume='if(between(t,47,57), 0.06, if(between(t,156,161), 0.22*(1-(t-156)/5), 0.22))':eval=frame
  [out]
" -map "[out]" -c:a aac -b:a 160k -ar 44100 -ac 2 "$WORK/music_ducked.m4a" 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "[mix] music ducked built"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 4 — mix VO front + music behind with sidechaincompress for VO ducking.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ffmpeg -y -i "$WORK/vo.m4a" -i "$WORK/music_ducked.m4a" -filter_complex "
  [1:a][0:a]sidechaincompress=threshold=0.05:ratio=8:attack=20:release=400:makeup=1[ducked];
  [0:a][ducked]amix=inputs=2:duration=longest:normalize=0,
  alimiter=limit=0.95
" -c:a aac -b:a 192k -ar 44100 -ac 2 "$WORK/audio.m4a" 2>&1 | tail -1
echo "[mix] audio.m4a built"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Step 5 — final combine + faststart.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
ffmpeg -y -i "$WORK/visual.mp4" -i "$WORK/audio.m4a" \
  -map 0:v -map 1:a -c:v copy -c:a copy -movflags +faststart \
  -t 161 "$OUT" 2>&1 | tail -1

echo
echo "FINAL: $OUT"
ffprobe -v error -show_entries format=duration,bit_rate -show_entries stream=codec_name,width,height -of default=noprint_wrappers=1 "$OUT"
echo "Size: $(du -h "$OUT" | cut -f1)"
```
